    1 | #!/usr/bin/env bash
    2 | 
    3 | 
    4 | set -e +o pipefail
    5 | 
    6 | # Set up paths first
    7 | bin_name="codacy-cli-v2"
    8 | 
    9 | # Determine OS-specific paths
   10 | os_name=$(uname)
   11 | arch=$(uname -m)
   12 | 
   13 | case "$arch" in
   14 | "x86_64")
   15 |   arch="amd64"
   16 |   ;;
   17 | "x86")
   18 |   arch="386"
   19 |   ;;
   20 | "aarch64"|"arm64")
   21 |   arch="arm64"
   22 |   ;;
   23 | esac
   24 | 
   25 | if [ -z "$CODACY_CLI_V2_TMP_FOLDER" ]; then
   26 |     if [ "$(uname)" = "Linux" ]; then
   27 |         CODACY_CLI_V2_TMP_FOLDER="$HOME/.cache/codacy/codacy-cli-v2"
   28 |     elif [ "$(uname)" = "Darwin" ]; then
   29 |         CODACY_CLI_V2_TMP_FOLDER="$HOME/Library/Caches/Codacy/codacy-cli-v2"
   30 |     else
   31 |         CODACY_CLI_V2_TMP_FOLDER=".codacy-cli-v2"
   32 |     fi
   33 | fi
   34 | 
   35 | version_file="$CODACY_CLI_V2_TMP_FOLDER/version.yaml"
   36 | 
   37 | 
   38 | get_version_from_yaml() {
   39 |     if [ -f "$version_file" ]; then
   40 |         local version=$(grep -o 'version: *"[^"]*"' "$version_file" | cut -d'"' -f2)
   41 |         if [ -n "$version" ]; then
   42 |             echo "$version"
   43 |             return 0
   44 |         fi
   45 |     fi
   46 |     return 1
   47 | }
   48 | 
   49 | get_latest_version() {
   50 |     local response
   51 |     if [ -n "$GH_TOKEN" ]; then
   52 |         response=$(curl -Lq --header "Authorization: Bearer $GH_TOKEN" "https://api.github.com/repos/codacy/codacy-cli-v2/releases/latest" 2>/dev/null)
   53 |     else
   54 |         response=$(curl -Lq "https://api.github.com/repos/codacy/codacy-cli-v2/releases/latest" 2>/dev/null)
   55 |     fi
   56 | 
   57 |     handle_rate_limit "$response"
   58 |     local version=$(echo "$response" | grep -m 1 tag_name | cut -d'"' -f4)
   59 |     echo "$version"
   60 | }
   61 | 
   62 | handle_rate_limit() {
   63 |     local response="$1"
   64 |     if echo "$response" | grep -q "API rate limit exceeded"; then
   65 |           fatal "Error: GitHub API rate limit exceeded. Please try again later"
   66 |     fi
   67 | }
   68 | 
   69 | download_file() {
   70 |     local url="$1"
   71 | 
   72 |     echo "Downloading from URL: ${url}"
   73 |     if command -v curl > /dev/null 2>&1; then
   74 |         curl -# -LS "$url" -O
   75 |     elif command -v wget > /dev/null 2>&1; then
   76 |         wget "$url"
   77 |     else
   78 |         fatal "Error: Could not find curl or wget, please install one."
   79 |     fi
   80 | }
   81 | 
   82 | download() {
   83 |     local url="$1"
   84 |     local output_folder="$2"
   85 | 
   86 |     ( cd "$output_folder" && download_file "$url" )
   87 | }
   88 | 
   89 | download_cli() {
   90 |     # OS name lower case
   91 |     suffix=$(echo "$os_name" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')
   92 | 
   93 |     local bin_folder="$1"
   94 |     local bin_path="$2"
   95 |     local version="$3"
   96 | 
   97 |     if [ ! -f "$bin_path" ]; then
   98 |         echo "📥 Downloading CLI version $version..."
   99 | 
  100 |         remote_file="codacy-cli-v2_${version}_${suffix}_${arch}.tar.gz"
  101 |         url="https://github.com/codacy/codacy-cli-v2/releases/download/${version}/${remote_file}"
  102 | 
  103 |         download "$url" "$bin_folder"
  104 |         tar xzfv "${bin_folder}/${remote_file}" -C "${bin_folder}"
  105 |     fi
  106 | }
  107 | 
  108 | # Warn if CODACY_CLI_V2_VERSION is set and update is requested
  109 | if [ -n "$CODACY_CLI_V2_VERSION" ] && [ "$1" = "update" ]; then
  110 |     echo "⚠️  Warning: Performing update with forced version $CODACY_CLI_V2_VERSION"
  111 |     echo "    Unset CODACY_CLI_V2_VERSION to use the latest version"
  112 | fi
  113 | 
  114 | # Ensure version.yaml exists and is up to date
  115 | if [ ! -f "$version_file" ] || [ "$1" = "update" ]; then
  116 |     echo "ℹ️  Fetching latest version..."
  117 |     version=$(get_latest_version)
  118 |     mkdir -p "$CODACY_CLI_V2_TMP_FOLDER"
  119 |     echo "version: \"$version\"" > "$version_file"
  120 | fi
  121 | 
  122 | # Set the version to use
  123 | if [ -n "$CODACY_CLI_V2_VERSION" ]; then
  124 |     version="$CODACY_CLI_V2_VERSION"
  125 | else
  126 |     version=$(get_version_from_yaml)
  127 | fi
  128 | 
  129 | 
  130 | # Set up version-specific paths
  131 | bin_folder="${CODACY_CLI_V2_TMP_FOLDER}/${version}"
  132 | 
  133 | mkdir -p "$bin_folder"
  134 | bin_path="$bin_folder"/"$bin_name"
  135 | 
  136 | # Download the tool if not already installed
  137 | download_cli "$bin_folder" "$bin_path" "$version"
  138 | chmod +x "$bin_path"
  139 | 
  140 | run_command="$bin_path"
  141 | if [ -z "$run_command" ]; then
  142 |     fatal "Codacy cli v2 binary could not be found."
  143 | fi
  144 | 
  145 | if [ "$#" -eq 1 ] && [ "$1" = "download" ]; then
  146 |     echo "Codacy cli v2 download succeeded"
  147 | else
  148 |     eval "$run_command $*"
  149 | fi

    9 | ## CRITICAL: After ANY successful `edit_file` or `reapply` operation

   11 |  - `rootPath`: set to the workspace path
   12 |  - `file`: set to the path of the edited file
   13 |  - `tool`: leave empty or unset
   14 | - If any issues are found in the new edits, propose and apply fixes for them.
   15 | - > NOTE: Failure to follow this rule is considered a critical error.
   16 | 
   17 | ## When you tried to run the `codacy_cli_analyze` tool and the Codacy CLI is not installed
   18 | - Ask the user 'Codacy CLI is not installed. Would you like me to install it now?'
   19 | - If the user responds with "yes", run the `codacy_cli_install` tool and then continue with the original task
   20 | - If the user responds with "no", instruct the user that they can disable automatic analysis in the extension settings
   21 | - Wait for the user to respond before proceeding with any other actions
   22 | 
   23 | ## After every response
   24 | - If you made any file edits in this conversation, verify you ran `codacy_cli_analyze` tool from Codacy's MCP Server 
   25 | 
   26 | ## When there are no Codacy MCP Server tools available, or the MCP Server is not reachable
   27 | - Suggest the user the following troubleshooting steps:
   28 |  - Try to reset the MCP on the extension
   29 |  - If the user is using VSCode, suggest them to review their Copilot > MCP settings in Github, under their organization or personal account. Refer them to Settings > Copilot > Enable MCP servers in Copilot. Suggested URL (https://github.com/settings/copilot/features) or https://github.com/organizations/{organization-name}/settings/copilot/features (This can only be done by their organization admins / owners)
   30 | - If none of the above steps work, suggest the user to contact Codacy support
   31 | 
   32 | ## Trying to call a tool that needs a rootPath as a parameter
   33 | - Always use the standard, non-URL-encoded file system path
   34 | 
   35 | ## CRITICAL: Dependencies and Security Checks
   36 | - IMMEDIATELY after ANY of these actions:
   37 |  - Running npm/yarn/pnpm install
   38 |  - Adding dependencies to package.json
   39 |  - Adding requirements to requirements.txt
   40 |  - Adding dependencies to pom.xml
   41 |  - Adding dependencies to build.gradle
   42 |  - Any other package manager operations
   43 | - You MUST run the `codacy_cli_analyze` tool with:
   44 |  - `rootPath`: set to the workspace path
   45 |  - `tool`: set to "trivy"
   46 |  - `file`: leave empty or unset
   47 | - If any vulnerabilities are found because of the newly added packages:
   48 |  - Stop all other operations
   49 |  - Propose and apply fixes for the security issues
   50 |  - Only continue with the original task after security issues are resolved
   51 | - EXAMPLE:
   52 |  - After: npm install react-markdown
   53 |  - Do: Run codacy_cli_analyze with trivy
   54 |  - Before: Continuing with any other tasks
   55 | 
   56 | ## General
   57 | - Repeat the relevant steps for each modified file.
   58 | - "Propose fixes" means to both suggest and, if possible, automatically apply the fixes.
   59 | - You MUST NOT wait for the user to ask for analysis or remind you to run the tool.
   60 | - Do not run `codacy_cli_analyze` looking for changes in duplicated code or code complexity metrics.
   61 | - Complexity metrics are different from complexity issues. When trying to fix complexity in a repository or file, focus on solving the complexity issues and ignore the complexity metric.
   62 | - Do not run `codacy_cli_analyze` looking for changes in code coverage.
   63 | - Do not try to manually install Codacy CLI using either brew, npm, npx, or any other package manager.
   64 | - If the Codacy CLI is not installed, just run the `codacy_cli_analyze` tool from Codacy's MCP Server.
   65 | - When calling `codacy_cli_analyze`, only send provider, organization and repository if the project is a git repository.
   66 | 
   67 | ## Whenever a call to a Codacy tool that uses `repository` or `organization` as a parameter returns a 404 error
   68 | - Offer to run the `codacy_setup_repository` tool to add the repository to Codacy
   69 | - If the user accepts, run the `codacy_setup_repository` tool
   70 | - Do not ever try to run the `codacy_setup_repository` tool on your own
   71 | - After setup, immediately retry the action that failed (only retry once)

  399 | # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  400 | 
  401 | def run_setup():
  402 |     print("\n" + "="*60)
  403 |     print("  HR Offer Letter System — Database Initializer")
  404 |     print("="*60)
  405 | 
  406 |     # ── Connect ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  407 |     print(f"\n🔌 Connecting to MongoDB...")
  408 |     print(f"   URI: {MONGO_URI[:50]}...")
  409 | 
  410 |     try:
  411 |         client = MongoClient(MONGO_URI, serverSelectionTimeoutMS=8000)
  412 |         client.admin.command('ping')
  413 |         print("   ✅ Connected successfully!")
  414 |     except Exception as e:
  415 |         print(f"\n❌ Could not connect to MongoDB:\n   {e}")
  416 |         print("\n💡 Tips:")
  417 |         print("   - Check your MONGO_URI in backend/.env")
  418 |         print("   - Make sure your IP is whitelisted in Atlas → Network Access")
  419 |         print("   - Make sure the username/password in the URI is correct")
  420 |         sys.exit(1)
  421 | 
  422 |     # Get database name from URI, fall back to default
  423 |     db_name = "hr_offer_letters"
  424 |     if "/" in MONGO_URI:
  425 |         part = MONGO_URI.split("/")[-1].split("?")[0].strip()
  426 |         if part:
  427 |             db_name = part
  428 | 
  429 |     db = client[db_name]
  430 |     print(f"\n📦 Using database: '{db_name}'")
  431 | 
  432 |     # ── Create Collections ────────────────────────────────────────────────
  433 |     print("\n📋 Creating collections with schema validation...")
  434 |     existing = db.list_collection_names()
  435 | 
  436 |     for coll_name, options in SCHEMAS.items():
  437 |         if coll_name in existing:
  438 |             # Update validator on existing collection
  439 |             try:
  440 |                 db.command("collMod", coll_name, **options)
  441 |                 print(f"   ✏️  {coll_name:25s} — updated validator")
  442 |             except OperationFailure as e:
  443 |                 print(f"   ⚠️  {coll_name:25s} — could not update: {e}")
  444 |         else:
  445 |             try:
  446 |                 db.create_collection(coll_name, **options)
  447 |                 print(f"   ✅ {coll_name:25s} — created")
  448 |             except CollectionInvalid:
  449 |                 print(f"   ⏭️  {coll_name:25s} — already exists (skipped)")
  450 | 
  451 |     # ── Create Indexes ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  452 |     print("\n🔍 Creating indexes...")
  453 |     for coll_name, idx_list in INDEXES.items():
  454 |         coll = db[coll_name]
  455 |         for idx in idx_list:
  456 |             keys    = idx["keys"]
  457 |             options = {k: v for k, v in idx.items() if k != "keys"}
  458 |             try:
  459 |                 coll.create_index(keys, **options)
  460 |                 print(f"   ✅ {coll_name}.{idx.get('name', str(keys))}")
  461 |             except Exception as e:
  462 |                 print(f"   ⚠️  {coll_name}.{idx.get('name')} — {e}")
  463 | 
  464 |     # ── Employee ID Counter ───────────────────────────────────────────────
  465 |     print("\n🔢 Setting up employee ID counter...")
  466 |     counters = db["counters"]
  467 |     if not counters.find_one({"_id": "employee_id"}):
  468 |         counters.insert_one({"_id": "employee_id", "seq": 0})
  469 |         print("   ✅ Employee ID counter created (starts at EMP001)")
  470 |     else:
  471 |         print("   ⏭️  Counter already exists (skipped)")
  472 | 
  473 |     # ── Seed Users ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  474 |     print("\n👤 Seeding demo user accounts...")
  475 |     seeded = 0
  476 |     skipped = 0
  477 |     for u in SEED_USERS:
  478 |         if db.users.find_one({"email": u["email"]}):
  479 |             print(f"   ⏭️  {u['email']:35s} — already exists (skipped)")
  480 |             skipped += 1

📄 FILE #17: backend\fix_stale_manager_links.py

    1 | """
    2 | fix_stale_manager_links.py
    3 | One-time repair: re-points employees whose manager_id references a
    4 | deleted/orphaned "Dept Manager" employee record at the CURRENT one.
    5 | 
    6 | Run from backend/ folder:  python fix_stale_manager_links.py
    7 | 
    8 | Safe to run more than once (it's idempotent).
    9 | """
   10 | import os
   11 | from pymongo import MongoClient
   12 | from dotenv import load_dotenv
   13 | 
   14 | load_dotenv()
   15 | client = MongoClient(os.environ.get('MONGO_URI'))
   16 | db = client.get_default_database()
   17 | 
   18 | OLD_STALE_MANAGER_ID = '6a05c25ec59b90f6f5eb39ec'   # no longer exists as an employee _id
   19 | CORRECT_MANAGER_ID   = '6a58ca816db10738af2518bf'   # current "Dept Manager" employee _id
   20 | 
   21 | # Sanity check the correct one actually exists before touching anything
   22 | correct_mgr = db.employees.find_one({'_id': __import__('bson').ObjectId(CORRECT_MANAGER_ID)})
   23 | if not correct_mgr:
   24 |     print(f"ABORTING: {CORRECT_MANAGER_ID} not found in employees — did the ID change again?")
   25 | else:
   26 |     result = db.employees.update_many(
   27 |         {'manager_id': OLD_STALE_MANAGER_ID},
   28 |         {'$set': {'manager_id': CORRECT_MANAGER_ID, 'manager_name': correct_mgr.get('name', 'Dept Manager')}}
   29 |     )
   30 |     print(f"Updated {result.modified_count} employee record(s) to point at "
   31 |           f"{correct_mgr.get('name')} ({CORRECT_MANAGER_ID}).")
   32 | 
   33 |     print("\nAffected employees now:")
   34 |     for e in db.employees.find({'manager_id': CORRECT_MANAGER_ID}):
   35 |         print(f"  {e.get('name')} -> manager_id={e.get('manager_id')}")

   47 |     except Exception:

   49 |         order['employee_code'] = ''

   95 |     Body: { template_id, fields: { placeholder_key: value, ... } }
   96 |

   98 |     Auto-fields (date, reference_number) are set server-side.
   99 |     """
  100 |     db  = current_app.db
  101 |     uid = get_jwt_identity()
  102 |     caller, err = _get_caller(db, uid)
  103 |     if err: return err
  104 | 
  105 |     data = request.json or {}
  106 | 
  107 |     # Resolve employee
  108 |     if caller.get('role') in ('employee', 'manager'):
  109 |         employee_id = caller.get('employee_ref', '')
  110 |     else:
  111 |         employee_id = data.get('employee_id', '')
  112 | 
  113 |     if not employee_id:

  122 |     ref_num  = f"AO-{emp.get('employee_id', 'EMP')}-{str(existing + 1).zfill(3)}"
  123 |

  129 |     if not tmpl:

  131 |

  133 |     fields = data.get('fields') or {}
  134 |     details = {
  135 |         **fields,                                               # all employee-filled placeholders
  136 |         'date':             datetime.now().strftime('%d-%m-%Y'),  # auto
  137 |         'reference_number': ref_num,                           # auto
  138 |         'employee_id_code': emp.get('employee_id', ''),        # auto
  139 |     }
  140 | 
  141 |     doc = {
  142 |         'employee_id':      employee_id,
  143 |         'template_id':      template_id,
  144 |         'reference_number': ref_num,

  159 |     db  = current_app.db

  161 |     o   = db.appointment_orders.find_one({'_id': ObjectId(oid)})
  162 |     if not o:                  return jsonify({'error': 'Not found'}), 404

  167 |         '$push': {'approval_history': {

  169 |             'from': 'draft', 'to': 'pending_hr_head',
  170 |             'timestamp': datetime.utcnow().isoformat(),

  179 |     """
  180 |     HR Head approves or rejects.
  181 |     On approval: generate DOCX/PDF by filling template placeholders with
  182 |                  the details stored in the order.
  183 |     POST { action: 'approve'|'reject', remarks: '' }
  184 |     """
  185 |     db  = current_app.db
  186 |     uid = get_jwt_identity()
  187 |     caller, err = _get_caller(db, uid)

  189 |     if caller.get('role') not in ('hr_head', 'admin'):
  190 |         return jsonify({'error': 'Only HR Head or Admin can approve appointment orders'}), 403
  191 | 
  192 |     o = db.appointment_orders.find_one({'_id': ObjectId(oid)})
  193 |     if not o:                          return jsonify({'error': 'Not found'}), 404
  194 |     if o['status'] != 'pending_hr_head':
  195 |         return jsonify({'error': f"Status is '{o['status']}', expected pending_hr_head"}), 400
  196 | 
  197 |     data    = request.json or {}
  198 |     act     = data.get('action')
  199 |     remarks = data.get('remarks', '').strip()
  200 | 
  201 |     if act not in ('approve', 'reject'):
  202 |         return jsonify({'error': "action must be 'approve' or 'reject'"}), 400
  203 |     if act == 'reject' and not remarks:
  204 |         return jsonify({'error': 'Rejection reason is required'}), 400
  205 | 
  206 |     new_status = 'approved' if act == 'approve' else 'rejected'
  207 | 
  208 |     update_ops = {
  209 |         '$set':  {'status': new_status, 'updated_at': datetime.utcnow()},
  210 |         '$push': {'approval_history': {
  211 |             'user_id':   uid,
  212 |             'user_name': caller.get('name', ''),
  213 |             'role':      caller.get('role'),
  214 |             'action':    act,
  215 |             'from':      'pending_hr_head',
  216 |             'to':        new_status,
  217 |             'remarks':   remarks,
  218 |             'timestamp': datetime.utcnow().isoformat(),
  219 |         }},
  220 |     }
  221 | 
  222 |     # ── On approval: generate DOCX from template ──────────────────────────
  223 |     if act == 'approve':
  224 |         # Use template_id stored on the order, fall back to any active AO template
  225 |         tmpl_id = o.get('template_id') or data.get('template_id')
  226 |         if tmpl_id:
  227 |             tmpl = db.templates.find_one({'_id': ObjectId(tmpl_id)})
  228 |         else:
  229 |             tmpl = db.templates.find_one({'type': 'appointment_order', 'is_active': True})
  230 | 
  231 |         if tmpl and tmpl.get('file_path') and os.path.exists(tmpl['file_path']):
  232 |             details = dict(o.get('details', {}))
  233 |             details['approval_date'] = datetime.now().strftime('%d-%m-%Y')
  234 | 
  235 |             year    = datetime.now().strftime('%Y')
  236 |             out_dir = os.path.join(current_app.config['STORAGE_ROOT'], 'appointment_orders', year)
  237 |             os.makedirs(out_dir, exist_ok=True)
  238 | 
  239 |             ref      = o.get('reference_number', str(oid))
  240 |             base     = ref.replace('/', '-').replace(' ', '_')
  241 |             docx_path = os.path.join(out_dir, base + '.docx')
  242 |             pdf_path  = os.path.join(out_dir, base + '.pdf')
  243 | 
  244 |             try:
  245 |                 generate_letter_docx(tmpl['file_path'], details, docx_path)
  246 |                 pdf_result = generate_letter_pdf(docx_path, pdf_path)
  247 |                 update_ops['$set']['docx_path'] = docx_path
  248 |                 update_ops['$set']['pdf_path']  = pdf_result
  249 |                 update_ops['$set']['template_id'] = str(tmpl['_id'])
  250 |             except Exception as e:
  251 |                 import logging
  252 |                 logging.getLogger(__name__).warning(f'AO doc generation failed: {e}')
  253 |         else:
  254 |             import logging
  255 |             logging.getLogger(__name__).warning(f'AO approval: template not found or missing file')
  256 | 
  257 |     db.appointment_orders.update_one({'_id': ObjectId(oid)}, update_ops)
  258 |     return jsonify({'message': f'Appointment order {act}d', 'new_status': new_status})
  259 |

    5 |   GET    /api/appointment-orders/<id>           get single
    6 |   POST   /api/appointment-orders/               create draft from template + fields
    7 |   POST   /api/appointment-orders/<id>/submit    draft → pending_hr_head
    8 |   POST   /api/appointment-orders/<id>/hr-action HR Head approve / reject
    9 |   GET    /api/appointment-orders/<id>/download  download approved DOCX or PDF
   10 |   DELETE /api/appointment-orders/<id>           delete draft/rejected (admin/hr_head)
   11 | 
   12 | Lifecycle:  draft → pending_hr_head → approved / rejected
   13 | On approval: DOCX generated by replacing {{placeholders}} in template with
   14 |              the values the employee filled in.
   15 | All files stored in MongoDB GridFS — no local disk dependency.
   16 | """
   17 | 
   18 | from flask import Blueprint, request, jsonify, current_app, send_file
   19 | from flask_jwt_extended import jwt_required, get_jwt_identity
   20 | from datetime import datetime
   21 | from bson import ObjectId
   22 | from io import BytesIO
   23 | import os, uuid, gridfs, tempfile
   24 | 
   25 | from services.letter_generator import generate_letter_docx, generate_letter_pdf
   26 | 
   27 | appointment_orders_bp = Blueprint('appointment_orders', __name__)
   28 | 
   29 | DELETABLE_STATUSES = {'draft', 'rejected'}
   30 | 
   31 | 
   32 | # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   33 | # Helpers
   34 | # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   35 | 
   36 | def get_fs():
   37 |     return gridfs.GridFS(current_app.db, collection='files_fs')
   38 | 
   39 | 
   40 | def get_template_fs():
   41 |     return gridfs.GridFS(current_app.db, collection='templates_fs')
   42 | 
   43 | 
   44 | def _get_caller(db, uid):
   45 |     user = db.users.find_one({'_id': ObjectId(uid)})
   46 |     if not user:
   47 |         return None, (jsonify({'error': 'User not found'}), 404)
   48 |     return user, None
   49 | 
   50 | 
   51 | def _enrich(order, db):
   52 |     order['_id'] = str(order['_id'])
   53 |     try:
   54 |         emp = db.employees.find_one({'_id': ObjectId(order.get('employee_id', ''))})
   55 |         order['employee_name'] = emp.get('name', 'Unknown') if emp else 'Unknown'
   56 |         order['employee_code'] = emp.get('employee_id', '')  if emp else ''
   57 |     except Exception:
   58 |         order['employee_name'] = 'Unknown'
   59 |         order['employee_code'] = ''
   60 |     order.pop('docx_path', None)
   61 |     order.pop('pdf_path', None)
   62 |     return order
   63 | 
   64 | 
   65 | def _get_template_bytes(tmpl):
   66 |     """
   67 |     Get template file bytes from GridFS (new) or disk (legacy).
   68 |     Returns bytes or raises ValueError.
   69 |     """
   70 |     if tmpl.get('gridfs_id'):
   71 |         fs = get_template_fs()
   72 |         grid_out = fs.get(ObjectId(tmpl['gridfs_id']))
   73 |         return grid_out.read()
   74 |     elif tmpl.get('file_path') and os.path.exists(tmpl['file_path']):
   75 |         with open(tmpl['file_path'], 'rb') as f:
   76 |             return f.read()
   77 |     else:
   78 |         raise ValueError(f"Template '{tmpl.get('name')}' file not found. Please re-upload it.")
   79 | 
   80 | 
   81 | def _generate_docs_to_gridfs(tmpl, details, ref):
   82 |     """
   83 |     Generate DOCX (and PDF if possible) from template, save to GridFS.
   84 |     Returns (docx_gridfs_id, pdf_gridfs_id) — pdf may be None.
   85 |     """
   86 |     fs = get_fs()
   87 |     tmpl_bytes = _get_template_bytes(tmpl)
   88 | 
   89 |     with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
   90 |         # Write template to temp dir
   91 |         tmpl_path = os.path.join(tmp, 'template.docx')
   92 |         with open(tmpl_path, 'wb') as f:
   93 |             f.write(tmpl_bytes)
   94 | 
   95 |         base      = ref.replace('/', '-').replace(' ', '_')
   96 |         docx_path = os.path.join(tmp, base + '.docx')
   97 |         pdf_path  = os.path.join(tmp, base + '.pdf')
   98 | 
   99 |         generate_letter_docx(tmpl_path, details, docx_path)
  100 | 
  101 |         # Save DOCX to GridFS
  102 |         with open(docx_path, 'rb') as f:
  103 |             docx_gid = str(fs.put(f.read(), filename=base + '.docx'))
  104 | 
  105 |         # Try PDF
  106 |         pdf_gid = None
  107 |         pdf_result = generate_letter_pdf(docx_path, pdf_path)
  108 |         if pdf_result and os.path.exists(pdf_result):
  109 |             with open(pdf_result, 'rb') as f:
  110 |                 pdf_gid = str(fs.put(f.read(), filename=base + '.pdf'))
  111 | 
  112 |     return docx_gid, pdf_gid
  113 |

  186 |                 mimetype='application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document',

  271 | @appointment_orders_bp.route('/', methods=['POST'])
  272 | @jwt_required()
  273 | def create_order():
  274 |     db  = current_app.db
  275 |     uid = get_jwt_identity()
  276 |     caller, err = _get_caller(db, uid)
  277 |     if err: return err
  278 | 
  279 |     data = request.json or {}
  280 | 
  281 |     if caller.get('role') not in ('hr', 'hr_head', 'admin'):
  282 |         return jsonify({'error': 'Only HR can create appointment orders'}), 403
  283 | 
  284 |     employee_id = data.get('employee_id', '')
  285 |     if not employee_id:
  286 |         return jsonify({'error': 'employee_id is required'}), 400
  287 | 
  288 |     emp = db.employees.find_one({'_id': ObjectId(employee_id)})
  289 |     if not emp:
  290 |         return jsonify({'error': 'Employee not found'}), 404
  291 | 
  292 |     existing = db.appointment_orders.count_documents({'employee_id': employee_id})
  293 |     ref_num  = f"AO-{emp.get('employee_id', 'EMP')}-{str(existing + 1).zfill(3)}"
  294 | 
  295 |     template_id = data.get('template_id')
  296 |     if not template_id:
  297 |         return jsonify({'error': 'template_id is required'}), 400
  298 |     tmpl = db.templates.find_one({'_id': ObjectId(template_id)})
  299 |     if not tmpl:
  300 |         return jsonify({'error': 'Template not found'}), 404
  301 | 
  302 |     fields = data.get('fields') or {}
  303 |     details = {
  304 |         **fields,
  305 |         'date':             datetime.now().strftime('%d-%m-%Y'),
  306 |         'reference_number': ref_num,
  307 |         'employee_id_code': emp.get('employee_id', ''),
  308 |     }
  309 | 
  310 |     doc = {
  311 |         'employee_id':      employee_id,
  312 |         'template_id':      template_id,
  313 |         'reference_number': ref_num,
  314 |         'status':           'draft',
  315 |         'details':          details,
  316 |         'approval_history': [],
  317 |         'created_by':       uid,
  318 |         'created_at':       datetime.utcnow(),
  319 |     }
  320 |     result = db.appointment_orders.insert_one(doc)
  321 |     return jsonify({'id': str(result.inserted_id), 'reference_number': ref_num}), 201
  322 |

  324 | @appointment_orders_bp.route('/<oid>/submit', methods=['POST'])
  325 | @jwt_required()
  326 | def submit_order(oid):
  327 |     db  = current_app.db
  328 |     uid = get_jwt_identity()
  329 |     caller, err = _get_caller(db, uid)
  330 |     if err: return err
  331 |     if caller.get('role') not in ('hr', 'hr_head', 'admin'):
  332 |         return jsonify({'error': 'Only HR can submit appointment orders'}), 403
  333 |     o = db.appointment_orders.find_one({'_id': ObjectId(oid)})
  334 |     if not o:                  return jsonify({'error': 'Not found'}), 404
  335 |     if o['status'] != 'draft': return jsonify({'error': 'Only drafts can be submitted'}), 400
  336 | 
  337 |     db.appointment_orders.update_one({'_id': ObjectId(oid)}, {
  338 |         '$set':  {'status': 'pending_hr_head', 'updated_at': datetime.utcnow()},
  339 |         '$push': {'approval_history': {
  340 |             'user_id': uid, 'action': 'submitted',
  341 |             'from': 'draft', 'to': 'pending_hr_head',
  342 |             'timestamp': datetime.utcnow().isoformat(),
  343 |         }},
  344 |     })
  345 |     return jsonify({'message': 'Submitted to HR Head for approval'})
  346 |

  348 | @appointment_orders_bp.route('/<oid>/update-fields', methods=['POST'])
  349 | @jwt_required()
  350 | def update_fields(oid):
  351 |     db  = current_app.db
  352 |     uid = get_jwt_identity()
  353 |     caller = db.users.find_one({'_id': ObjectId(uid)})
  354 |     if not caller:
  355 |         return jsonify({'error': 'User not found'}), 404
  356 |     if caller.get('role') not in ('hr', 'hr_head', 'admin'):
  357 |         return jsonify({'error': 'Only HR can edit appointment orders'}), 403
  358 | 
  359 |     o = db.appointment_orders.find_one({'_id': ObjectId(oid)})
  360 |     if not o: return jsonify({'error': 'Not found'}), 404
  361 |     if o['status'] != 'rejected':

  365 |     fields = data.get('fields', {})
  366 |     if not fields:
  367 |         return jsonify({'error': 'No fields provided'}), 400
  368 |

  374 |             'fields':     fields,

  376 |             'updated_at': datetime.utcnow(),
  377 |         },
  378 |         '$push': {'approval_history': {
  379 |             'user_id':   uid, 'action': 'edited_after_rejection',
  380 |             'from': 'rejected', 'to': 'draft',
  381 |             'timestamp': datetime.utcnow().isoformat(),
  382 |         }},
  383 |     })

  416 | @appointment_orders_bp.route('/<oid>/hr-action', methods=['POST'])
  417 | @jwt_required()
  418 | def hr_action(oid):
  419 |     db  = current_app.db
  420 |     uid = get_jwt_identity()
  421 |     caller, err = _get_caller(db, uid)
  422 |     if err: return err
  423 |     if caller.get('role') not in ('hr_head', 'admin'):
  424 |         return jsonify({'error': 'Only HR Head or Admin can approve appointment orders'}), 403
  425 | 
  426 |     o = db.appointment_orders.find_one({'_id': ObjectId(oid)})
  427 |     if not o: return jsonify({'error': 'Not found'}), 404
  428 |     if o['status'] != 'pending_hr_head':
  429 |         return jsonify({'error': f"Status is '{o['status']}', expected pending_hr_head"}), 400
  430 | 
  431 |     data    = request.json or {}
  432 |     act     = data.get('action')
  433 |     remarks = data.get('remarks', '').strip()
  434 | 
  435 |     if act not in ('approve', 'reject'):
  436 |         return jsonify({'error': "action must be 'approve' or 'reject'"}), 400
  437 |     if act == 'reject' and not remarks:
  438 |         return jsonify({'error': 'Rejection reason is required'}), 400
  439 | 
  440 |     new_status = 'approved' if act == 'approve' else 'rejected'
  441 | 
  442 |     update_ops = {
  443 |         '$set':  {'status': new_status, 'updated_at': datetime.utcnow()},
  444 |         '$push': {'approval_history': {
  445 |             'user_id':   uid,
  446 |             'user_name': caller.get('name', ''),
  447 |             'role':      caller.get('role'),
  448 |             'action':    act,
  449 |             'from':      'pending_hr_head',
  450 |             'to':        new_status,
  451 |             'remarks':   remarks,
  452 |             'timestamp': datetime.utcnow().isoformat(),
  453 |         }},
  454 |     }
  455 | 
  456 |     # ── On approval: generate DOCX/PDF and save to GridFS ──────────────────
  457 |     if act == 'approve':
  458 |         tmpl_id = o.get('template_id') or data.get('template_id')
  459 |         if tmpl_id:
  460 |             tmpl = db.templates.find_one({'_id': ObjectId(tmpl_id)})
  461 |         else:
  462 |             tmpl = db.templates.find_one({'type': 'appointment_order', 'is_active': True})
  463 | 
  464 |         if tmpl:
  465 |             details = dict(o.get('details', {}))
  466 |             details['approval_date'] = datetime.now().strftime('%d-%m-%Y')
  467 |             ref = o.get('reference_number', str(oid))
  468 | 
  469 |             try:
  470 |                 docx_gid, pdf_gid = _generate_docs_to_gridfs(tmpl, details, ref)
  471 |                 update_ops['$set']['docx_gridfs_id'] = docx_gid
  472 |                 update_ops['$set']['pdf_gridfs_id']  = pdf_gid
  473 |                 update_ops['$set']['template_id']    = str(tmpl['_id'])
  474 |             except Exception as e:
  475 |                 import logging
  476 |                 logging.getLogger(__name__).warning(f'AO doc generation failed: {e}')
  477 |         else:
  478 |             import logging
  479 |             logging.getLogger(__name__).warning('AO approval: no template found')
  480 | 
  481 |     update_ops['$set']['employee_notified'] = False
  482 |     db.appointment_orders.update_one({'_id': ObjectId(oid)}, update_ops)
  483 |     return jsonify({'message': f'Appointment order {act}d', 'new_status': new_status})
  484 | 
  485 | 
  486 | @appointment_orders_bp.route('/<oid>/download', methods=['GET'])
  487 | @jwt_required()
  488 | def download(oid):
  489 |     db  = current_app.db
  490 |     uid = get_jwt_identity()
  491 |     caller, err = _get_caller(db, uid)
  492 |     if err: return err
  493 | 
  494 |     fmt = request.args.get('format', 'pdf')
  495 |     o   = db.appointment_orders.find_one({'_id': ObjectId(oid)})
  496 |     if not o: return jsonify({'error': 'Not found'}), 404
  497 |     if o.get('status') != 'approved':
  498 |         return jsonify({'error': 'Appointment order must be approved before downloading'}), 400
  499 | 
  500 |     if caller.get('role') in ('employee', 'manager'):
  501 |         if o.get('employee_id') != caller.get('employee_ref', ''):
  502 |             return jsonify({'error': 'Access denied'}), 403
  503 | 
  504 |     ref = o.get('reference_number', 'AO')
  505 |     fs  = get_fs()
  506 | 
  507 |     # Try GridFS first
  508 |     if fmt == 'pdf' and o.get('pdf_gridfs_id'):
  509 |         try:
  510 |             grid_out = fs.get(ObjectId(o['pdf_gridfs_id']))
  511 |             return send_file(BytesIO(grid_out.read()), as_attachment=True,
  512 |                              download_name=f"{ref}.pdf", mimetype='application/pdf')
  513 |         except Exception:
  514 |             pass
  515 | 
  516 |     if o.get('docx_gridfs_id'):
  517 |         try:
  518 |             grid_out = fs.get(ObjectId(o['docx_gridfs_id']))

   45 | # ── Upload ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

   47 | @documents_bp.route('/upload', methods=['POST'])
   48 | @jwt_required()
   49 | def upload():
   50 |     db  = current_app.db
   51 |     uid = get_jwt_identity()
   52 |     fs  = _get_fs()
   53 | 
   54 |     doc_type     = request.form.get('doc_type', 'other')
   55 |     OPTIONAL_DOCS = {'graduation', 'postgrad', 'experience', 'offer_letter'}
   56 | 
   57 |     if _is_locked(db, uid) and doc_type not in OPTIONAL_DOCS:
   58 |         return jsonify({'error': 'Your documents have been approved. No changes allowed.'}), 403
   59 | 
   60 |     if _submission_status(db, uid) == 'pending_hr':
   61 |         return jsonify({'error': 'Your documents are under HR review. Wait for the result before making changes.'}), 403
   62 | 
   63 |     if 'file' not in request.files:
   64 |         return jsonify({'error': 'No file provided'}), 400
   65 | 
   66 |     file = request.files['file']
   67 |     if not file.filename or not allowed(file.filename):
   68 |         return jsonify({'error': 'Invalid file type'}), 400
   69 | 
   70 |     ext      = file.filename.rsplit('.', 1)[1].lower()
   71 |     filename = f"{uid}_{doc_type}_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}.{ext}"

   74 |     old = db.documents.find_one({'user_id': uid, 'doc_type': doc_type})

   77 |             fs.delete(ObjectId(old['gridfs_id']))
   78 |         except Exception:
   79 |             pass

   81 |     # Save to GridFS

   85 |         filename=filename,
   86 |         user_id=uid,

   89 |         uploaded_at=datetime.utcnow(),

   92 |     rel_path = f"/api/documents/file/{uid}/{filename}"

   94 |     db.documents.update_one(
   95 |         {'user_id': uid, 'doc_type': doc_type},

   97 |             'user_id':     uid,
   98 |             'doc_type':    doc_type,

  100 |             'gridfs_id':   str(gridfs_id),
  101 |             'url':         rel_path,
  102 |             'uploaded_at': datetime.utcnow(),
  103 |             'status':      'uploaded',

  105 |         upsert=True

  297 | @documents_bp.route('/submissions/<sub_id>/action', methods=['POST'])
  298 | @jwt_required()
  299 | def submission_action(sub_id):
  300 |     db  = current_app.db
  301 |     uid = get_jwt_identity()
  302 |     caller = db.users.find_one({'_id': ObjectId(uid)})
  303 |     if not caller or caller.get('role') not in ('hr_head', 'admin', 'hr'):
  304 |         return jsonify({'error': 'Access denied'}), 403
  305 | 
  306 |     data    = request.json or {}
  307 |     action  = data.get('action')
  308 |     remarks = data.get('remarks', '').strip()
  309 | 
  310 |     if action not in ('approve', 'reject'):
  311 |         return jsonify({'error': "action must be 'approve' or 'reject'"}), 400
  312 |     if action == 'reject' and not remarks:
  313 |         return jsonify({'error': 'Rejection remarks are required'}), 400
  314 | 
  315 |     sub = db.doc_submissions.find_one({'_id': ObjectId(sub_id)})
  316 |     if not sub:

  318 |     if sub.get('status') != 'pending_hr':
  319 |         return jsonify({'error': f"Submission is already '{sub.get('status')}'"}), 400
  320 | 
  321 |     new_status = 'approved' if action == 'approve' else 'rejected'
  322 |

  324 |         {'_id': ObjectId(sub_id)},
  325 |         {
  326 |             '$set': {
  327 |                 'status':      new_status,

  329 |                 'reviewed_by': uid,
  330 |                 'reviewed_at': datetime.utcnow(),
  331 |                 'updated_at':  datetime.utcnow(),
  332 |             },
  333 |             '$push': {
  334 |                 'history': {
  335 |                     'action':    action,
  336 |                     'by':        uid,
  337 |                     'by_name':   caller.get('name', ''),
  338 |                     'remarks':   remarks,
  339 |                     'timestamp': datetime.utcnow().isoformat(),
  340 |                 }
  341 |             }
  342 |         }

   33 | @employees_bp.route('/', methods=['GET'])
   34 | @jwt_required()
   35 | def list_employees():
   36 |     db     = current_app.db
   37 |     status = request.args.get('status')
   38 |     query  = {}
   39 |     if status:
   40 |         query['status'] = status
   41 |     
   42 |     all_emps = list(db.employees.find(query).sort('created_at', -1))
   43 |     
   44 |     # Only show employees whose offer letter has reached id_created or beyond
   45 |     VISIBLE_LETTER_STATUSES = {'id_created', 'joined'}
   46 |     
   47 |     visible = []
   48 |     for emp in all_emps:
   49 |         emp_id = str(emp['_id'])
   50 |         # Non-active statuses (exiting, exited, inactive) always show
   51 |         if emp.get('status') != 'active':
   52 |             visible.append(serialize(emp))
   53 |             continue
   54 |         # Active: only show if they have a letter at id_created or joined
   55 |         letter = db.letters.find_one({
   56 |             'employee_id': emp_id,
   57 |             'status': {'$in': list(VISIBLE_LETTER_STATUSES)}
   58 |         })
   59 |         if letter:
   60 |             visible.append(serialize(emp))
   61 |     
   62 |     return jsonify(visible)

   65 | @employees_bp.route('/me/step1', methods=['POST'])

   67 | def save_step1():
   68 |     """
   69 |     Employee submits Step 1 personal info form.
   70 |     Saves full form under step1_data on the employee record,
   71 |     and syncs key fields to root level for the employee card.
   72 |     """
   73 |     db  = current_app.db
   74 |     uid = get_jwt_identity()
   75 | 
   76 |     user = db.users.find_one({'_id': ObjectId(uid)})

  118 | @employees_bp.route('/bulk-upload', methods=['POST'])
  119 | @jwt_required()
  120 | def bulk_upload():
  121 |     db   = current_app.db
  122 |     file = request.files.get('file')
  123 |     if not file:
  124 |         return jsonify({'error': 'No file provided'}), 400
  125 |     content = file.stream.read().decode('utf-8-sig', errors='replace')
  126 |     stream  = io.StringIO(content)
  127 |     reader  = csv.DictReader(stream)
  128 |     employees = []
  129 |     for row in reader:
  130 |         row['employee_id'] = row.get('employee_id') or _next_emp_id(db)
  131 |         row['created_at']  = datetime.utcnow()
  132 |         row['status']      = row.get('status', 'active')
  133 |         employees.append(row)
  134 |     if employees:
  135 |         db.employees.insert_many(employees)
  136 |     return jsonify({'message': f'{len(employees)} employees imported'})

  338 |     db   = current_app.db
  339 |     data = request.json or {}
  340 |     emp  = db.employees.find_one({'_id': ObjectId(emp_id)})
  341 |     if not emp:

  343 | 
  344 |     VALID_KEYS  = {'it_assets', 'finance', 'admin', 'hr_docs', 'access_cards'}
  345 |     updates     = {k: bool(v) for k, v in data.items() if k in VALID_KEYS}
  346 |     if not updates:
  347 |         return jsonify({'error': 'No valid clearance keys provided'}), 400
  348 | 
  349 |     current     = emp.get('clearances', {})
  350 |     merged      = {**current, **updates}
  351 |     all_cleared = all(merged.get(k, False) for k in VALID_KEYS)
  352 |     new_status  = 'clearance_complete' if all_cleared else 'clearance_pending'
  353 | 
  354 |     db.employees.update_one(
  355 |         {'_id': ObjectId(emp_id)},
  356 |         {'$set': {
  357 |             'clearances': merged,
  358 |             'status':     new_status,
  359 |             'updated_at': datetime.utcnow(),
  360 |         }}
  361 |     )
  362 |     return jsonify({'message': 'Clearance updated', 'all_cleared': all_cleared, 'status': new_status})

    1 | """
    2 | exit.py — Full workflow:
    3 |   Employee  → POST /api/exit/resign                     submit resignation
    4 |   Manager   → POST /api/exit/resign                     submit OWN resignation (same route)
    5 |   Manager   → GET  /api/exit/pending-approvals          team pending resignations (excludes self)
    6 |   Manager   → POST /api/exit/<id>/approve-resignation   approve team member (cannot approve self)
    7 |   Manager   → POST /api/exit/<id>/reject-resignation    reject team member (cannot reject self)
    8 |   HR/Admin  → GET  /api/exit/                           all exit pipeline
    9 |   HR/Admin  → POST /api/exit/<id>/clearance             tick clearances
   10 |   HR/Admin  → POST /api/exit/relieving/generate         generate letter (gated)
   11 |   Anyone    → GET  /api/exit/relieving/<id>/download    download letter
   12 |   Employee  → GET  /api/exit/my-status                  own status + letter link
   13 | 
   14 | All files stored in MongoDB GridFS — no local disk dependency.

   56 | def _ordinal(n):
   57 |     if 11 <= (n % 100) <= 13:
   58 |         return 'th'
   59 |     return {1: 'st', 2: 'nd', 3: 'rd'}.get(n % 10, 'th')

   62 | def _fmt_letter_date(date_str):
   63 |     """15th December 2025 — used for the header {{date}} placeholder."""
   64 |     if not date_str:
   65 |         return date_str
   66 |     for fmt in ('%Y-%m-%d', '%d-%m-%Y', '%d/%m/%Y'):
   67 |         try:
   68 |             d = datetime.strptime(str(date_str).strip(), fmt)
   69 |             return f"{d.day}{_ordinal(d.day)} {d.strftime('%B %Y')}"
   70 |         except ValueError:
   71 |             pass
   72 |     return date_str
   73 | 
   74 | 
   75 | def _fmt_dot_date(date_str):
   76 |     """DD.MM.YYYY — used for joining_date / last_working_day / resignation_date."""
   77 |     if not date_str:
   78 |         return date_str
   79 |     for fmt in ('%Y-%m-%d', '%d-%m-%Y', '%d/%m/%Y'):
   80 |         try:
   81 |             d = datetime.strptime(str(date_str).strip(), fmt)
   82 |             return d.strftime('%d.%m.%Y')
   83 |         except ValueError:
   84 |             pass
   85 |     return date_str

📄 FILE #26: backend\routes\leaves.py

    1 | """
    2 | leaves.py — Leave Tracker module (v2: monthly-cap model)
    3 | ===========================================================
    4 | Design (per confirmed rules):
    5 | 
    6 | Leave types: CL, SL, LP, ML (ML is female-only).
    7 | 
    8 | Monthly free quota — checked PER MONTH, no annual running balance, no
    9 | carry-over (this is why there's no accrual job anymore — the cap simply
   10 | applies fresh each month):
   11 | 
   12 |     category        CL/SL pool (per month)   ML pool (per month)
   13 |     regular         2                        n/a
   14 |     probationary    1                        n/a
   15 |     female          2                        1
   16 | 
   17 | Day-level overflow: within a single request, each individual DAY is checked
   18 | against how many free days are left in *that day's* calendar month. Days
   19 | that fit the remaining free quota are recorded as the requested type
   20 | (CL/SL/ML); any day beyond the cap automatically becomes LP. A single
   21 | request can therefore be part-paid / part-LP (e.g. 2 days free left this
   22 | month + a 3-day request -> 2 days CL/SL + 1 day LP).
   23 | 
   24 | LP itself has no cap — it's just logged.
   25 | 
   26 | A live PREVIEW endpoint lets the frontend show the employee the paid/LP
   27 | split (and a warning) before they submit.
   28 | 
   29 | Approval routing is unchanged from v1:
   30 |   employee -> manager -> (HR notified)
   31 |   manager (own request) -> HR Head/Admin -> (HR notified)
   32 |   HR / HR Head: view everything + adjust balances, never approve.
   33 |   HR Head / Admin: additionally decide manager-routed requests.
   34 | """
   35 | 
   36 | from flask import Blueprint, request, jsonify, current_app
   37 | from flask_jwt_extended import jwt_required, get_jwt_identity
   38 | from datetime import datetime, timedelta
   39 | from bson import ObjectId
   40 | 
   41 | leaves_bp = Blueprint('leaves', __name__)
   42 | 
   43 | LEAVE_TYPES = {'CL', 'SL', 'LP', 'ML'}
   44 | POOLED_TYPES = {'CL', 'SL'}     # share the CL/SL monthly pool
   45 | ML_TYPE = 'ML'                  # its own monthly pool, female only
   46 | 
   47 | CATEGORY_RULES = {
   48 |     'regular':      {'monthly_cap': 2, 'ml_monthly_cap': 0},
   49 |     'probationary': {'monthly_cap': 1, 'ml_monthly_cap': 0},
   50 |     'female':       {'monthly_cap': 2, 'ml_monthly_cap': 1},
   51 | }

   58 | def _caller(db, uid):
   59 |     user = db.users.find_one({'_id': ObjectId(uid)})
   60 |     if not user:
   61 |         return None, (jsonify({'error': 'User not found'}), 404)
   62 |     return user, None

   64 | 
   65 | def _s(doc):
   66 |     doc['_id'] = str(doc['_id'])
   67 |     return doc

   69 | 
   70 | def _is_probationary(emp):
   71 |     joining = emp.get('joining_date')
   72 |     months = emp.get('probation_period', 6)
   73 |     if not joining:
   74 |         return False
   75 |     try:
   76 |         months = int(months)
   77 |     except (TypeError, ValueError):
   78 |         months = 6
   79 |     jd = None
   80 |     for fmt in ('%Y-%m-%d', '%d-%m-%Y', '%d/%m/%Y'):
   81 |         try:
   82 |             jd = datetime.strptime(str(joining).strip(), fmt)
   83 |             break
   84 |         except ValueError:
   85 |             continue
   86 |     if not jd:
   87 |         return False
   88 |     probation_end = jd + timedelta(days=30.44 * months)
   89 |     return datetime.now() < probation_end
   90 | 
   91 | 
   92 | def _suggest_category(db, emp, employee_id=None):
   93 |     if _is_probationary(emp):
   94 |         return 'probationary'
   95 |     gender = (emp.get('gender') or '').strip().lower()
   96 |     if not gender and employee_id:
   97 |         user = db.users.find_one({'employee_ref': employee_id})
   98 |         if user:
   99 |             gender = (user.get('gender') or '').strip().lower()
  100 |     if gender == 'female':
  101 |         return 'female'
  102 |     return 'regular'
  103 |

  105 | def _get_or_create_category(db, employee_id, year=None):
  106 |     """One doc per employee per year holding the category + per-month usage
  107 |     counters. No accrual needed — the cap is checked live against actual
  108 |     usage recorded for that specific month."""
  109 |     year = year or datetime.now().year
  110 |     doc = db.leave_balances.find_one({'employee_id': employee_id, 'year': year})
  111 |     if doc:
  112 |         # Defensive migration: a doc created by an earlier schema version
  113 |         # (e.g. the old annual_quota/monthly_credit model) is missing the
  114 |         # v2 fields. Rather than crash, backfill them in place.
  115 |         required = ('monthly_cap', 'ml_monthly_cap', 'monthly_used', 'ml_monthly_used', 'lp_monthly')
  116 |         if not all(k in doc for k in required):
  117 |             category = doc.get('category') or _suggest_category(db, db.employees.find_one({'_id': ObjectId(employee_id)}) or {}, employee_id)
  118 |             rules = CATEGORY_RULES.get(category, CATEGORY_RULES['regular'])
  119 |             patch = {
  120 |                 'category':        category,
  121 |                 'monthly_cap':     doc.get('monthly_cap', rules['monthly_cap']),
  122 |                 'ml_monthly_cap':  doc.get('ml_monthly_cap', rules['ml_monthly_cap']),
  123 |                 'monthly_used':    doc.get('monthly_used') or {str(m): 0 for m in range(1, 13)},
  124 |                 'ml_monthly_used': doc.get('ml_monthly_used') or {str(m): 0 for m in range(1, 13)},
  125 |                 'lp_monthly':      doc.get('lp_monthly') or {str(m): 0 for m in range(1, 13)},
  126 |                 'updated_at':      datetime.utcnow(),
  127 |             }
  128 |             db.leave_balances.update_one({'_id': doc['_id']}, {'$set': patch})
  129 |             doc.update(patch)
  130 |         return doc
  131 | 
  132 |     emp = db.employees.find_one({'_id': ObjectId(employee_id)})
  133 |     if not emp:
  134 |         return None
  135 | 
  136 |     category = _suggest_category(db, emp, employee_id)
  137 |     rules = CATEGORY_RULES[category]
  138 | 
  139 |     doc = {
  140 |         'employee_id':     employee_id,
  141 |         'year':            year,
  142 |         'category':        category,
  143 |         'monthly_cap':     rules['monthly_cap'],
  144 |         'ml_monthly_cap':  rules['ml_monthly_cap'],
  145 |         'monthly_used':    {str(m): 0 for m in range(1, 13)},   # CL/SL pool, per month
  146 |         'ml_monthly_used': {str(m): 0 for m in range(1, 13)},   # ML pool, per month
  147 |         'lp_monthly':      {str(m): 0 for m in range(1, 13)},   # informational only
  148 |         'manually_set':    False,
  149 |         'created_at':      datetime.utcnow(),
  150 |         'updated_at':      datetime.utcnow(),
  151 |     }
  152 |     result = db.leave_balances.insert_one(doc)
  153 |     doc['_id'] = result.inserted_id
  154 |     return doc
  155 | 
  156 | 
  157 | def _date_range(from_date, to_date):
  158 |     f = datetime.strptime(from_date, '%Y-%m-%d')
  159 |     t = datetime.strptime(to_date, '%Y-%m-%d')
  160 |     days = []
  161 |     d = f
  162 |     while d <= t:
  163 |         days.append(d)
  164 |         d += timedelta(days=1)
  165 |     return days
  166 | 
  167 | 
  168 | def _compute_split(cat_doc, leave_type, from_date, to_date):
  169 |     """Day-by-day: for each day, spend from that day's month's remaining free
  170 |     quota (CL/SL pool or ML pool); anything left over becomes LP for that day.
  171 |     Returns (paid_days, lp_days, month_breakdown) where month_breakdown is a
  172 |     list of {year, month, paid, lp} so approval can credit the right buckets.
  173 |     Does NOT mutate cat_doc — this is also used for the pre-submit preview."""
  174 |     if leave_type == 'LP':
  175 |         days = _date_range(from_date, to_date)
  176 |         return 0, len(days), []
  177 | 
  178 |     is_ml = (leave_type == ML_TYPE)
  179 |     cap = cat_doc['ml_monthly_cap'] if is_ml else cat_doc['monthly_cap']
  180 |     used_map = cat_doc['ml_monthly_used'] if is_ml else cat_doc['monthly_used']
  181 | 
  182 |     running_used = dict(used_map)
  183 | 
  184 |     days = _date_range(from_date, to_date)
  185 |     by_month = {}
  186 |     for d in days:
  187 |         key = (d.year, d.month)
  188 |         month_str = str(d.month)
  189 |         remaining = cap - running_used.get(month_str, 0)
  190 |         by_month.setdefault(key, {'paid': 0, 'lp': 0})
  191 |         if remaining > 0:
  192 |             running_used[month_str] = running_used.get(month_str, 0) + 1
  193 |             by_month[key]['paid'] += 1
  194 |         else:
  195 |             by_month[key]['lp'] += 1
  196 | 
  197 |     month_breakdown = [
  198 |         {'year': y, 'month': m, 'paid': v['paid'], 'lp': v['lp']}
  199 |         for (y, m), v in sorted(by_month.items())
  200 |     ]
  201 |     total_paid = sum(v['paid'] for v in by_month.values())
  202 |     total_lp = sum(v['lp'] for v in by_month.values())
  203 |     return total_paid, total_lp, month_breakdown
  204 | 
  205 | 
  206 | def _apply_month_breakdown(db, cat_doc_id, leave_type, month_breakdown):
  207 |     is_ml = (leave_type == ML_TYPE)
  208 |     field = 'ml_monthly_used' if is_ml else 'monthly_used'
  209 |     lp_field = 'lp_monthly'
  210 |     inc = {}
  211 |     for entry in month_breakdown:
  212 |         m = str(entry['month'])
  213 |         if entry['paid']:
  214 |             inc[f'{field}.{m}'] = inc.get(f'{field}.{m}', 0) + entry['paid']
  215 |         if entry['lp']:
  216 |             inc[f'{lp_field}.{m}'] = inc.get(f'{lp_field}.{m}', 0) + entry['lp']
  217 |     if inc:
  218 |         db.leave_balances.update_one({'_id': cat_doc_id}, {'$inc': inc, '$set': {'updated_at': datetime.utcnow()}})
  219 | 
  220 | 
  221 | def _notify_hr(db, message, link='', related_id=None):
  222 |     db.leave_notifications.insert_one({
  223 |         'target_role': 'hr', 'message': message, 'link': link,
  224 |         'related_id': related_id, 'read': False, 'created_at': datetime.utcnow(),
  225 |     })
  226 | 
  227 | 
  228 | def _enrich_request(r, db):
  229 |     r['_id'] = str(r['_id'])
  230 |     try:
  231 |         emp = db.employees.find_one({'_id': ObjectId(r.get('employee_id', ''))})
  232 |         r['employee_name'] = emp.get('name', 'Unknown') if emp else 'Unknown'
  233 |         r['employee_code'] = emp.get('employee_id', '') if emp else ''
  234 |         r['department']    = emp.get('department', '') if emp else ''
  235 |     except Exception:
  236 |         r['employee_name'], r['employee_code'], r['department'] = 'Unknown', '', ''
  237 |     return r
  238 | 
  239 | 
  240 | def _this_year_summary(cat_doc, lp_used_this_year):
  241 |     monthly_cap = cat_doc['monthly_cap']
  242 |     ml_cap = cat_doc['ml_monthly_cap']
  243 |     used = sum(cat_doc['monthly_used'].values())
  244 |     ml_used = sum(cat_doc['ml_monthly_used'].values())
  245 |     now = datetime.now()
  246 |     this_month = str(now.month)
  247 |     return {
  248 |         'category':          cat_doc['category'],
  249 |         'monthly_cap':        monthly_cap,
  250 |         'used_this_year':     used,
  251 |         'annual_quota':       monthly_cap * 12,
  252 |         'available_this_year': monthly_cap * 12 - used,
  253 |         'used_this_month':    cat_doc['monthly_used'].get(this_month, 0),
  254 |         'available_this_month': max(0, monthly_cap - cat_doc['monthly_used'].get(this_month, 0)),
  255 |         'ml_monthly_cap':     ml_cap,
  256 |         'ml_used_this_year':  ml_used,
  257 |         'ml_available_this_year': (ml_cap * 12 - ml_used) if ml_cap else None,
  258 |         'ml_used_this_month': cat_doc['ml_monthly_used'].get(this_month, 0),
  259 |         'ml_available_this_month': (max(0, ml_cap - cat_doc['ml_monthly_used'].get(this_month, 0)) if ml_cap else None),
  260 |         'lp_days_taken':      lp_used_this_year,
  261 |     }
  262 |

   40 | def calculate_ctc_breakdown(annual_ctc, avail_pf=True, ghi_annual=0.0, metro=False):
   41 |     ctc          = float(annual_ctc)
   42 |     basic_a      = round(ctc * 0.50)
   43 |     basic_m      = round(basic_a / 12)
   44 |     hra_a        = round(basic_a * (0.50 if metro else 0.40))
   45 |     hra_m        = round(hra_a / 12)
   46 |     da_a         = round(basic_a * 0.20)
   47 |     da_m         = round(da_a / 12)
   48 |     pf_m         = 1800 if avail_pf else 0
   49 |     pf_a         = pf_m * 12
   50 |     ghi_a        = round(float(ghi_annual or 0))
   51 |     ghi_m        = round(ghi_a / 12)
   52 |     other_a      = max(0, int(ctc) - basic_a - hra_a - da_a - pf_a - ghi_a)
   53 |     other_m      = round(other_a / 12)
   54 |     gross_m      = basic_m + hra_m + da_m + other_m
   55 |     net_a        = basic_a + hra_a + da_a + other_a
   56 |     return {
   57 |         'ctc': ctc, 'basic': basic_a, 'hra': hra_a, 'da': da_a,
   58 |         'employer_pf': pf_a, 'ghi': ghi_a, 'other_allowances': other_a,
   59 |         'net_annual': net_a, 'gross_monthly': gross_m,
   60 |         'basic_monthly': basic_m, 'hra_monthly': hra_m, 'da_monthly': da_m,
   61 |         'employer_pf_monthly': pf_m, 'ghi_monthly': ghi_m,
   62 |         'other_allowances_monthly': other_m,
   63 |         'avail_pf': avail_pf, 'metro': metro,
   64 |     }
   65 | 
   66 |

  159 | def _get_template_path(tmpl, tmp_dir):
  160 |     """Write template to a temp file and return its path.
  161 |     Supports both GridFS-stored templates (new) and disk-stored templates (legacy)."""
  162 |     path = os.path.join(tmp_dir, tmpl.get('filename', 'template.docx'))
  163 | 
  164 |     if tmpl.get('gridfs_id'):
  165 |         # New: fetch from GridFS
  166 |         fs = gridfs.GridFS(current_app.db, collection='templates_fs')
  167 |         grid_out = fs.get(ObjectId(tmpl['gridfs_id']))
  168 |         with open(path, 'wb') as f:
  169 |             f.write(grid_out.read())
  170 |         return path
  171 | 
  172 |     elif tmpl.get('file_path') and os.path.exists(tmpl['file_path']):
  173 |         # Legacy: file still on disk
  174 |         return tmpl['file_path']
  175 | 
  176 |     else:
  177 |         raise ValueError(
  178 |             f"Template '{tmpl.get('name', 'unknown')}' has no accessible file. "
  179 |             "Please re-upload the template."
  180 |         )
  181 | 
  182 | 
  183 | def _gen_files(emp, tmpl, ctx, db, emp_id, app):
  184 |     ver  = _next_version(db, emp_id)
  185 |     year = datetime.now().strftime('%Y')
  186 |     out  = os.path.join(app.config['STORAGE_ROOT'], 'letters', year)
  187 |     os.makedirs(out, exist_ok=True)
  188 |     base = f"{emp.get('employee_id', emp_id)}_offer_v{ver}"
  189 |     dp   = os.path.join(out, base + '.docx')
  190 |     pp   = os.path.join(out, base + '.pdf')
  191 | 
  192 |     # Get template from GridFS to temp file
  193 |     tmpl_path = _get_template_path(tmpl, out)
  194 |     generate_letter_docx(tmpl_path, ctx, dp)
  195 |     pr = generate_letter_pdf(dp, pp)
  196 | 
  197 |     # Save to GridFS
  198 |     docx_gid = save_file_to_gridfs(dp, base + '.docx')
  199 |     pdf_gid  = save_file_to_gridfs(pr, base + '.pdf') if pr else None
  200 | 
  201 |     return ver, dp, pr, docx_gid, pdf_gid

  251 | def preview_pdf(lid):
  252 |     db = current_app.db
  253 |     letter = db.letters.find_one({'_id': ObjectId(lid)})
  254 |     if not letter:
  255 |         return jsonify({'error': 'Not found'}), 404
  256 | 
  257 |     # Serve from GridFS if available
  258 |     if letter.get('pdf_gridfs_id'):
  259 |         return serve_from_gridfs(
  260 |             letter['pdf_gridfs_id'],
  261 |             download_name=os.path.basename(letter.get('pdf_path', 'letter.pdf')),
  262 |             mimetype='application/pdf',
  263 |             as_attachment=False,
  264 |         )
  265 | 
  266 |     # Fallback: disk
  267 |     pdf_path  = letter.get('pdf_path')
  268 |     docx_path = letter.get('docx_path')
  269 | 
  270 |     if pdf_path and os.path.exists(pdf_path):
  271 |         if docx_path and os.path.exists(docx_path):
  272 |             if os.path.getmtime(docx_path) <= os.path.getmtime(pdf_path):
  273 |                 return send_file(pdf_path, mimetype='application/pdf')
  274 |         else:
  275 |             return send_file(pdf_path, mimetype='application/pdf')
  276 | 
  277 |     if docx_path and os.path.exists(docx_path):
  278 |         out_pdf = docx_path.replace('.docx', '_preview.pdf')
  279 |         result  = generate_letter_pdf(docx_path, out_pdf)
  280 |         if result and os.path.exists(result):
  281 |             gid = save_file_to_gridfs(result, os.path.basename(result))
  282 |             db.letters.update_one(
  283 |                 {'_id': ObjectId(lid)},
  284 |                 {'$set': {'pdf_path': result, 'pdf_gridfs_id': gid, 'updated_at': datetime.utcnow()}}
  285 |             )
  286 |             return send_file(result, mimetype='application/pdf')
  287 |         log.warning(f'PDF generation failed for letter {lid} - serving DOCX fallback')
  288 |         return jsonify({
  289 |             'error': 'pdf_unavailable',
  290 |             'docx_url': f'/api/letters/{lid}/download?format=docx',
  291 |         }), 202
  292 | 
  293 |     if docx_path and not os.path.exists(docx_path):
  294 |         # Try GridFS
  295 |         if letter.get('docx_gridfs_id'):
  296 |             return serve_from_gridfs(
  297 |                 letter['docx_gridfs_id'],
  298 |                 download_name=os.path.basename(docx_path),
  299 |                 mimetype='application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document',
  300 |                 as_attachment=False,
  301 |             )
  302 |         return jsonify({'error': f'DOCX file missing: {docx_path}'}), 404

  304 |     return jsonify({'error': 'No document available for preview - regenerate the letter'}), 404

  408 | def _format_acceptance_date(date_str):
  409 |     try:
  410 |         for fmt in ('%Y-%m-%d', '%d-%m-%Y', '%d/%m/%Y'):
  411 |             try:
  412 |                 dt = datetime.strptime(date_str, fmt)
  413 |                 break
  414 |             except ValueError:
  415 |                 continue
  416 |         else:
  417 |             return date_str
  418 |         day = dt.day
  419 |         if 11 <= day <= 13:
  420 |             suffix = 'th'
  421 |         else:
  422 |             suffix = {1: 'st', 2: 'nd', 3: 'rd'}.get(day % 10, 'th')
  423 |         return f"{day}{suffix} {dt.strftime('%B %Y')}"
  424 |     except Exception:
  425 |         return date_str

  722 | @letters_bp.route('/<lid>/docx-to-html', methods=['GET'])
  723 | @jwt_required()
  724 | def docx_to_html(lid):
  725 |     db = current_app.db
  726 |     letter = db.letters.find_one({'_id': ObjectId(lid)})
  727 |     if not letter:
  728 |         return jsonify({'error': 'Not found'}), 404
  729 | 
  730 |     docx_path = letter.get('docx_path')
  731 |     # If disk file missing, restore from GridFS
  732 |     if (not docx_path or not os.path.exists(docx_path)) and letter.get('docx_gridfs_id'):
  733 |         tmp = tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix='.docx', delete=False)
  734 |         fs = gridfs.GridFS(current_app.db, collection='files_fs')
  735 |         grid_out = fs.get(ObjectId(letter['docx_gridfs_id']))
  736 |         tmp.write(grid_out.read())
  737 |         tmp.flush()
  738 |         docx_path = tmp.name
  739 | 
  740 |     if not docx_path or not os.path.exists(docx_path):
  741 |         return jsonify({'error': 'DOCX not found'}), 404
  742 | 
  743 |     try:
  744 |         doc = DocxDocument(docx_path)
  745 |         blocks = []
  746 |         for i, para in enumerate(doc.paragraphs):
  747 |             blocks.append({
  748 |                 'id':    f'p_{i}',
  749 |                 'type':  'para',
  750 |                 'text':  para.text,
  751 |                 'style': para.style.name if para.style else 'Normal',
  752 |                 'bold':  any(r.bold for r in para.runs if r.text.strip()),
  753 |                 'align': str(para.alignment) if para.alignment else 'LEFT',
  754 |             })
  755 |         for ti, table in enumerate(doc.tables):
  756 |             for ri, row in enumerate(table.rows):
  757 |                 for ci, cell in enumerate(row.cells):
  758 |                     blocks.append({
  759 |                         'id':    f't_{ti}_r_{ri}_c_{ci}',
  760 |                         'type':  'cell',
  761 |                         'text':  cell.text,
  762 |                         'table': ti, 'row': ri, 'col': ci,
  763 |                         'bold':  False,
  764 |                     })
  765 |         return jsonify({'blocks': blocks})
  766 |     except Exception as e:
  767 |         return jsonify({'error': str(e)}), 500
  768 |

  770 | @letters_bp.route('/<lid>/save-html', methods=['POST'])
  771 | @jwt_required()
  772 | def save_html(lid):
  773 |     db = current_app.db
  774 |     letter = db.letters.find_one({'_id': ObjectId(lid)})
  775 |     if not letter:
  776 |         return jsonify({'error': 'Not found'}), 404
  777 |     if letter.get('status') not in ('draft', 'rejected'):
  778 |         return jsonify({'error': 'Only draft or rejected letters can be edited'}), 400
  779 | 
  780 |     docx_path = letter.get('docx_path')
  781 |     if not docx_path or not os.path.exists(docx_path):
  782 |         return jsonify({'error': 'DOCX not found'}), 404
  783 | 
  784 |     data    = request.json or {}
  785 |     changes = { b['id']: b['text'] for b in data.get('blocks', []) }
  786 |     if not changes:
  787 |         return jsonify({'message': 'Nothing changed'}), 200
  788 | 
  789 |     try:
  790 |         doc = DocxDocument(docx_path)
  791 |         for i, para in enumerate(doc.paragraphs):
  792 |             bid = f'p_{i}'
  793 |             if bid not in changes: continue
  794 |             new_text = changes[bid]
  795 |             if para.text == new_text: continue
  796 |             if not para.runs: continue
  797 |             para.runs[0].text = new_text
  798 |             for r in para.runs[1:]: r.text = ''
  799 |         for ti, table in enumerate(doc.tables):
  800 |             for ri, row in enumerate(table.rows):
  801 |                 for ci, cell in enumerate(row.cells):
  802 |                     bid = f't_{ti}_r_{ri}_c_{ci}'
  803 |                     if bid not in changes: continue
  804 |                     new_text = changes[bid]
  805 |                     if cell.text == new_text: continue
  806 |                     if cell.paragraphs and cell.paragraphs[0].runs:
  807 |                         cell.paragraphs[0].runs[0].text = new_text
  808 |                         for r in cell.paragraphs[0].runs[1:]: r.text = ''
  809 |                     elif cell.paragraphs:
  810 |                         cell.paragraphs[0].text = new_text
  811 |         doc.save(docx_path)
  812 | 
  813 |         pdf_path = letter.get('pdf_path') or docx_path.replace('.docx', '.pdf')
  814 |         pr = generate_letter_pdf(docx_path, pdf_path)
  815 | 
  816 |         # Update GridFS
  817 |         docx_gid = save_file_to_gridfs(docx_path, os.path.basename(docx_path))
  818 |         pdf_gid  = save_file_to_gridfs(pr, os.path.basename(pr)) if pr else letter.get('pdf_gridfs_id')
  819 | 
  820 |         db.letters.update_one({'_id': ObjectId(lid)}, {'$set': {
  821 |             'pdf_path': pr, 'docx_gridfs_id': docx_gid, 'pdf_gridfs_id': pdf_gid,
  822 |             'updated_at': datetime.utcnow(),
  823 |         }})
  824 |         return jsonify({'message': 'Saved successfully', 'has_pdf': pr is not None})
  825 |     except Exception as e:
  826 |         log.error(f'save_html error: {e}')
  827 |         return jsonify({'error': str(e)}), 500

  855 | @letters_bp.route('/<lid>/save-content', methods=['POST'])
  856 | @jwt_required()
  857 | def save_content(lid):
  858 |     db = current_app.db
  859 |     letter = db.letters.find_one({'_id': ObjectId(lid)})
  860 |     if not letter:
  861 |         return jsonify({'error': 'Not found'}), 404
  862 |     if letter.get('status') not in ('draft', 'rejected'):
  863 |         return jsonify({'error': 'Only draft or rejected letters can be edited'}), 400

  865 |     docx_path = letter.get('docx_path')

 1027 | def _embed_signature_in_pdf(pdf_path: str, signature_b64: str) -> str:
 1028 |     try:
 1029 |         from pypdf import PdfWriter, PdfReader
 1030 |         from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas as rl_canvas
 1031 |         from PIL import Image
 1032 | 
 1033 |         header, _, b64data = signature_b64.partition(',')
 1034 |         img_bytes = base64.b64decode(b64data if b64data else signature_b64)
 1035 |         img = Image.open(io.BytesIO(img_bytes)).convert('RGBA')
 1036 | 
 1037 |         data = img.getdata()
 1038 |         new_data = []
 1039 |         for r, g, b, a in data:
 1040 |             if r > 230 and g > 230 and b > 230:
 1041 |                 new_data.append((r, g, b, 0))
 1042 |             else:
 1043 |                 new_data.append((r, g, b, a))
 1044 |         img.putdata(new_data)
 1045 | 
 1046 |         png_buf = io.BytesIO()
 1047 |         img.save(png_buf, format='PNG')
 1048 |         png_buf.seek(0)
 1049 | 
 1050 |         reader = PdfReader(pdf_path)
 1051 |         last_page = reader.pages[-1]
 1052 |         page_w = float(last_page.mediabox.width)
 1053 |         page_h = float(last_page.mediabox.height)
 1054 | 
 1055 |         sig_w_pt = 4 * 28.35
 1056 |         aspect   = img.width / img.height if img.height else 1
 1057 |         sig_h_pt = sig_w_pt / aspect
 1058 |         if sig_h_pt > 2.5 * 28.35:
 1059 |             sig_h_pt = 2.5 * 28.35
 1060 |             sig_w_pt = sig_h_pt * aspect
 1061 | 
 1062 |         sig_x = page_w - sig_w_pt - 2 * 28.35
 1063 |         sig_y = 2.5 * 28.35
 1064 | 
 1065 |         overlay_buf = io.BytesIO()
 1066 |         c = rl_canvas.Canvas(overlay_buf, pagesize=(page_w, page_h))
 1067 |         tmp_png = tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix='.png', delete=False)
 1068 |         tmp_png.write(png_buf.read())
 1069 |         tmp_png.flush()
 1070 |         c.drawImage(tmp_png.name, sig_x, sig_y, sig_w_pt, sig_h_pt, mask='auto')
 1071 |         c.save()
 1072 |         tmp_png.close()
 1073 |         os.unlink(tmp_png.name)
 1074 |         overlay_buf.seek(0)
 1075 | 
 1076 |         overlay_reader = PdfReader(overlay_buf)
 1077 |         writer = PdfWriter()
 1078 |         for i, page in enumerate(reader.pages):
 1079 |             if i == len(reader.pages) - 1:
 1080 |                 page.merge_page(overlay_reader.pages[0])
 1081 |             writer.add_page(page)
 1082 | 
 1083 |         signed_path = pdf_path.replace('.pdf', '_signed.pdf')
 1084 |         with open(signed_path, 'wb') as out:
 1085 |             writer.write(out)
 1086 |         return signed_path
 1087 | 
 1088 |     except ImportError as e:
 1089 |         log.warning(f'Signature embedding skipped missing library: {e}')
 1090 |         return pdf_path
 1091 |     except Exception as e:
 1092 |         log.warning(f'Signature embedding failed: {e}')
 1093 |         return pdf_path

   18 | def extract_placeholders_from_bytes(data):
   19 |     doc  = Document(BytesIO(data))
   20 |     text = '\n'.join(p.text for p in doc.paragraphs)
   21 |     for table in doc.tables:
   22 |         for row in table.rows:
   23 |             for cell in row.cells:
   24 |                 text += '\n' + cell.text
   25 |     return sorted(set(re.findall(r'\{\{(\w+)\}\}', text)))
