    1 | """
    2 | scheduler.py — Daily birthday and work anniversary email sender
    3 | Runs as a background thread started when Flask app boots.
    4 | Checks every day at 09:00 AM server time for:
    5 |   - Employees whose birthday is today → sends birthday wish
    6 |   - Employees whose joining_date anniversary is today → sends work anniversary wish
    7 | """
    8 | 
    9 | import threading
   10 | import time
   11 | import logging
   12 | import os
   13 | import smtplib
   14 | from datetime import datetime, date, timedelta
   15 | from email.mime.text import MIMEText
   16 | from email.mime.multipart import MIMEMultipart
   17 | 
   18 | log = logging.getLogger(__name__)
   19 | 
   20 | 
   21 | def _send_email(to_email: str, subject: str, body: str):
   22 |     smtp_host = os.getenv('SMTP_HOST', '')
   23 |     smtp_user = os.getenv('SMTP_USER', '')
   24 |     smtp_pass = os.getenv('SMTP_PASS', '')
   25 |     smtp_port = int(os.getenv('SMTP_PORT', 587))
   26 |     from_addr = os.getenv('SMTP_FROM') or smtp_user
   27 |     company   = os.getenv('COMPANY_NAME', 'Infopace Management Pvt Ltd')
   28 | 
   29 |     if not smtp_host or not smtp_user:
   30 |         log.warning('Scheduler: SMTP not configured — skipping email to %s', to_email)
   31 |         return False
   32 | 
   33 |     try:
   34 |         msg = MIMEMultipart()
   35 |         msg['From']    = f'{company} HR <{from_addr}>'
   36 |         msg['To']      = to_email
   37 |         msg['Subject'] = subject
   38 |         msg.attach(MIMEText(body, 'plain'))
   39 | 
   40 |         with smtplib.SMTP(smtp_host, smtp_port) as s:
   41 |             s.ehlo(); s.starttls(); s.ehlo()
   42 |             s.login(smtp_user, smtp_pass)
   43 |             s.sendmail(from_addr, to_email, msg.as_string())
   44 | 
   45 |         log.info('Scheduler: email sent to %s — %s', to_email, subject)
   46 |         return True
   47 | 
   48 |     except Exception as e:
   49 |         log.error('Scheduler: email failed to %s — %s', to_email, e)
   50 |         return False
   51 | 
   52 | 
   53 | def _parse_date(d_str: str):
   54 |     if not d_str or not isinstance(d_str, str):
   55 |         return None
   56 |     d_str = d_str.strip()
   57 |     for fmt in ('%Y-%m-%d', '%d-%m-%Y', '%d/%m/%Y'):
   58 |         try:
   59 |             return datetime.strptime(d_str, fmt)
   60 |         except ValueError:
   61 |             continue
   62 |     return None
   63 | 
   64 | 
   65 | def _years_completed(join_dt: datetime, today: date) -> int:
   66 |     years = today.year - join_dt.year
   67 |     if (today.month, today.day) < (join_dt.month, join_dt.day):
   68 |         years -= 1
   69 |     return years
   70 | 
   71 | 
   72 | def _ordinal(n: int) -> str:
   73 |     if 11 <= n % 100 <= 13:
   74 |         return f'{n}th'
   75 |     return f'{n}{["th","st","nd","rd","th","th","th","th","th","th"][n % 10]}'
   76 | 
   77 | 
   78 | def _birthday_body(name: str, company: str) -> str:
   79 |     return f"""Dear {name},
   80 | 
   81 | Wishing you a very Happy Birthday! 🎂
   82 | 
   83 | On behalf of everyone at {company}, we hope your special day is filled with joy, laughter, and wonderful memories.
   84 | 
   85 | Your dedication and hard work are truly appreciated. We are grateful to have you as part of our team and look forward to celebrating many more milestones together.
   86 | 
   87 | Warm wishes,
   88 | HR Team
   89 | {company}
   90 | """
   91 | 
   92 | 
   93 | def _anniversary_body(name: str, years: int, company: str) -> str:
   94 |     ordinal = _ordinal(years)
   95 |     return f"""Dear {name},
   96 | 
   97 | Congratulations on completing your {ordinal} work anniversary at {company}! 🎉
   98 | 
   99 | {years} year{'s' if years > 1 else ''} of dedication, growth, and contribution — thank you for being such a valued member of our team.
  100 | 
  101 | Your efforts make a real difference every day, and we look forward to many more successful years together.
  102 | 
  103 | With appreciation,
  104 | HR Team
  105 | {company}
  106 | """
  107 | 
  108 | 
  109 | def run_daily_checks(app):
  110 |     company = os.getenv('COMPANY_NAME', 'Infopace Management Pvt Ltd')
  111 | 
  112 |     while True:
  113 |         now    = datetime.now()
  114 |         target = now.replace(hour=9, minute=0, second=0, microsecond=0)
  115 | 
  116 |         if now >= target:
  117 |             # Already past 9 AM — schedule for tomorrow using timedelta (safe for month-end)
  118 |             target = target + timedelta(days=1)
  119 | 
  120 |         wait_seconds = (target - now).total_seconds()
  121 |         log.info('Scheduler: next run in %.0f seconds (at %s)', wait_seconds, target)
  122 |         time.sleep(wait_seconds)
  123 | 
  124 |         today = date.today()
  125 |         log.info('Scheduler: running daily checks for %s', today)
  126 | 
  127 |         try:
  128 |             with app.app_context():
  129 |                 db = app.db
  130 | 
  131 |                 users = list(db.users.find({
  132 |                     'is_active': {'$ne': False},
  133 |                     'employee_ref': {'$exists': True, '$ne': ''},
  134 |                 }))
  135 | 
  136 |                 sent_birthday    = 0
  137 |                 sent_anniversary = 0
  138 | 
  139 |                 for user in users:
  140 |                     work_email = user.get('email', '')
  141 |                     name       = user.get('name', 'Team Member')
  142 |                     emp_ref    = user.get('employee_ref')
  143 | 
  144 |                     if not work_email:
  145 |                         continue
  146 | 
  147 |                     try:
  148 |                         from bson import ObjectId
  149 |                         emp = db.employees.find_one({'_id': ObjectId(emp_ref)})
  150 |                     except Exception:
  151 |                         emp = None
  152 | 
  153 |                     if not emp:
  154 |                         continue
  155 | 
  156 |                     # ── Birthday check ────────────────────────────────────
  157 |                     # Checks user.birthday → emp.birthday → emp.date_of_birth (set by Step 1 form)
  158 |                     bday_str = (user.get('birthday')
  159 |                                 or emp.get('birthday')
  160 |                                 or emp.get('date_of_birth', ''))
  161 |                     bday_dt = _parse_date(bday_str)
  162 |                     if bday_dt and bday_dt.month == today.month and bday_dt.day == today.day:
  163 |                         sent = _send_email(
  164 |                             to_email=work_email,
  165 |                             subject=f'Happy Birthday, {name.split()[0]}! 🎂',
  166 |                             body=_birthday_body(name, company),
  167 |                         )
  168 |                         if sent:
  169 |                             sent_birthday += 1
  170 |                             db.scheduler_log.insert_one({
  171 |                                 'type': 'birthday', 'user_id': str(user['_id']),
  172 |                                 'to_email': work_email, 'name': name,
  173 |                                 'sent_at': datetime.utcnow(), 'date': today.isoformat(),
  174 |                             })
  175 | 
  176 |                     # ── Work anniversary check ────────────────────────────
  177 |                     join_str = emp.get('joining_date', '')
  178 |                     join_dt  = _parse_date(join_str)
  179 |                     if join_dt and join_dt.month == today.month and join_dt.day == today.day:
  180 |                         years = _years_completed(join_dt, today)
  181 |                         if years >= 1:
  182 |                             sent = _send_email(
  183 |                                 to_email=work_email,
  184 |                                 subject=f'Happy {_ordinal(years)} Work Anniversary, {name.split()[0]}! 🎉',
  185 |                                 body=_anniversary_body(name, years, company),
  186 |                             )
  187 |                             if sent:
  188 |                                 sent_anniversary += 1
  189 |                                 db.scheduler_log.insert_one({
  190 |                                     'type': 'anniversary', 'user_id': str(user['_id']),
  191 |                                     'to_email': work_email, 'name': name, 'years': years,
  192 |                                     'sent_at': datetime.utcnow(), 'date': today.isoformat(),
  193 |                                 })
  194 | 
  195 |                 log.info('Scheduler: done — %d birthday, %d anniversary emails sent',
  196 |                          sent_birthday, sent_anniversary)
  197 | 
  198 |         except Exception as e:
  199 |             log.error('Scheduler: daily check failed — %s', e)
  200 | 
  201 |         # Safety sleep before recalculating next target
  202 |         time.sleep(60)
  203 | 
  204 | def run_checks_now(app):
  205 |     """Test function — runs the daily check immediately and returns a summary."""
  206 |     from datetime import date
  207 |     from bson import ObjectId
  208 |     
  209 |     today = date.today()
  210 |     company = os.getenv('COMPANY_NAME', 'Infopace Management Pvt Ltd')
  211 |     results = []
  212 | 
  213 |     with app.app_context():
  214 |         db = app.db
  215 |         users = list(db.users.find({
  216 |             'is_active': {'$ne': False},
  217 |             'employee_ref': {'$exists': True, '$ne': ''},
  218 |         }))
  219 | 
  220 |         for user in users:
  221 |             work_email = user.get('email', '')
  222 |             name = user.get('name', '')
  223 |             emp_ref = user.get('employee_ref')
  224 |             try:
  225 |                 emp = db.employees.find_one({'_id': ObjectId(emp_ref)})
  226 |             except Exception:
  227 |                 emp = None
  228 |             if not emp:
  229 |                 continue
  230 | 
  231 |             bday_str = user.get('birthday') or emp.get('birthday') or emp.get('date_of_birth', '')
  232 |             bday_dt  = _parse_date(bday_str)
  233 |             join_str = emp.get('joining_date', '')
  234 |             join_dt  = _parse_date(join_str)
  235 | 
  236 |             results.append({
  237 |                 'name':          name,
  238 |                 'email':         work_email,
  239 |                 'birthday':      bday_str,
  240 |                 'bday_match':    bool(bday_dt and bday_dt.month == today.month and bday_dt.day == today.day),
  241 |                 'joining_date':  join_str,
  242 |                 'anniv_match':   bool(join_dt and join_dt.month == today.month and join_dt.day == today.day),
  243 |             })
  244 | 
  245 |     return {'today': today.isoformat(), 'checked': len(results), 'employees': results}

    1 | """
    2 | letter_generator.py
    3 | ───────────────────
    4 | Generates filled DOCX from a template by replacing {{placeholders}}.
    5 | 
    6 | Key behaviours:
    7 |   • Run-by-run replacement preserves bold/italic/font/size/color on every run
    8 |   • Handles split placeholders — Word sometimes splits {{key}} across multiple
    9 |     runs at the XML level. We detect this, consolidate, then replace.
   10 |   • Handles embedded \n in values — splits into multiple <w:br/> so line
   11 |     breaks render correctly inside table cells (wages field etc.)
   12 |   • IMAGE placeholders — {{hr_signature}} and {{chairman_signature}} are
   13 |     replaced with actual images (base64 PNG from the frontend).
   14 |     The placeholder paragraph is replaced in-place with an image run,
   15 |     preserving the paragraph's position in the document.
   16 |   • All table alignment, paragraph spacing, column widths, page margins are
   17 |     NEVER touched — template formatting is preserved 100%.
   18 | """
   19 | 
   20 | import os
   21 | import io
   22 | import re
   23 | import base64
   24 | import subprocess
   25 | import shutil
   26 | import platform
   27 | import logging
   28 | import tempfile
   29 | from copy import deepcopy
   30 | 
   31 | from docx import Document
   32 | from docx.oxml.ns import qn
   33 | from docx.oxml import OxmlElement
   34 | from docx.shared import Inches, Pt
   35 | from docx.enum.text import WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH
   36 | 
   37 | logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
   38 | 
   39 | # Keys that carry image data (base64 PNG strings)
   40 | IMAGE_PLACEHOLDER_KEYS = {'hr_signature', 'chairman_signature'}
   41 | 
   42 | # Width in inches for each signature image in the document
   43 | SIGNATURE_WIDTH_INCHES = 0.5  # ~4cm — professional, not oversized
   44 | 
   45 | 
   46 | # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   47 | # XML helpers
   48 | # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   49 | 
   50 | def _get_rpr(run_elem):
   51 |     """Return the <w:rPr> element of a run, or None."""
   52 |     return run_elem.find(qn('w:rPr'))
   53 | 
   54 | 
   55 | def _set_run_text_with_breaks(run_elem, text):
   56 |     """
   57 |     Replace the text content of a run element.
   58 |     Converts embedded \n into <w:br/> so line-breaks render in DOCX cells.
   59 |     Preserves the run's existing <w:rPr> formatting node.
   60 |     """
   61 |     to_remove = [
   62 |         c for c in list(run_elem)
   63 |         if c.tag in (qn('w:t'), qn('w:br'))
   64 |     ]
   65 |     for c in to_remove:
   66 |         run_elem.remove(c)
   67 | 
   68 |     lines = str(text).split('\n')
   69 |     for i, line in enumerate(lines):
   70 |         t = OxmlElement('w:t')
   71 |         t.text = line
   72 |         if line.startswith(' ') or line.endswith(' '):
   73 |             t.set('{http://www.w3.org/XML/1998/namespace}space', 'preserve')
   74 |         run_elem.append(t)
   75 |         if i < len(lines) - 1:
   76 |             br = OxmlElement('w:br')
   77 |             run_elem.append(br)
   78 | 
   79 | 
   80 | # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   81 | # Image placeholder replacement
   82 | # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   83 | 
   84 | def _b64_to_png_bytes(b64_string: str) -> bytes:
   85 |     """
   86 |     Decode a base64 image string (with or without data-URI header) → raw bytes.
   87 |     Also removes near-white background pixels (makes drawn signatures transparent).
   88 |     """
   89 |     from PIL import Image, ImageEnhance
   90 | 
   91 |     # Strip data-URI header if present: "data:image/png;base64,..."
   92 |     if ',' in b64_string:
   93 |         b64_string = b64_string.split(',', 1)[1]
   94 | 
   95 |     raw = base64.b64decode(b64_string)
   96 |     img = Image.open(io.BytesIO(raw)).convert('RGBA')
   97 | 
   98 |     # Make white/near-white pixels transparent for a clean look on the letter
   99 |     data = img.getdata()
  100 |     new_pixels = []
  101 |     for r, g, b, a in data:
  102 |         if r > 230 and g > 230 and b > 230:
  103 |             new_pixels.append((r, g, b, 0))   # transparent
  104 |         else:
  105 |             new_pixels.append((r, g, b, a))
  106 |     img.putdata(new_pixels)
  107 | 
  108 |     buf = io.BytesIO()
  109 |     img.save(buf, format='PNG')
  110 |     return buf.getvalue()
  111 | 
  112 | 
  113 | # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  114 | # Paragraph-level text replacement
  115 | # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  116 | 
  117 | def _replace_in_para(para, ctx):
  118 |     """
  119 |     Replace all {{key}} TEXT placeholders in a paragraph.
  120 |     IMAGE placeholders are handled separately by _process_image_placeholders().
  121 | 
  122 |     Two-pass strategy:
  123 |     Pass 1 — Simple case: placeholder fits inside a single run.
  124 |     Pass 2 — Split-run case: consolidate all runs then replace.
  125 |     """
  126 |     runs = para.runs
  127 |     if not runs:
  128 |         return
  129 | 
  130 |     # ── Pass 1: single-run replacement ──────────────────────────────────────
  131 |     for run in runs:
  132 |         text = run.text or ''
  133 |         if '{{' not in text:
  134 |             continue
  135 |         new_text = text
  136 |         for key, val in ctx.items():
  137 |             if key in IMAGE_PLACEHOLDER_KEYS:
  138 |                 continue   # image placeholders handled separately
  139 |             new_text = new_text.replace('{{' + key + '}}', str(val) if val is not None else '')
  140 |         if new_text != text:
  141 |             if '\n' in new_text:
  142 |                 _set_run_text_with_breaks(run._r, new_text)
  143 |             else:
  144 |                 run.text = new_text
  145 | 
  146 |     # ── Pass 2: split-run detection & consolidation ──────────────────────────
  147 |     full = ''.join(r.text or '' for r in runs)
  148 |     if '{{' not in full:
  149 |         return
  150 | 
  151 |     for key in ctx:
  152 |         if key in IMAGE_PLACEHOLDER_KEYS:
  153 |             continue
  154 |         if '{{' + key + '}}' not in full:
  155 |             continue
  156 | 
  157 |         merged = full
  158 |         for k, v in ctx.items():
  159 |             if k in IMAGE_PLACEHOLDER_KEYS:
  160 |                 continue
  161 |             merged = merged.replace('{{' + k + '}}', str(v) if v is not None else '')
  162 | 
  163 |         first_run = runs[0]
  164 |         if '\n' in merged:
  165 |             _set_run_text_with_breaks(first_run._r, merged)
  166 |         else:
  167 |             first_run.text = merged
  168 | 
  169 |         for run in runs[1:]:
  170 |             run.text = ''
  171 |         break
  172 | 
  173 | 
  174 | # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  175 | # Image placeholder pass — runs over all body paragraphs + table cells
  176 | # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  177 | def _add_image_run(doc, p_elem, png_bytes, width_inches=SIGNATURE_WIDTH_INCHES):
  178 |     with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix='.png', delete=False) as tf:
  179 |         tf.write(png_bytes)
  180 |         tmp_path = tf.name
  181 |     try:
  182 |         tmp_para = doc.add_paragraph()
  183 |         tmp_run  = tmp_para.add_run()
  184 |         tmp_run.add_picture(tmp_path, width=Inches(width_inches))
  185 |         # Move run directly — no deepcopy, relationship already in doc.part
  186 |         run_elem = tmp_run._r
  187 |         tmp_para._p.remove(run_elem)
  188 |         tmp_para._p.getparent().remove(tmp_para._p)
  189 |         p_elem.append(run_elem)
  190 |     finally:
  191 |         os.unlink(tmp_path)
  192 | 
  193 | 
  194 | def _replace_image_in_run(doc, run, key, ctx):
  195 |     png_bytes = _b64_to_png_bytes(ctx[key])
  196 |     run.text  = run.text.replace('{{' + key + '}}', '')
  197 | 
  198 |     with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix='.png', delete=False) as tf:
  199 |         tf.write(png_bytes)
  200 |         tmp_path = tf.name
  201 |     try:
  202 |         tmp_para = doc.add_paragraph()
  203 |         tmp_run  = tmp_para.add_run()
  204 |         tmp_run.add_picture(tmp_path, width=Inches(SIGNATURE_WIDTH_INCHES))
  205 |         img_run_elem = tmp_run._r
  206 |         tmp_para._p.remove(img_run_elem)
  207 |         tmp_para._p.getparent().remove(tmp_para._p)
  208 |         run._r.addprevious(img_run_elem)
  209 |     finally:
  210 |         os.unlink(tmp_path)
  211 | 
  212 | def _consolidate_runs(para):
  213 |     """
  214 |     Merge all runs in a paragraph into the first run (text only).
  215 |     Fixes split-placeholder cases where Word breaks {{key}} across runs.
  216 |     para.text is read-only in python-docx, so we must do this manually.
  217 |     """
  218 |     runs = para.runs
  219 |     if len(runs) <= 1:
  220 |         return
  221 |     full_text = ''.join(r.text or '' for r in runs)
  222 |     runs[0].text = full_text
  223 |     for run in runs[1:]:
  224 |         run.text = ''
  225 | 
  226 | 
  227 | def _process_image_para(doc, para, ctx, processed):
  228 |     """
  229 |     Find and replace image placeholders in a paragraph.
  230 |     Handles split runs by consolidating all runs into the first one when
  231 |     a placeholder is detected as split across multiple runs.
  232 |     """
  233 |     p_id = id(para._p)
  234 |     if p_id in processed:
  235 |         return
  236 |     processed.add(p_id)
  237 | 
  238 |     for key in IMAGE_PLACEHOLDER_KEYS:
  239 |         placeholder = '{{' + key + '}}'
  240 | 
  241 |         # Check if placeholder exists anywhere in this paragraph
  242 |         full_text = ''.join(r.text or '' for r in para.runs)
  243 |         if placeholder not in full_text:
  244 |             continue
  245 | 
  246 |         if not ctx.get(key):
  247 |             # No image data — clear the placeholder text
  248 |             if not any(placeholder in (r.text or '') for r in para.runs):
  249 |                 _consolidate_runs(para)
  250 |             for run in para.runs:
  251 |                 if run.text and placeholder in run.text:
  252 |                     run.text = run.text.replace(placeholder, '')
  253 |             continue
  254 | 
  255 |         # If placeholder is split across runs, consolidate into first run
  256 |         if not any(placeholder in (r.text or '') for r in para.runs):
  257 |             _consolidate_runs(para)
  258 | 
  259 |         # Find the run containing the placeholder and replace with image
  260 |         for run in para.runs:
  261 |             if run.text and placeholder in run.text:
  262 |                 _replace_image_in_run(doc, run, key, ctx)
  263 |                 break
  264 | 
  265 |     # ── Signature alignment fix ──────────────────────────────────────────────
  266 |     full_text = ''.join(r.text or '' for r in para.runs)
  267 |     is_sig_para = all(
  268 |         para._p.find('.//' + qn('w:drawing')) is not None
  269 |         for _ in [1]
  270 |     ) and all(ctx.get(k) for k in IMAGE_PLACEHOLDER_KEYS)
  271 | 
  272 |     if is_sig_para:
  273 |         # Remove whitespace-only runs between the two signatures
  274 |         for r in list(para._p.findall(qn('w:r'))):
  275 |             w_t = r.find(qn('w:t'))
  276 |             w_drawing = r.find(qn('w:drawing'))
  277 |             if w_t is not None and w_drawing is None:
  278 |                 if not (w_t.text or '').strip():
  279 |                     r.getparent().remove(r)
  280 | 
  281 |         # Add right-aligned tab stop at exact text width
  282 |         pPr = para._p.get_or_add_pPr()
  283 |         if pPr.find(qn('w:tabs')) is None:
  284 |             tabs = OxmlElement('w:tabs')
  285 |             tab  = OxmlElement('w:tab')
  286 |             tab.set(qn('w:val'), 'right')
  287 |             tab.set(qn('w:pos'), '8500')
  288 |             tabs.append(tab)
  289 |             pPr.append(tabs)
  290 |             # Remove any left indent on signature paragraph
  291 |             ind = pPr.find(qn('w:ind'))
  292 |             if ind is None:
  293 |                 ind = OxmlElement('w:ind')
  294 |                 pPr.append(ind)
  295 |             ind.set(qn('w:left'), '0')
  296 |             ind.set(qn('w:firstLine'), '0')
  297 | 
  298 |         # Insert tab element between the two image runs
  299 |         all_runs = para._p.findall(qn('w:r'))
  300 |         if len(all_runs) >= 2:
  301 |             tab_run  = OxmlElement('w:r')
  302 |             tab_elem = OxmlElement('w:tab')
  303 |             tab_run.append(tab_elem)
  304 |             all_runs[1].addprevious(tab_run)
  305 | 
  306 | def _process_image_placeholders(doc, ctx):
  307 |     """
  308 |     Replace {{hr_signature}} / {{chairman_signature}} with inline images.
  309 | 
  310 |     IMPORTANT: doc.paragraphs in python-docx includes table-cell paragraphs
  311 |     in its iteration order, so iterating BOTH doc.paragraphs and table cells
  312 |     causes the same paragraph to be visited twice. The first visit adds it to
  313 |     `processed` without replacing (because the temp-paragraph trick mutates the
  314 |     doc body mid-iteration), and the second visit is skipped as already processed.
  315 | 
  316 |     Fix: iterate ONLY table cells explicitly — do not use doc.paragraphs for
  317 |     image placeholders. Signature placeholders live in table cells in this
  318 |     template (and that is where they should always be placed).
  319 |     Also scan body paragraphs directly by XML to catch any non-table placements,
  320 |     but use a fresh paragraph list snapshot to avoid mutation issues.
  321 |     """
  322 |     # Collect all paragraphs: body (non-table) + table cells
  323 |     # Use XML-level iteration to get a stable snapshot before any mutation
  324 |     from docx.oxml.ns import qn as _qn
  325 |     body = doc.element.body
  326 | 
  327 |     # Body-level paragraphs (direct children — excludes table-cell paragraphs)
  328 |     body_paras = [doc.paragraphs[i] for i, p in enumerate(doc.paragraphs)
  329 |                   if p._p.getparent() is body]
  330 | 
  331 |     for para in body_paras:
  332 |         _process_image_para(doc, para, ctx, set())
  333 | 
  334 |     # Table cell paragraphs — explicit traversal, no processed set needed
  335 |     for table in doc.tables:
  336 |         for row in table.rows:
  337 |             for cell in row.cells:
  338 |                 for para in cell.paragraphs:
  339 |                     _process_image_para(doc, para, ctx, set())
  340 | 
  341 | 
  342 | # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  343 | # Public API
  344 | # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  345 | 
  346 | def generate_letter_docx(template_path, ctx, output_path):
  347 |     """
  348 |     Open template_path, fill all {{placeholders}} from ctx dict,
  349 |     save filled document to output_path.
  350 | 
  351 |     ctx may contain:
  352 |       - Regular text values:  ctx['employee_name'] = 'Rahul Sharma'
  353 |       - Image values (base64): ctx['hr_signature'] = 'data:image/png;base64,...'
  354 |                                ctx['chairman_signature'] = 'data:image/png;base64,...'
  355 | 
  356 |     Template formatting (fonts, alignment, table widths, margins) is preserved.
  357 |     Signature images are placed exactly where {{hr_signature}} / {{chairman_signature}}
  358 |     appear in the template.
  359 |     """
  360 |     doc = Document(template_path)
  361 | 
  362 |     # ── Pass 1: Replace image placeholders first ─────────────────────────────
  363 |     # Must run before text replacement so image placeholder text is not mangled
  364 |     _process_image_placeholders(doc, ctx)
  365 | 
  366 |     # ── Pass 2: Replace all text placeholders ────────────────────────────────
  367 |     for para in doc.paragraphs:
  368 |         _replace_in_para(para, ctx)
  369 | 
  370 |     for table in doc.tables:
  371 |         for row in table.rows:
  372 |             for cell in row.cells:
  373 |                 for para in cell.paragraphs:
  374 |                     _replace_in_para(para, ctx)
  375 | 
  376 |     for section in doc.sections:
  377 |         for para in section.header.paragraphs:
  378 |             _replace_in_para(para, ctx)
  379 |         for para in section.footer.paragraphs:
  380 |             _replace_in_para(para, ctx)
  381 |         for table in section.header.tables:
  382 |             for row in table.rows:
  383 |                 for cell in row.cells:
  384 |                     for para in cell.paragraphs:
  385 |                         _replace_in_para(para, ctx)
  386 |         for table in section.footer.tables:
  387 |             for row in table.rows:
  388 |                 for cell in row.cells:
  389 |                     for para in cell.paragraphs:
  390 |                         _replace_in_para(para, ctx)
  391 | 
  392 |     # Compact annexure calculation rows to prevent page overflow
  393 |     # Fix signature table row 0 — set exact row height to match image size
  394 |     if doc.tables:
  395 |         sig_table = doc.tables[0]
  396 |         if len(sig_table.rows) > 0:
  397 |             row = sig_table.rows[0]
  398 |             # Set exact row height to 0.6 inch (same as signature width)
  399 |             trPr = row._tr.find(qn('w:trPr'))
  400 |             if trPr is None:
  401 |                 trPr = OxmlElement('w:trPr')
  402 |                 row._tr.insert(0, trPr)
  403 |             trHeight = trPr.find(qn('w:trHeight'))
  404 |             if trHeight is None:
  405 |                 trHeight = OxmlElement('w:trHeight')
  406 |                 trPr.append(trHeight)
  407 |             trHeight.set(qn('w:val'), '864')   # 0.6 inch in twips
  408 |             trHeight.set(qn('w:hRule'), 'exact')
  409 | 
  410 |             # Set vAlign bottom on each cell
  411 |             for cell in row.cells:
  412 |                 tc   = cell._tc
  413 |                 tcPr = tc.find(qn('w:tcPr'))
  414 |                 if tcPr is None:
  415 |                     tcPr = OxmlElement('w:tcPr')
  416 |                     tc.insert(0, tcPr)
  417 |                 existing = tcPr.find(qn('w:vAlign'))
  418 |                 if existing is not None:
  419 |                     tcPr.remove(existing)
  420 |                 vAlign = OxmlElement('w:vAlign')
  421 |                 vAlign.set(qn('w:val'), 'bottom')
  422 |                 tcPr.append(vAlign)
  423 | 
  424 |     doc.save(output_path)
  425 |     return output_path
  426 | 
  427 | 
  428 | def _find_libreoffice():
  429 |     lo = shutil.which('libreoffice') or shutil.which('soffice')
  430 |     if lo:
  431 |         return lo
  432 |     if platform.system() == 'Windows':
  433 |         for c in [
  434 |             r'C:\Program Files\LibreOffice\program\soffice.exe',
  435 |             r'C:\Program Files (x86)\LibreOffice\program\soffice.exe',
  436 |         ]:
  437 |             if os.path.exists(c):
  438 |                 return c
  439 |     if platform.system() == 'Darwin':
  440 |         mac = '/Applications/LibreOffice.app/Contents/MacOS/soffice'
  441 |         if os.path.exists(mac):
  442 |             return mac
  443 |     return None
  444 | 
  445 | 
  446 | def generate_letter_pdf(docx_path, pdf_path):
  447 |     lo = _find_libreoffice()
  448 |     if not lo:
  449 |         logger.error('LibreOffice not found. Install: apt-get install -y libreoffice')
  450 |         return None
  451 |     try:
  452 |         out_dir = os.path.dirname(pdf_path)
  453 |         os.makedirs(out_dir, exist_ok=True)
  454 | 
  455 |         # Use a private user profile dir to avoid lock conflicts in Docker
  456 |         lo_profile = os.path.join(tempfile.gettempdir(), 'lo_userprofile')
  457 |         os.makedirs(lo_profile, exist_ok=True)
  458 | 
  459 |         result = subprocess.run(
  460 |             [
  461 |                 lo,
  462 |                 f'-env:UserInstallation=file://{lo_profile}',
  463 |                 '--headless',
  464 |                 '--convert-to', 'pdf',
  465 |                 '--outdir', out_dir,
  466 |                 docx_path,
  467 |             ],
  468 |             capture_output=True,
  469 |             timeout=90,
  470 |             check=False,
  471 |         )
  472 | 
  473 |         if result.returncode != 0:
  474 |             logger.error(
  475 |                 f'LibreOffice failed (rc={result.returncode}) for {docx_path}\n'
  476 |                 f'stdout: {result.stdout.decode(errors="replace")}\n'
  477 |                 f'stderr: {result.stderr.decode(errors="replace")}'
  478 |             )
  479 |             return None
  480 | 
  481 |         # LibreOffice always names the output after the input basename
  482 |         base      = os.path.splitext(os.path.basename(docx_path))[0]
  483 |         generated = os.path.join(out_dir, base + '.pdf')
  484 | 
  485 |         if os.path.exists(generated):
  486 |             if os.path.abspath(generated) != os.path.abspath(pdf_path):
  487 |                 shutil.move(generated, pdf_path)
  488 |             return pdf_path
  489 | 
  490 |         logger.error(f'LibreOffice ran OK but PDF not found at: {generated}')
  491 |     except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
  492 |         logger.error(f'LibreOffice timed out converting {docx_path}')
  493 |     except Exception as e:
  494 |         logger.error(f'PDF generation exception: {e}', exc_info=True)
  495 |     return None

📄 FILE #37: export_project.js

    1 | const fs = require('fs');
    2 | const path = require('path');
    3 | 
    4 | const OUTPUT_FILE = 'project_export.txt';
    5 | 
    6 | // Folders to skip
    7 | const SKIP_DIRS = [
    8 |   'node_modules', '.git', '.angular', 'dist', 'build',
    9 |   '.cache', 'coverage', '.nyc_output', 'tmp', '.tmp',
   10 |   '__pycache__', '.pytest_cache', '.venv', 'venv', 'env',
   11 |   '.mypy_cache', '.eggs', '*.egg-info'
   12 | ];
   13 | 
   14 | // File types to SKIP (only binaries / assets — everything else is collected)
   15 | const SKIP_EXTENSIONS = [
   16 |   // Images
   17 |   '.png', '.jpg', '.jpeg', '.gif', '.svg', '.ico', '.webp', '.bmp', '.tiff',
   18 |   // Fonts
   19 |   '.woff', '.woff2', '.ttf', '.eot', '.otf',
   20 |   // Archives / binaries
   21 |   '.zip', '.tar', '.gz', '.rar', '.7z',
   22 |   '.exe', '.dll', '.so', '.dylib', '.bin',
   23 |   // Compiled Python
   24 |   '.pyc', '.pyo', '.pyd',
   25 |   // Misc
   26 |   '.pdf', '.map', '.lock', '.log'
   27 | ];
   28 | 
   29 | // ── No IMPORTANT_EXTENSIONS filter any more ──
   30 | // Every file NOT in SKIP_EXTENSIONS will be included.
   31 | 
   32 | let output = '';
   33 | let fileCount = 0;
   34 | 
   35 | function scanDir(dirPath, depth = 0) {
   36 |   let items;
   37 |   try {
   38 |     items = fs.readdirSync(dirPath);
   39 |   } catch (e) {
   40 |     output += `[Cannot read directory: ${dirPath}]\n`;
   41 |     return;
   42 |   }
   43 | 
   44 |   for (const item of items) {
   45 |     const fullPath = path.join(dirPath, item);
   46 |     let stat;
   47 |     try {
   48 |       stat = fs.statSync(fullPath);
   49 |     } catch (e) {
   50 |       continue;
   51 |     }
   52 | 
   53 |     if (stat.isDirectory()) {
   54 |       // Skip unwanted dirs (support glob-style *.egg-info check)
   55 |       if (SKIP_DIRS.some(d => d.startsWith('*') ? item.endsWith(d.slice(1)) : item === d)) continue;
   56 | 
   57 |       output += `\n${'='.repeat(70)}\n`;
   58 |       output += `📁 FOLDER: ${fullPath}\n`;
   59 |       output += `${'='.repeat(70)}\n`;
   60 |       scanDir(fullPath, depth + 1);
   61 | 
   62 |     } else {
   63 |       const ext = path.extname(item).toLowerCase();
   64 | 
   65 |       // Skip binary / asset extensions
   66 |       if (SKIP_EXTENSIONS.includes(ext)) continue;
   67 | 
   68 |       // ── Collect EVERY remaining file ──
   69 |       fileCount++;
   70 |       output += `\n${'-'.repeat(70)}\n`;
   71 |       output += `📄 FILE #${fileCount}: ${fullPath}\n`;
   72 |       output += `${'-'.repeat(70)}\n`;
   73 | 
   74 |       try {
   75 |         const content = fs.readFileSync(fullPath, 'utf8');
   76 |         const lines = content.split('\n');
   77 |         lines.forEach((line, i) => {
   78 |           output += `${String(i + 1).padStart(5)} | ${line}\n`;
   79 |         });
   80 |       } catch (e) {
   81 |         output += `[Could not read file: ${e.message}]\n`;
   82 |       }
   83 |     }
   84 |   }
   85 | }
   86 | 
   87 | // ── Header ──
   88 | output += `${'#'.repeat(70)}\n`;
   89 | output += `   FULL PROJECT EXPORT — JS FRONTEND + PYTHON BACKEND\n`;
   90 | output += `${'#'.repeat(70)}\n`;
   91 | output += `Generated : ${new Date().toISOString()}\n`;
   92 | output += `Root Path : ${process.cwd()}\n`;
   93 | output += `${'#'.repeat(70)}\n\n`;
   94 | 
   95 | // ── Scan ──
   96 | scanDir('.');
   97 | 
   98 | // ── Footer ──
   99 | output += `\n${'#'.repeat(70)}\n`;
  100 | output += `   EXPORT COMPLETE — Total Files: ${fileCount}\n`;
  101 | output += `${'#'.repeat(70)}\n`;
  102 | 
  103 | fs.writeFileSync(OUTPUT_FILE, output, 'utf8');
  104 | console.log(`✅ Done! Exported ${fileCount} files to: ${OUTPUT_FILE}`);

   20 | // Hash-based router
   21 | function useHashRoute() {
   22 |   // FIX #5 (App.jsx L16): strip all leading # chars robustly
   23 |   const getPath = () => window.location.hash.replace(/^#+/, '') || '/';
   24 |   const [path, setPath] = useState(getPath);
   25 |   useEffect(() => {
   26 |     const handler = () => setPath(getPath());
   27 |     window.addEventListener('hashchange', handler);
   28 |     return () => window.removeEventListener('hashchange', handler);
   29 |   }, []);
   30 |   return path;
   31 | }
   32 |

   59 | function AppRouter() {
   60 |   const path              = useHashRoute();
   61 |   const { user, loading } = useAuth();
   62 | 
   63 |   if (loading) return <div className="loading-screen"><div className="spinner" /></div>;
   64 |   if (!user)   return <LoginPage />;
   65 | 
   66 |   const PageComponent = PAGES[path] ?? NotFound;
   67 | 
   68 |   return (
   69 |     <Layout currentPath={path}>
   70 |       <PageComponent />
   71 |     </Layout>
   72 |   );
   73 | }

  609 | const REQUIRED_PROFILE_FIELDS = ['name', 'phone', 'personal_email', 'gender', 'blood_group', 'birthday', 'address'];
  610 | 
  611 | const isProfileComplete = (u) =>
  612 |   u && REQUIRED_PROFILE_FIELDS.every(k => u[k] && String(u[k]).trim() !== '');
  613 |

  616 |   const [showProfile, setShowProfile] = useState(false);

  622 | 
  623 |   // Fetch total pending approval count for sidebar badge (only when logged in)
  624 |   useEffect(() => {
  625 |     if (!user?._id || user.role === 'employee') return;
  626 |     const role = user.role;
  627 |     const isMgr = role === 'manager';
  628 |     const isHR = ['admin', 'hr_head', 'hr'].includes(role);
  629 |

  631 |       isHR ? axios.get('/api/approvals/pending').catch(() => ({ data: [] })) : Promise.resolve({ data: [] }),
  632 |       isHR ? axios.get('/api/appointment-orders/').catch(() => ({ data: [] })) : Promise.resolve({ data: [] }),
  633 |       isHR ? axios.get('/api/documents/submissions?status=pending_hr').catch(() => ({ data: [] })) : Promise.resolve({ data: [] }),
  634 |       isMgr ? axios.get('/api/approvals/pending').catch(() => ({ data: [] })) : Promise.resolve({ data: [] }),

  639 |       const docsCount = (docs.data || []).length;
  640 |       const resignCount = (resign.data || []).length;

  643 |   }, [user?._id]);
  644 |

  662 |           padding: '18px 18px 16px',

📄 FILE #48: frontend\src\context\AuthContext.jsx

    1 | import { createContext, useContext, useState, useEffect } from 'react';
    2 | import axios from 'axios';
    3 | 
    4 | const AuthContext = createContext(null);
    5 | 
    6 | export function AuthProvider({ children }) {
    7 |   const [user, setUser] = useState(null);
    8 |   const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
    9 | 
   10 |   // FIX #13: global 401 interceptor — redirect to login when JWT expires mid-session
   11 |   useEffect(() => {
   12 |     const id = axios.interceptors.response.use(
   13 |       res => res,
   14 |       err => {
   15 |         // 401 = unauthorised, 422 = flask-jwt invalid/expired token
   16 |         if (err.response?.status === 401 || err.response?.status === 422) {
   17 |           // Don't redirect if this is the login endpoint itself
   18 |           const url = err.config?.url || '';
   19 |           if (!url.includes('/api/auth/login') && !url.includes('/api/auth/profile')) {
   20 |             localStorage.removeItem('token');
   21 |             delete axios.defaults.headers.common['Authorization'];
   22 |             setUser(null);
   23 |             window.location.hash = '/';
   24 |           }
   25 |         }
   26 |         return Promise.reject(err);
   27 |       }
   28 |     );
   29 |     return () => axios.interceptors.response.eject(id);
   30 |   }, []);
   31 | 
   32 |   useEffect(() => {
   33 |     const token = localStorage.getItem('token');
   34 |     if (token) {
   35 |       axios.defaults.headers.common['Authorization'] = `Bearer ${token}`;
   36 |       axios.get('/api/auth/profile')
   37 |         .then(res => setUser(res.data))
   38 |         .catch(err => {
   39 |           // FIX #13 (AuthContext): only clear token on 401/422, not network errors
   40 |           if (err.response?.status === 401 || err.response?.status === 422) {
   41 |             localStorage.removeItem('token');
   42 |           }
   43 |         })
   44 |         .finally(() => setLoading(false));
   45 |     } else {
   46 |       setLoading(false);
   47 |     }
   48 |   }, []);
   49 | 
   50 |   const login = async (email, password) => {
   51 |     const res = await axios.post('/api/auth/login', { email, password });
   52 |     const { token } = res.data;
   53 |     localStorage.setItem('token', token);
   54 |     axios.defaults.headers.common['Authorization'] = `Bearer ${token}`;
   55 |     // Fetch full profile so personal fields are available immediately
   56 |     const profile = await axios.get('/api/auth/profile');
   57 |     setUser(profile.data);
   58 |     return profile.data;
   59 |   };
   60 | 
   61 |   const logout = () => {
   62 |     localStorage.removeItem('token');
   63 |     delete axios.defaults.headers.common['Authorization'];
   64 |     setUser(null);
   65 |   };
   66 | 
   67 |   const updateUser = (fields) => {
   68 |     setUser(prev => ({ ...prev, ...fields }));
   69 |   };
   70 | 
   71 |   return (
   72 |     <AuthContext.Provider value={{ user, login, logout, loading, updateUser }}>
   73 |       {children}
   74 |     </AuthContext.Provider>
   75 |   );
   76 | }
   77 | 
   78 | export const useAuth = () => useContext(AuthContext);

  176 | // ─── Form Q Preview Table ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  177 | // Used in Step 3 (employee) and HR review panel — mirrors official form layout
  178 | function FormQTable({ fields }) {
  179 |   const wageVal = [
  180 |     fields.wage_basic && `I) Basic: ₹${fields.wage_basic}`,
  181 |     fields.wage_vda && `II) VDA: ₹${fields.wage_vda}`,

  183 |     fields.wage_total && `Total: ₹${fields.wage_total}`,
  184 |   ].filter(Boolean).join('\n');
  185 | 
  186 |   return (
  187 |     <div style={{ borderRadius: 8, overflow: 'hidden', border: '1px solid var(--border)' }}>
  188 |       {/* Form Q heading */}
  189 |       <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', padding: '14px 16px 10px', borderBottom: '1px solid var(--border)', background: 'var(--surface-2)' }}>
  190 |         <div style={{ fontWeight: 800, fontSize: 15, letterSpacing: .5 }}>Form 'Q'</div>
  191 |         <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: 'var(--text-dim)', marginTop: 2 }}>[See Rule 24(9-A)] &nbsp;·&nbsp; Appointment Order</div>
  192 |       </div>
  193 |       <table className="fq-table"><tbody>
  194 |         <tr className="fq-hdr"><td className="fq-sl">Sl.</td><td className="fq-part">Particulars</td><td>Details</td></tr>
  195 |         {FORM_Q_ROWS.map(row => {
  196 |           let val = '';
  197 |           if (row.wages) {
  198 |             val = wageVal;
  199 |           } else {
  200 |             val = fields[row.key] || '';
  201 |             if (row.date && val) val = fmtDisp(val);
  202 |           }
  203 |           return (
  204 |             <tr key={row.sl}>
  205 |               <td className="fq-sl">{row.sl}</td>
  206 |               <td className="fq-part">{row.part}</td>
  207 |               <td className={`fq-val${!val ? ' fq-empty' : ''}`}>{val || '—'}</td>
  208 |             </tr>
  209 |           );
  210 |         })}
  211 |       </tbody></table>
  212 |       {/* Footer row */}
  213 |       <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1fr', gap: 0, borderTop: '1px solid var(--border)', fontSize: 13 }}>
  214 |         <div style={{ padding: '9px 14px', borderRight: '1px solid var(--border)' }}>

  216 |           <div style={{ fontWeight: 500 }}>{fields.place || '—'}</div>
  217 |         </div>
  218 |         <div style={{ padding: '9px 14px' }}>
  219 |           <div style={{ fontSize: 10, color: 'var(--text-dim)', fontFamily: 'monospace', textTransform: 'uppercase', marginBottom: 3 }}>Date</div>
  220 |           <div style={{ fontWeight: 500 }}>{fields.date ? fmtDisp(fields.date) : new Date().toLocaleDateString('en-IN')}</div>
  221 |         </div>
  222 |       </div>
  223 |     </div>

  532 | // Shows full Form Q table + approve/reject workflow
  533 | function HRReviewPanel({ order, onClose, onDone, readOnly = false }) {
  534 |   const [tab, setTab] = useState('preview');  // 'preview' | 'action'
  535 |   const [action, setAction] = useState('');
  536 |   const [remarks, setRemarks] = useState('');
  537 |   const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  538 |   const [error, setError] = useState('');
  539 |   const [pdfUrl, setPdfUrl] = useState(null);
  540 |   const [pdfLoading, setPdfLoading] = useState(true);
  541 |   const [pdfError, setPdfError] = useState('');
  542 |   const d = order.details || {};
  543 | 
  544 |   useEffect(() => {
  545 |     setPdfLoading(true); setPdfError('');
  546 |     axios.get(`/api/appointment-orders/${order._id}/preview`, { responseType: 'blob' })
  547 |       .then(r => {
  548 |         const url = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([r.data], { type: 'application/pdf' }));
  549 |         setPdfUrl(url);
  550 |       })
  551 |       .catch(() => setPdfError('Could not load document preview.'))
  552 |       .finally(() => setPdfLoading(false));
  553 |     return () => { if (pdfUrl) URL.revokeObjectURL(pdfUrl); };

  555 |

  563 |       setError(e.response?.data?.error || 'Action failed');

  737 | // ─── Edit & Resubmit Modal ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  738 | // Opens pre-filled with rejected order's fields so employee can fix and resubmit
  739 | function EditResubmitModal({ order, onClose, onDone }) {
  740 |   const d = order.details || {};
  741 | 
  742 |   // Auto-set server-side keys — never shown as inputs
  743 |   const AUTO_KEYS_SET = new Set(['date', 'reference_number', 'employee_id', 'employee_id_code', 'approval_date']);
  744 | 
  745 |   // Build initFields ONLY from keys actually stored in this order's details
  746 |   // This guarantees we show exactly what was filled from the template — nothing more
  747 |   const initFields = {};
  748 |   Object.keys(d).forEach(key => {
  749 |     if (AUTO_KEYS_SET.has(key)) return;
  750 |     if (typeof d[key] !== 'string') return;
  751 |     initFields[key] = d[key];
  752 |   });
  753 | 
  754 |   // Ordered field list — use ALL_FIELDS metadata where key is known,
  755 |   // fall back to plain text for any template-specific key not in ALL_FIELDS
  756 |   const visibleFields = [
  757 |     ...ALL_FIELDS.filter(f => f.key in initFields),
  758 |     ...Object.keys(initFields)
  759 |       .filter(k => !ALL_FIELDS.some(f => f.key === k))
  760 |       .map(k => ({ key: k, label: k.replace(/_/g, ' ').replace(/\b\w/g, c => c.toUpperCase()) })),
  761 |   ];
  762 | 
  763 |   const [fields, setFields] = useState(initFields);
  764 |   const [step, setStep] = useState('edit');
  765 |   const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  766 |   const [error, setError] = useState('');
  767 | 
  768 |   const rejection = (order.approval_history || []).slice().reverse().find(h => h.action === 'reject');
  769 |   const set = (k, v) => setFields(prev => ({ ...prev, [k]: v }));
  770 | 
  771 |   const filled = visibleFields.filter(f => (fields[f.key] || '').trim()).length;
  772 | 
  773 |   const goPreview = () => {
  774 |     const empty = visibleFields.filter(f => !(fields[f.key] || '').trim()).map(f => f.label);
  775 |     if (empty.length) { setError(`Please fill: ${empty.slice(0, 3).join(', ')}${empty.length > 3 ? ` +${empty.length - 3} more` : ''}`); return; }
  776 |     setError(''); setStep('preview');
  777 |   };
  778 | 
  779 |   const resubmit = async () => {
  780 |     setError(''); setSubmitting(true);
  781 |     try {
  782 |       // Step 1: update fields (resets to draft)
  783 |       await axios.post(`/api/appointment-orders/${order._id}/update-fields`, { fields });
  784 |       // Step 2: resubmit draft → pending_hr_head
  785 |       await axios.post(`/api/appointment-orders/${order._id}/resubmit`);
  786 |       onDone('Appointment order resubmitted to HR Head for approval.');
  787 |     } catch (e) {
  788 |       setError(e.response?.data?.error || 'Resubmission failed');
  789 |     } finally { setSubmitting(false); }
  790 |   };
  791 | 
  792 |   return (
  793 |     <div className="modal-overlay" onClick={e => e.target === e.currentTarget && onClose()}>
  794 |       <style>{STYLES}</style>
  795 |       <div className="modal" style={{ maxWidth: 680, width: '96%', maxHeight: '92vh', overflowY: 'auto' }}
  796 |         onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()}>
  797 | 
  798 |         {/* Header */}
  799 |         <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'flex-start', justifyContent: 'space-between', marginBottom: 20 }}>
  800 |           <div>
  801 |             <div style={{ fontSize: 10, color: 'var(--text-dim)', fontFamily: 'monospace', textTransform: 'uppercase', letterSpacing: 1.5, marginBottom: 4 }}>Edit & Resubmit</div>
  802 |             <h2 style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: 21 }}>Appointment Order</h2>
  803 |             <div style={{ fontSize: 12, color: 'var(--text-dim)', marginTop: 4, fontFamily: 'monospace' }}>{order.reference_number}</div>
  804 |           </div>
  805 |           <button className="btn-icon" onClick={onClose} style={{ fontSize: 18, marginTop: 4 }}>✕</button>
  806 |         </div>
  807 | 
  808 |         {/* Rejection reason banner */}
  809 |         {rejection?.remarks && (
  810 |           <div style={{ background: 'rgba(239,68,68,.08)', border: '1px solid rgba(239,68,68,.25)', borderRadius: 8, padding: '12px 16px', marginBottom: 20, fontSize: 13 }}>
  811 |             <div style={{ fontWeight: 700, color: 'var(--red)', marginBottom: 4 }}>✗ Rejected by HR Head</div>
  812 |             <div style={{ color: 'var(--text-dim)' }}>{rejection.remarks}</div>
  813 |             <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: 'var(--text-dim)', marginTop: 6 }}>Please correct the details below and resubmit.</div>
  814 |           </div>
  815 |         )}
  816 | 
  817 |         {error && <div className="alert alert-error" style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>{error}</div>}
  818 | 
  819 |         {/* ── EDIT STEP ── */}
  820 |         {step === 'edit' && (
  821 |           <div>
  822 |             <div style={{ background: 'var(--surface-2)', borderRadius: 10, padding: '11px 16px', marginBottom: 20, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between' }}>
  823 |               <div style={{ fontSize: 13 }}>
  824 |                 <strong style={{ color: filled === visibleFields.length ? 'var(--green)' : 'var(--accent)' }}>{filled}</strong>
  825 |                 <span style={{ color: 'var(--text-dim)' }}> / {visibleFields.length} fields filled</span>
  826 |               </div>
  827 |               <div style={{ height: 6, width: 140, background: 'var(--border)', borderRadius: 3, overflow: 'hidden' }}>
  828 |                 <div style={{ height: '100%', borderRadius: 3, width: `${visibleFields.length ? (filled / visibleFields.length) * 100 : 0}%`, background: filled === visibleFields.length ? 'var(--green)' : 'var(--accent)', transition: 'width .3s' }} />
  829 |               </div>
  830 |             </div>
  831 | 
  832 |             <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 12 }}>
  833 |               {visibleFields.map((f, idx) => (
  834 |                 <div key={f.key} className="ao-field">
  835 |                   <div className="ao-field-label">
  836 |                     <span className="ao-field-num">{idx + 1}</span>
  837 |                     {f.label}
  838 |                     <span style={{ color: 'var(--red)', marginLeft: 2 }}>*</span>
  839 |                   </div>
  840 |                   {f.date ? (
  841 |                     <input type="date" className="ao-field-input" value={fields[f.key] || ''} onChange={e => set(f.key, e.target.value)} style={{ cursor: 'pointer' }} />
  842 |                   ) : f.multi ? (
  843 |                     <textarea className="ao-field-input" rows={f.rows || 3} value={fields[f.key] || ''} onChange={e => set(f.key, e.target.value)} />
  844 |                   ) : (
  845 |                     <input type="text" className="ao-field-input" value={fields[f.key] || ''} onChange={e => set(f.key, e.target.value)} />
  846 |                   )}
  847 |                 </div>
  848 |               ))}
  849 |             </div>
  850 | 
  851 |             <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 10, marginTop: 24 }}>
  852 |               <button className="btn btn-secondary" onClick={onClose}>Cancel</button>
  853 |               <button className="btn btn-primary" onClick={goPreview}
  854 |                 disabled={filled !== visibleFields.length} style={{ flex: 1 }}>
  855 |                 Preview Before Resubmitting →
  856 |               </button>
  857 |             </div>
  858 |           </div>
  859 |         )}
  860 | 
  861 |         {/* ── PREVIEW STEP ── */}
  862 |         {step === 'preview' && (
  863 |           <div>
  864 |             <div style={{ background: 'rgba(63,207,142,.07)', border: '1px solid rgba(63,207,142,.2)', borderRadius: 8, padding: '10px 16px', marginBottom: 20, fontSize: 13, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8 }}>
  865 |               <span>✓</span><span>All fields updated. Review before resubmitting to HR.</span>
  866 |             </div>
  867 |             <TemplatePreview templateId={selTpl._id} fields={fields} />
  868 |             <div style={{ background: 'rgba(99,102,241,.07)', border: '1px solid rgba(99,102,241,.2)', borderRadius: 8, padding: '12px 16px', margin: '20px 0', fontSize: 13 }}>
  869 |               <strong>📤 Resubmit to HR Head</strong>

  871 |             </div>

  873 |               <button className="btn btn-secondary" onClick={() => setStep('edit')}>← Edit Again</button>

  885 | // ─── Order Card ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  886 | function OrderCard({ order, isHR, isHRHead, isEmployee, onReview, onEdit }) {
  887 |   const [downloading, setDownloading] = useState(false);
  888 |   const d = order.details || {};
  889 | 
  890 |   const download = async (fmt) => {
  891 |     setDownloading(true);
  892 |     try {
  893 |       const r = await axios.get(`/api/appointment-orders/${order._id}/download?format=${fmt}`, { responseType: 'blob' });
  894 |       const url = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([r.data]));
  895 |       const a = document.createElement('a'); a.href = url; a.download = `${order.reference_number}.${fmt}`; a.click();
  896 |       URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  897 |     } catch { alert('Download failed. File may not be ready yet.'); }
  898 |     finally { setDownloading(false); }
  899 |   };
  900 | 
  901 |   const rejection = order.status === 'rejected'
  902 |     ? (order.approval_history || []).slice().reverse().find(h => h.action === 'reject')
  903 |     : null;
  904 | 
  905 |   return (
  906 |     <div className="card" style={{ padding: '18px 22px', borderColor: order.status === 'rejected' ? 'rgba(239,68,68,.3)' : undefined }}>
  907 |       <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'flex-start', justifyContent: 'space-between', gap: 16, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
  908 |         <div style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 200 }}>
  909 |           <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10, marginBottom: 6, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
  910 |             <span style={{ fontWeight: 700, fontSize: 16 }}>{order.employee_name || d.employee_name || '—'}</span>
  911 |             <Badge status={order.status} />
  912 |           </div>
  913 |           <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 18, flexWrap: 'wrap', fontSize: 12, color: 'var(--text-dim)' }}>
  914 |             <span style={{ fontFamily: 'monospace' }}>{order.reference_number}</span>
  915 |             {d.designation && <span>{d.designation}</span>}
  916 |             {d.date_of_joining && <span>Joining: {fmtDisp(d.date_of_joining)}</span>}
  917 |             <span>Submitted: {fmtDate(order.created_at)}</span>
  918 |           </div>
  919 |           {/* Rejection reason + call to action */}
  920 |           {rejection?.remarks && (
  921 |             <div style={{ marginTop: 10, fontSize: 12, color: 'var(--red)', background: 'rgba(239,68,68,.07)', padding: '8px 12px', borderRadius: 6, borderLeft: '3px solid var(--red)' }}>
  922 |               <div style={{ fontWeight: 600, marginBottom: 2 }}>✗ Rejected</div>
  923 |               <div>{rejection.remarks}</div>
  924 |             </div>
  925 |           )}
  926 |         </div>
  927 | 
  928 |         <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8, alignItems: 'center', flexShrink: 0, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
  929 | 
  930 |           {/* HR Head: review pending orders */}
  931 |           {isHRHead && order.status === 'pending_hr_head' && (
  932 |             <button className="btn btn-primary" style={{ fontSize: 12 }} onClick={() => onReview(order)}>
  933 |               Review →
  934 |             </button>
  935 |           )}
  936 | 
  937 |           {/* HR: preview any order */}
  938 |           {isHR && order.status !== 'pending_hr_head' && (
  939 |             <button className="btn btn-secondary" style={{ fontSize: 12 }} onClick={() => onReview(order)}>
  940 |               👁 Preview
  941 |             </button>
  942 |           )}
  943 | 
  944 |           {/* HR: edit & resubmit rejected orders */}
  945 |           {isHR && order.status === 'rejected' && (
  946 |             <button className="btn btn-secondary" style={{ fontSize: 12, color: 'var(--amber)', borderColor: 'rgba(245,166,35,.4)' }}
  947 |               onClick={() => onEdit(order)}>
  948 |               ✎ Edit & Resubmit
  949 |             </button>
  950 |           )}
  951 | 
  952 |           {/* Employee: view Form Q read-only */}
  953 |           {isEmployee && (
  954 |             <button className="btn btn-secondary" style={{ fontSize: 12 }} onClick={() => onReview(order)}>
  955 |               👁 View
  956 |             </button>
  957 |           )}
  958 | 
  959 |           {/* Download approved — both HR and employee */}
  960 |           {order.status === 'approved' && (
  961 |             <>
  962 |               <button className="btn btn-primary" style={{ fontSize: 12 }} onClick={() => download('pdf')} disabled={downloading}>⬇ PDF</button>
  963 |               <button className="btn btn-secondary" style={{ fontSize: 12 }} onClick={() => download('docx')} disabled={downloading}>⬇ DOCX</button>
  964 |             </>
  965 |           )}
  966 |         </div>
  967 |       </div>
  968 |     </div>
  969 |   );

 1006 |     if (activeTab === 'all') return true;
 1007 |     if (activeTab === 'pending') return o.status === 'pending_hr_head';
 1008 |     if (activeTab === 'approved') return o.status === 'approved';

  596 | // ─── Resignation Modal ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  597 | 
  598 | function ResignationModal({ emp, onClose, onDone }) {
  599 |   const [rejectMode, setRejectMode] = useState(false);
  600 |   const [reason, setReason] = useState('');
  601 |   const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  602 |   const [error, setError] = useState('');
  603 | 
  604 |   const approve = async () => {
  605 |     setLoading(true); setError('');
  606 |     try { await axios.post(`/api/exit/${emp._id}/approve-resignation`); onDone('approved'); }
  607 |     catch (e) { setError(e.response?.data?.error || 'Failed'); setLoading(false); }
  608 |   };
  609 | 
  610 |   const reject = async () => {
  611 |     setLoading(true); setError('');
  612 |     try { await axios.post(`/api/exit/${emp._id}/reject-resignation`, { reason }); onDone('rejected'); }
  613 |     catch (e) { setError(e.response?.data?.error || 'Failed'); setLoading(false); }
  614 |   };
  615 | 
  616 |   return (
  617 |     <div className="modal-overlay" onClick={e => e.target === e.currentTarget && onClose()}>
  618 |       <div className="modal" style={{ maxWidth: 500 }} onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()}>
  619 |         <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'flex-start', marginBottom: 20 }}>
  620 |           <div>
  621 |             <div style={{ fontSize: 10, color: 'var(--text-dim)', fontFamily: 'var(--mono)', textTransform: 'uppercase', letterSpacing: 1.5, marginBottom: 4 }}>Resignation Approval</div>
  622 |             <h2 style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: 20 }}>Review Resignation</h2>
  623 |           </div>
  624 |           <button className="btn btn-ghost btn-sm" onClick={onClose}>✕</button>
  625 |         </div>
  626 |         <div style={{ background: 'var(--surface-2)', borderRadius: 10, padding: '14px 18px', marginBottom: 18 }}>
  627 |           <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1fr', gap: '10px 20px', fontSize: 13 }}>
  628 |             {[
  629 |               ['Employee', emp.name], ['Employee ID', emp.employee_id],
  630 |               ['Designation', emp.designation], ['Department', emp.department],
  631 |               ['Resignation Date', emp.resignation_date], ['Last Working Day', emp.last_working_day || 'Auto-calculated'],
  632 |               ['Exit Reason', emp.exit_reason || '—'],
  633 |             ].map(([k, v]) => v && (
  634 |               <div key={k} style={{ gridColumn: k === 'Exit Reason' ? '1 / -1' : undefined }}>
  635 |                 <div style={{ fontSize: 10, color: 'var(--text-dim)', textTransform: 'uppercase', fontFamily: 'var(--mono)', marginBottom: 2 }}>{k}</div>
  636 |                 <div style={{ fontWeight: 500 }}>{v}</div>
  637 |               </div>
  638 |             ))}
  639 |           </div>
  640 |         </div>
  641 |         {error && <div className="alert alert-error" style={{ marginBottom: 14 }}>{error}</div>}
  642 |         {!rejectMode ? (
  643 |           <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 10 }}>
  644 |             <button className="btn btn-secondary" style={{ flex: 1 }} onClick={() => setRejectMode(true)}>✗ Reject</button>
  645 |             <button className="btn btn-primary" style={{ flex: 1, background: 'var(--green)', borderColor: 'var(--green)' }}
  646 |               onClick={approve} disabled={loading}>
  647 |               {loading ? 'Approving…' : '✓ Approve Resignation'}
  648 |             </button>
  649 |           </div>
  650 |         ) : (
  651 |           <>
  652 |             <div className="form-group" style={{ marginBottom: 14 }}>
  653 |               <label className="form-label">Rejection Reason <span style={{ color: 'var(--red)', fontSize: 10 }}>(optional)</span></label>
  654 |               <textarea className="form-input" rows={3} value={reason} onChange={e => setReason(e.target.value)}
  655 |                 placeholder="Explain the reason for rejection…" />
  656 |             </div>
  657 |             <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 10 }}>
  658 |               <button className="btn btn-secondary" onClick={() => setRejectMode(false)} disabled={loading}>← Back</button>
  659 |               <button className="btn btn-danger" style={{ flex: 1 }} onClick={reject} disabled={loading}>
  660 |                 {loading ? 'Rejecting…' : '✗ Confirm Rejection'}
  661 |               </button>
  662 |             </div>
  663 |           </>
  664 |         )}
  665 |       </div>
  666 |     </div>
  667 |   );
  668 | }

  670 | // ─── Main ApprovalsPage ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  672 | export default function ApprovalsPage() {
  673 |   const { user } = useAuth();
  674 |   const role = user?.role || '';
  675 |   const isHR = ['hr_head', 'admin', 'hr'].includes(role);
  676 |   const isMgr = ['manager', 'hr_head', 'admin'].includes(role);
  677 | 
  678 |   const [pending, setPending] = useState([]);
  679 |   const [history, setHistory] = useState([]);
  680 |   const [pendingAO, setPendingAO] = useState([]);
  681 |   const [pendingResign, setPendingResign] = useState([]);
  682 |   const [pendingDocs, setPendingDocs] = useState([]);
  683 |   const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  684 | 
  685 |   const [reviewingLetter, setReviewingLetter] = useState(null);
  686 |   const [previewingLetter, setPreviewingLetter] = useState(null);
  687 |   const [reviewingAO, setReviewingAO] = useState(null);
  688 |   const [reviewingResign, setReviewingResign] = useState(null);
  689 |   const [reviewingDoc, setReviewingDoc] = useState(null);
  690 |   const [success, setSuccess] = useState('');
  691 |   const [tab, setTab] = useState(isMgr && !isHR ? 'resignations' : role === 'hr' ? 'documents' : 'offer_pending');
  692 | 
  693 |   const load = () => {
  694 |     setLoading(true);
  695 |     Promise.all([
  696 |       axios.get('/api/approvals/pending').catch(() => ({ data: [] })),
  697 |       axios.get('/api/approvals/history').catch(() => ({ data: [] })),
  698 |       axios.get('/api/appointment-orders/').catch(() => ({ data: [] })),
  699 |       isMgr ? axios.get('/api/exit/pending-approvals').catch(() => ({ data: [] })) : Promise.resolve({ data: [] }),
  700 |       isHR ? axios.get('/api/documents/submissions?status=pending_hr').catch(() => ({ data: [] })) : Promise.resolve({ data: [] }),
  701 |     ]).then(([p, h, ao, resign, docs]) => {
  702 |       setPending(p.data || []);
  703 |       setHistory(h.data || []);
  704 |       setPendingAO((ao.data || []).filter(o => o.status === 'pending_hr_head'));
  705 |       setPendingResign(resign.data || []);
  706 |       setPendingDocs(docs.data || []);
  707 |     }).finally(() => setLoading(false));
  708 |   };
  709 | 
  710 |   useEffect(() => { load(); }, []);
  711 | 
  712 |   const notify = (msg) => { setSuccess(msg); load(); setTimeout(() => setSuccess(''), 4000); };

   21 | function fmtDate(d) {
   22 |   if (!d) return '—';
   23 |   try {
   24 |     const parts = d.split(/[-/]/);
   25 |     let date;
   26 |     if (parts.length === 3 && parts[0].length === 2) {
   27 |       date = new Date(`${parts[2]}-${parts[1]}-${parts[0]}`);
   28 |     } else {
   29 |       date = new Date(d);
   30 |     }
   31 |     if (isNaN(date)) return d;
   32 |     return date.toLocaleDateString('en-IN', { day: '2-digit', month: 'short', year: 'numeric' });
   33 |   } catch { return d; }
   34 | }

   80 | function getAccent(gradient) {
   81 |   if (!gradient) return ACCENT_COLORS.blue;
   82 |   if (gradient.includes('#8b5cf6') || gradient.includes('#7c3aed') || gradient.includes('#6366f1') || gradient.includes('#764ba2')) return ACCENT_COLORS.purple;
   83 |   if (gradient.includes('#10b981') || gradient.includes('#059669')) return ACCENT_COLORS.green;
   84 |   if (gradient.includes('#f59e0b') && !gradient.includes('#ef4444') && !gradient.includes('#dc2626')) return ACCENT_COLORS.amber;
   85 |   if (gradient.includes('#f97316') || gradient.includes('#ea580c')) return ACCENT_COLORS.orange;
   86 |   if (gradient.includes('#ec4899') || gradient.includes('#be185d')) return ACCENT_COLORS.pink;
   87 |   if (gradient.includes('#ef4444') || gradient.includes('#dc2626')) return ACCENT_COLORS.red;
   88 |   if (gradient.includes('#94a3b8') || gradient.includes('#64748b')) return ACCENT_COLORS.slate;
   89 |   return ACCENT_COLORS.blue;
   90 | }

  109 | function resolveIcon(icon, accentColor) {
  110 |   const color = accentColor || '#64748b';
  111 |   const map = {
  112 |     '👥': ICONS.users, '✅': ICONS.check, '⏳': ICONS.clock, '🎯': ICONS.target,
  113 |     '📄': ICONS.file, '📋': ICONS.clipboard, '✉️': ICONS.mail, '🔔': ICONS.bell,
  114 |     '⚠️': ICONS.alert, '🔄': ICONS.refresh, '🗂': ICONS.folder,
  115 |   };
  116 |   const fn = map[icon] || ICONS.file;
  117 |   return fn(color);
  118 | }

  144 |       {sub && <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: ac.sub, marginTop: 3, fontFamily: 'monospace' }}>{sub}</div>}
  145 |     </div>
  146 |   );

  149 | // ─── Section Header ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  175 | // ─── Pipeline Bar ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  176 | function PipelineBar({ stages }) {
  177 |   const total = stages.reduce((a, s) => a + s.count, 0) || 1;
  178 |   return (
  179 |     <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 10, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
  180 |       {stages.map(s => (
  181 |         <div key={s.label} style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 90 }}>
  182 |           <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', marginBottom: 7, alignItems: 'center' }}>
  183 |             <span style={{ fontSize: 11, color: '#6b7280', fontWeight: 500 }}>{s.label}</span>
  184 |             <span style={{
  185 |               fontWeight: 800, fontSize: 13, fontFamily: 'monospace',
  186 |               background: s.count > 0 ? s.color + '20' : 'transparent',
  187 |               color: s.count > 0 ? s.color : '#9ca3af',
  188 |               padding: '1px 7px', borderRadius: 6,
  189 |             }}>{s.count}</span>
  190 |           </div>
  191 |           <div style={{ height: 7, background: '#f1f5f9', borderRadius: 99, overflow: 'hidden' }}>
  192 |             <div style={{
  193 |               height: '100%', width: `${Math.max((s.count / total) * 100, s.count > 0 ? 5 : 0)}%`,
  194 |               background: s.color, borderRadius: 99, transition: 'width .6s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1)',
  195 |             }} />
  196 |           </div>
  197 |         </div>
  198 |       ))}
  199 |     </div>
  200 |   );
  201 | }
  202 | 
  203 | // ─── Card wrapper ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  204 | function Card({ children, style = {}, onClick }) {
  205 |   return (
  206 |     <div onClick={onClick} style={{
  207 |       background: '#fff', borderRadius: 16, border: '1px solid #f1f5f9',
  208 |       boxShadow: '0 1px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.06)',
  209 |       transition: onClick ? 'box-shadow .15s, transform .15s' : undefined,
  210 |       cursor: onClick ? 'pointer' : 'default',
  211 |       overflow: 'hidden',
  212 |       ...style,
  213 |     }}
  214 |       onMouseEnter={e => { if (onClick) { e.currentTarget.style.boxShadow = '0 4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.1)'; e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'translateY(-2px)'; } }}
  215 |       onMouseLeave={e => { if (onClick) { e.currentTarget.style.boxShadow = '0 1px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.06)'; e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'none'; } }}
  216 |     >
  217 |       {children}
  218 |     </div>
  219 |   );
  220 | }

  222 | // ─── Table ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  223 | function Table({ headers, rows }) {
  224 |   return (
  225 |     <div style={{ overflowX: 'auto' }}>
  226 |       <table style={{ width: '100%', borderCollapse: 'collapse', fontSize: 13 }}>
  227 |         <thead>
  228 |           <tr style={{ borderBottom: '1px solid #f1f5f9' }}>
  229 |             {headers.map(h => (
  230 |               <th key={h} style={{ padding: '10px 16px', textAlign: 'left', fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 700, color: '#9ca3af', textTransform: 'uppercase', letterSpacing: 0.8, whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>{h}</th>
  231 |             ))}
  232 |           </tr>
  233 |         </thead>
  234 |         <tbody>
  235 |           {rows.map((row, i) => (
  236 |             <tr key={i} style={{ borderBottom: '1px solid #f9fafb', transition: 'background .1s' }}
  237 |               onMouseEnter={e => e.currentTarget.style.background = '#fafafa'}
  238 |               onMouseLeave={e => e.currentTarget.style.background = 'transparent'}
  239 |             >
  240 |               {row.map((cell, j) => (
  241 |                 <td key={j} style={{ padding: '11px 16px', verticalAlign: 'middle' }}>{cell}</td>
  242 |               ))}
  243 |             </tr>
  244 |           ))}
  245 |         </tbody>
  246 |       </table>
  247 |     </div>
  248 |   );
  249 | }

  285 |         </button>

   65 |               {submitting ? 'Submitting…' : 'Resubmit for Review'}

   71 |               Reviewed on {new Date(submission.reviewed_at).toLocaleDateString('en-IN', { day: 'numeric', month: 'long', year: 'numeric' })}
   72 |             </div>

   84 | function DocCard({ doc, uploaded, isLoading, err, isLocked, isPending, onUpload, onView, onDelete, isOptional }) {
   85 |   const fileRef = useRef();
   86 |   const u = uploaded;
   87 | 
   88 |   const borderColor = u
   89 |     ? (isLocked ? 'rgba(63,207,142,0.5)' : 'rgba(63,207,142,0.4)')
   90 |     : err ? 'rgba(240,82,82,0.4)' : 'var(--border)';
   91 | 
   92 |   return (
   93 |     <div style={{
   94 |       background: 'var(--surface)', border: `1px solid ${borderColor}`,
   95 |       borderRadius: 'var(--radius)', padding: 14,
   96 |       display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 8,
   97 |       opacity: isPending && !u ? 0.7 : 1,
   98 |     }}>
   99 |       <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'flex-start' }}>
  100 |         <div>
  101 |           <div style={{ fontWeight: 600, fontSize: 13 }}>
  102 |             {doc.label}
  103 |             {doc.required && <span style={{ color: 'var(--red)', marginLeft: 4, fontSize: 11 }}>*</span>}
  104 |           </div>
  105 |           {u && <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: 'var(--green)', marginTop: 2 }}>✓ {u.filename}</div>}
  106 |           {err && !isOptional && <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: 'var(--red)', marginTop: 2 }}>{err}</div>}
  107 |           {err && isOptional && <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: 'var(--red)', marginTop: 2 }}>{err}</div>}
  108 |         </div>
  109 |         {u && <span style={{ fontSize: 18 }}>✅</span>}
  110 |       </div>
  111 | 
  112 |       <input
  113 |         ref={fileRef}
  114 |         type="file"
  115 |         accept={doc.accept}
  116 |         style={{ display: 'none' }}
  117 |         onChange={e => onUpload(doc.key, e.target.files[0])}
  118 |       />
  119 | 
  120 |       <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 6 }}>
  121 |         {!isPending && (!isLocked || (isOptional && !u)) && (
  122 |           <button
  123 |             className={`btn btn-sm ${u ? 'btn-secondary' : 'btn-primary'}`}
  124 |             onClick={() => fileRef.current?.click()}
  125 |             disabled={isLoading}
  126 |             style={{ flex: 1 }}
  127 |           >
  128 |             {isLoading ? 'Uploading…' : u ? '↻ Replace' : '⬆ Upload'}
  129 |           </button>
  130 |         )}
  131 | 
  132 |         {u?.url && (
  133 |           <button
  134 |             className="btn btn-sm btn-secondary"
  135 |             onClick={() => onView(u.url)}
  136 |             style={{ flex: isLocked || isPending ? 1 : 'unset' }}
  137 |           >
  138 |             View
  139 |           </button>
  140 |         )}
  141 | 
  142 |         {!isLocked && !isPending && u && (
  143 |           <button
  144 |             className="btn btn-sm btn-secondary"
  145 |             style={{ color: 'var(--red)', borderColor: 'rgba(240,82,82,.3)' }}
  146 |             onClick={() => onDelete(doc.key)}
  147 |           >
  148 |             🗑
  149 |           </button>
  150 |         )}
  151 |       </div>
  152 |     </div>
  153 |   );
  154 | }

  253 | function calcAge(dobStr) {
  254 |   if (!dobStr) return '';
  255 |   const dob = new Date(dobStr);
  256 |   if (isNaN(dob.getTime())) return '';
  257 |   const today = new Date();
  258 |   let age = today.getFullYear() - dob.getFullYear();
  259 |   const m = today.getMonth() - dob.getMonth();
  260 |   if (m < 0 || (m === 0 && today.getDate() < dob.getDate())) age--;
  261 |   return age >= 0 ? age : '';
  262 | }

  264 | // ── Section wrapper — visually matches existing .card styling ──────────────
  265 | function SectionCard({ title, children }) {
  266 |   return (
  267 |     <div className="card" style={{ marginBottom: 16, padding: 0, overflow: 'hidden' }}>
  268 |       <div className="card-header" style={{ padding: '12px 16px' }}>
  269 |         <div className="card-title" style={{ fontSize: 13 }}>{title}</div>
  270 |       </div>
  271 |       <div style={{ padding: 16 }}>{children}</div>
  272 |     </div>
  273 |   );
  274 | }
