  276 | // ── Generic repeatable table for Education / Work Experience / Dependents ──
  277 | function RepeatableTable({ title, columns, rows, onChange, readOnly, minRows = 0, errors = {} }) {
  278 |   const addRow = () => {
  279 |     const blank = {};
  280 |     columns.forEach(c => { blank[c.key] = ''; });
  281 |     onChange([...rows, blank]);
  282 |   };
  283 |   const removeRow = (idx) => {
  284 |     if (rows.length <= minRows) return;
  285 |     onChange(rows.filter((_, i) => i !== idx));
  286 |   };
  287 |   const setCell = (idx, key, val) => {
  288 |     const next = rows.map((r, i) => (i === idx ? { ...r, [key]: val } : r));
  289 |     onChange(next);
  290 |   };
  291 | 
  292 |   return (
  293 |     <SectionCard
  294 |       title={
  295 |         <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between' }}>
  296 |           <span>{title}</span>
  297 |           {!readOnly && (
  298 |             <button type="button" className="btn btn-sm btn-secondary" onClick={addRow} style={{ fontSize: 11 }}>
  299 |               + Add Row
  300 |             </button>
  301 |           )}
  302 |         </div>
  303 |       }
  304 |     >
  305 |       {rows.length === 0 ? (
  306 |         <div style={{ fontSize: 12, color: 'var(--text-dim)', fontStyle: 'italic', padding: '4px 0' }}>
  307 |           No entries added{minRows > 0 ? ' yet — add at least one row.' : '.'}
  308 |         </div>
  309 |       ) : (
  310 |         <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 12 }}>
  311 |           {rows.map((row, idx) => (
  312 |             <div
  313 |               key={idx}
  314 |               style={{
  315 |                 display: 'grid',
  316 |                 gridTemplateColumns: `repeat(${columns.length}, 1fr) ${readOnly ? '' : 'auto'}`,
  317 |                 gap: 10, alignItems: 'end',
  318 |                 padding: '10px', background: 'var(--surface-2)', borderRadius: 8,
  319 |               }}
  320 |             >
  321 |               {columns.map(col => {
  322 |                 const errKey = `${title}_${idx}_${col.key}`;
  323 |                 return (
  324 |                   <div key={col.key} className="form-group" style={{ margin: 0 }}>
  325 |                     <label className="form-label" style={{ fontSize: 10 }}>
  326 |                       {col.label}{col.required && <span style={{ color: 'var(--red)', marginLeft: 3 }}>*</span>}
  327 |                     </label>
  328 |                     <input
  329 |                       type={col.type} value={row[col.key] || ''}
  330 |                       onChange={e => !readOnly && setCell(idx, col.key, e.target.value)}
  331 |                       placeholder={col.placeholder} disabled={readOnly}
  332 |                       style={{ borderColor: errors[errKey] ? 'var(--red)' : undefined, opacity: readOnly ? 0.75 : 1 }}
  333 |                     />
  334 |                   </div>
  335 |                 );
  336 |               })}
  337 |               {!readOnly && (
  338 |                 <button
  339 |                   type="button" className="btn btn-sm btn-secondary"
  340 |                   onClick={() => removeRow(idx)}
  341 |                   disabled={rows.length <= minRows}
  342 |                   style={{ fontSize: 11, height: 34 }}
  343 |                 >
  344 |                   ✕
  345 |                 </button>
  346 |               )}
  347 |             </div>
  348 |           ))}
  349 |         </div>
  350 |       )}
  351 |     </SectionCard>
  352 |   );
  353 | }
  354 | 
  355 | function Step1Form({ onComplete, userId, readOnly = false, onBack }) {
  356 |   const { user } = useAuth();
  357 |   const STEP1_KEY = getStep1Key(userId);
  358 |   const saved = (() => { try { return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(STEP1_KEY) || '{}'); } catch { return {}; } })();
  359 | 
  360 |   // Ensure table sections always have an initial row set (min rows for education)
  361 |   const withDefaults = (data) => {
  362 |     const next = { ...data };
  363 |     TABLE_SECTIONS.forEach(sec => {
  364 |       if (!Array.isArray(next[sec.key])) {
  365 |         next[sec.key] = sec.minRows > 0 ? [Object.fromEntries(sec.columns.map(c => [c.key, '']))] : [];
  366 |       }
  367 |     });
  368 |     return next;
  369 |   };
  370 | 
  371 |   const [form, setForm] = useState(withDefaults(saved));
  372 |   const [errors, setErrors] = useState({});
  373 |   const [submitted, setSubmitted] = useState(false);
  374 | 
  375 |   const set = (k, v) => setForm(p => ({ ...p, [k]: v }));
  376 |   const setTable = (key, rows) => setForm(p => ({ ...p, [key]: rows }));
  377 | 
  378 |   const allSimpleFields = SIMPLE_SECTIONS.flatMap(s => s.fields);
  379 | 
  380 |   const validate = () => {
  381 |     const errs = {};
  382 |     const isRepetitive = (s) => /^(.)\1+$/.test(s);
  383 |     const isConsecutive = (s) => {
  384 |       for (let i = 0; i < s.length - 1; i++) {
  385 |         if (Math.abs(s.charCodeAt(i + 1) - s.charCodeAt(i)) !== 1) return false;
  386 |       }
  387 |       return true;
  388 |     };
  389 | 
  390 |     allSimpleFields.forEach(f => {
  391 |       const v = (form[f.key] || '').trim();
  392 |       if (f.required && !v) { errs[f.key] = 'Required'; return; }
  393 |       if (!v) return;
  394 |       const stripped = v.replace(/\s/g, '');
  395 |       if (f.pattern && !f.pattern.test(stripped)) { errs[f.key] = 'Invalid format'; return; }
  396 |       if (f.key === 'aadhaar_number') {
  397 |         const digits = stripped;
  398 |         if (!/^\d{12}$/.test(digits)) { errs[f.key] = 'Must be exactly 12 digits'; return; }
  399 |         if (isRepetitive(digits)) { errs[f.key] = 'Invalid Aadhaar number'; return; }
  400 |         if (isConsecutive(digits)) { errs[f.key] = 'Invalid Aadhaar number'; return; }
  401 |         if (/^[01]/.test(digits)) { errs[f.key] = 'Aadhaar cannot start with 0 or 1'; return; }
  402 |       }
  403 |       if (f.key === 'phone') {
  404 |         if (!/^[6-9]\d{9}$/.test(stripped)) { errs[f.key] = 'Enter a valid 10-digit mobile number'; return; }
  405 |         if (isRepetitive(stripped)) { errs[f.key] = 'Invalid mobile number'; return; }
  406 |         if (isConsecutive(stripped)) { errs[f.key] = 'Invalid mobile number'; return; }
  407 |       }
  408 |       if (f.key === 'pan_number') {
  409 |         if (isRepetitive(stripped.slice(0, 5))) { errs[f.key] = 'Invalid PAN number'; return; }
  410 |       }
  411 |       if (f.key === 'account_number') {
  412 |         if (!/^\d{9,18}$/.test(stripped)) { errs[f.key] = 'Account number must be 9–18 digits'; return; }
  413 |         if (isRepetitive(stripped)) { errs[f.key] = 'Invalid account number'; return; }
  414 |       }
  415 |       if (f.key === 'dob' && v) {
  416 |         const dob = new Date(v);
  417 |         const today = new Date();
  418 |         const age = (today - dob) / (365.25 * 24 * 3600 * 1000);
  419 |         if (isNaN(dob.getTime())) { errs[f.key] = 'Invalid date'; return; }
  420 |         if (age < 16) { errs[f.key] = 'Age must be at least 16'; return; }
  421 |         if (age > 75) { errs[f.key] = 'Check date of birth'; return; }
  422 |       }
  423 |     });
  424 | 
  425 |     // Table section validation
  426 |     TABLE_SECTIONS.forEach(sec => {
  427 |       const rows = form[sec.key] || [];
  428 |       if (sec.minRows > 0 && rows.length < sec.minRows) {
  429 |         errs[`${sec.key}__rows`] = `Add at least ${sec.minRows} entry`;
  430 |       }
  431 |       rows.forEach((row, idx) => {
  432 |         sec.columns.forEach(col => {
  433 |           const v = (row[col.key] || '').toString().trim();
  434 |           if (col.required && !v) {
  435 |             errs[`${sec.title}_${idx}_${col.key}`] = 'Required';
  436 |           }
  437 |         });
  438 |       });
  439 |     });
  440 | 
  441 |     return errs;
  442 |   };
  443 | 
  444 |   const submit = (e) => {
  445 |     e.preventDefault();
  446 |     setSubmitted(true);
  447 |     const errs = validate();
  448 |     setErrors(errs);
  449 |     if (Object.keys(errs).length > 0) return;
  450 | 
  451 |     // Build a joined single-line address for downstream consumers (letters, HR view)
  452 |     const address = [form.address_line1, form.address_line2, form.city, form.state, form.postal_code, form.country]
  453 |       .filter(Boolean).join(', ');
  454 | 
  455 |     const payload = { ...form, full_name: user?.name || '', email: user?.email || '', address };
  456 |     localStorage.setItem(STEP1_KEY, JSON.stringify(payload));
  457 |     axios.post('/api/employees/me/step1', payload).catch(() => { });
  458 |     onComplete(payload);
  459 |   };
  460 | 
  461 |   const fieldErr = (k) => submitted && errors[k];
  462 |   const age = calcAge(form.dob);
  463 | 
  464 |   return (
  465 |     <div style={{ maxWidth: 900, margin: '0 auto' }}>
  466 |       <div style={{ marginBottom: 24 }}>
  467 |         <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'flex-start', justifyContent: 'space-between' }}>
  468 |           <h1 style={{ fontFamily: 'var(--display)', fontSize: 22, fontWeight: 800, margin: 0 }}>
  469 |             📋 Step 1 — Personal Information
  470 |           </h1>
  471 |           {readOnly && (
  472 |             <button type="button" className="btn btn-secondary" onClick={() => onBack?.()} style={{ fontSize: 13, whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>
  473 |               ← Back to Documents
  474 |             </button>
  475 |           )}
  476 |         </div>
  477 |         {readOnly ? (
  478 |           <div style={{ marginTop: 10, padding: '10px 14px', background: 'rgba(63,207,142,.08)', border: '1px solid rgba(63,207,142,.25)', borderRadius: 8, fontSize: 13, color: 'var(--green)' }}>
  479 |             ✅ Your documents have been approved. This information is locked and cannot be edited.
  480 |           </div>
  481 |         ) : (
  482 |           <div style={{ color: 'var(--text-dim)', fontSize: 13, marginTop: 4 }}>
  483 |             Fill in your details accurately before uploading documents. These will be cross-verified with your uploaded files.
  484 |           </div>
  485 |         )}
  486 |       </div>
  487 | 
  488 |       <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 0, marginBottom: 28 }}>
  489 |         {['Personal Info', 'Upload Documents'].map((label, i) => (
  490 |           <div key={i} style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', flex: 1 }}>
  491 |             <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8 }}>
  492 |               <div style={{
  493 |                 width: 28, height: 28, borderRadius: '50%', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center',
  494 |                 justifyContent: 'center', fontWeight: 700, fontSize: 12, flexShrink: 0,
  495 |                 background: i === 0 ? 'var(--accent)' : 'var(--surface-2)',
  496 |                 color: i === 0 ? '#fff' : 'var(--text-dim)',
  497 |               }}>{i + 1}</div>
  498 |               <span style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: i === 0 ? 700 : 400, color: i === 0 ? 'var(--text)' : 'var(--text-dim)' }}>{label}</span>
  499 |             </div>
  500 |             {i === 0 && <div style={{ flex: 1, height: 2, background: 'var(--border)', margin: '0 12px' }} />}
  501 |           </div>
  502 |         ))}
  503 |       </div>
  504 | 
  505 |       <form onSubmit={submit} noValidate>
  506 | 
  507 |         {/* ── Section 1: Basic Information (auto-fetched, read-only) ── */}
  508 |         <SectionCard title="Basic Information">
  509 |           <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1fr', gap: 16 }}>
  510 |             <div className="form-group" style={{ margin: 0 }}>
  511 |               <label className="form-label">Full Name</label>
  512 |               <input type="text" value={user?.name || ''} disabled style={{ opacity: 0.75 }} />
  513 |             </div>
  514 |             <div className="form-group" style={{ margin: 0 }}>
  515 |               <label className="form-label">Email</label>
  516 |               <input type="text" value={user?.email || ''} disabled style={{ opacity: 0.75 }} />
  517 |             </div>
  518 |           </div>
  519 |         </SectionCard>
  520 | 
  521 |         {/* ── Sections 2–6: simple grouped fields ── */}
  522 |         {SIMPLE_SECTIONS.map(section => (
  523 |           <SectionCard key={section.title} title={section.title}>
  524 |             <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1fr', gap: 16 }}>
  525 |               {section.fields.map(f => (
  526 |                 <div key={f.key} className="form-group" style={{ margin: 0 }}>
  527 |                   <label className="form-label">
  528 |                     {f.label}{f.required && <span style={{ color: 'var(--red)', marginLeft: 3 }}>*</span>}
  529 |                   </label>
  530 |                   <input
  531 |                     type={f.type} value={form[f.key] || ''}
  532 |                     onChange={e => {
  533 |                       if (readOnly) return;
  534 |                       const UPPER_KEYS = ['pan_number', 'aadhaar_number', 'ifsc_code'];
  535 |                       const val = e.target.value;
  536 |                       set(f.key, UPPER_KEYS.includes(f.key) ? val.toUpperCase() : val);
  537 |                     }}
  538 |                     placeholder={f.placeholder} disabled={readOnly}
  539 |                     style={{ borderColor: fieldErr(f.key) ? 'var(--red)' : undefined, opacity: readOnly ? 0.75 : 1 }}
  540 |                   />
  541 |                   {fieldErr(f.key) && <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: 'var(--red)', marginTop: 3 }}>{errors[f.key]}</div>}
  542 |                 </div>
  543 |               ))}
  544 |               {section.title === 'Personal Details' && (
  545 |                 <div className="form-group" style={{ margin: 0 }}>
  546 |                   <label className="form-label">Age</label>
  547 |                   <input type="text" value={age} disabled style={{ opacity: 0.75 }} />
  548 |                 </div>
  549 |               )}
  550 |             </div>
  551 |           </SectionCard>
  552 |         ))}
  553 | 
  554 |         {/* ── Sections 7–9: repeatable tables ── */}
  555 |         {TABLE_SECTIONS.map(sec => (
  556 |           <RepeatableTable
  557 |             key={sec.key}
  558 |             title={sec.title}
  559 |             columns={sec.columns}
  560 |             rows={form[sec.key] || []}
  561 |             onChange={(rows) => setTable(sec.key, rows)}
  562 |             readOnly={readOnly}
  563 |             minRows={sec.minRows}
  564 |             errors={submitted ? errors : {}}
  565 |           />
  566 |         ))}
  567 | 
  568 |         <div style={{ marginTop: 24, display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'flex-end' }}>
  569 |           {!readOnly && (
  570 |             <button type="submit" className="btn btn-primary" style={{ minWidth: 200, padding: '12px 0' }}>Save & Continue to Step 2 →</button>
  571 |           )}
  572 |         </div>
  573 |       </form>
  574 |     </div>
  575 |   );
  576 | }

  598 |   const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);

  966 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  967 | // HRReviewModal
  968 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  969 | 
  970 | function HRReviewModal({ submission, onClose, onDone }) {
  971 |   const [fullSub, setFullSub] = useState(null);
  972 |   const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  973 |   const [action, setAction] = useState('');
  974 |   const [remarks, setRemarks] = useState('');
  975 |   const [submitting, setSub] = useState(false);
  976 |   const [error, setError] = useState('');
  977 |   const docs = fullSub?.docs || [];
  978 | 
  979 |   useEffect(() => {
  980 |     setLoading(true);
  981 |     axios.get(`/api/documents/submissions/${submission._id}`)
  982 |       .then(r => setFullSub(r.data))
  983 |       .catch(() => setError('Failed to load submission details.'))
  984 |       .finally(() => setLoading(false));
  985 |   }, [submission._id]);
  986 | 
  987 |   const viewDoc = async (url) => {
  988 |     try {
  989 |       const r = await axios.get(url, { responseType: 'blob' });
  990 |       window.open(URL.createObjectURL(r.data), '_blank');
  991 |     } catch { alert('Could not open file.'); }
  992 |   };
  993 | 
  994 |   const submit = async () => {
  995 |     if (action === 'reject' && !remarks.trim()) { setError('Remarks are required for rejection.'); return; }
  996 |     setSub(true); setError('');
  997 |     try {
  998 |       await axios.post(`/api/documents/submissions/${submission._id}/action`, { action, remarks });
  999 |       onDone(`Documents ${action === 'approve' ? 'approved' : 'rejected'} successfully.`);
 1000 |     } catch (e) {
 1001 |       setError(e.response?.data?.error || 'Action failed.');
 1002 |       setSub(false);
 1003 |     }

  745 | /** Normalise any date value to YYYY-MM-DD so <input type="date"> shows it.
  746 |  *  Handles: "2026-05-06", "2026-05-06T00:00:00.000Z", "06-05-2026", "06/05/2026" */
  747 | function toInputDate(val) {
  748 |   if (!val) return '';
  749 |   const s = String(val).trim();
  750 |   // Already ISO date string YYYY-MM-DD (with optional time)
  751 |   if (/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}/.test(s)) return s.slice(0, 10);
  752 |   // DD-MM-YYYY or DD/MM/YYYY
  753 |   const m = s.match(/^(\d{2})[-/](\d{2})[-/](\d{4})$/);
  754 |   if (m) return `${m[3]}-${m[2]}-${m[1]}`;
  755 |   // Fallback: let Date parse it
  756 |   try {
  757 |     const d = new Date(s);
  758 |     if (!isNaN(d)) return d.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  759 |   } catch { /* */ }
  760 |   return '';
  761 | }

  763 | function EditModal({ emp, onClose, onDone }) {
  764 |   const step1 = emp.step1_data || {};
  765 |   // letter_context is populated by the Edit button's fresh GET /api/employees/:id
  766 |   // which now returns the latest letter context via serialize()
  767 |   const ctx = emp.letter_context || {};
  768 |   const merged = {
  769 |     ...emp,
  770 |     email: emp.email || ctx.email || step1.email || step1.personal_email || emp.login_email || emp.work_email || '',
  771 |     department: emp.department || ctx.department || '',
  772 |     ctc: emp.ctc || ctx.ctc || '',
  773 |     joining_date: toInputDate(emp.joining_date || ctx.joining_date || step1.date_of_joining || ''),
  774 |     phone: emp.phone || step1.phone || '',
  775 |     date_of_birth: toInputDate(emp.date_of_birth || step1.dob || step1.date_of_birth || ''),
  776 |     address: emp.address || step1.address || step1.postal_address || step1.permanent_address || '',
  777 |   };
  778 |   const [form, setForm] = useState(merged);
  779 |   const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  780 |   const [error, setError] = useState('');
  781 |   const [managers, setManagers] = useState([]);
  782 | 
  783 |   useEffect(() => {
  784 |     axios.get('/api/auth/users?role=manager')
  785 |       .then(r => setManagers(r.data))
  786 |       .catch(() => setManagers([]));
  787 |   }, []);
  788 | 
  789 |   const submit = async (e) => {
  790 |     e.preventDefault(); setError(''); setLoading(true);
  791 |     try {
  792 |       await axios.put(`/api/employees/${emp._id}`, form);
  793 |       onDone('Employee updated.');
  794 |     } catch (err) {
  795 |       setError(err.response?.data?.error || 'Update failed');
  796 |       setLoading(false);
  797 |     }
  798 |   };
  799 | 
  800 |   return (
  801 |     <div className="modal-overlay" onClick={e => e.target === e.currentTarget && onClose()}>

  818 |           </div>

  214 | // ─── EMPLOYEE VIEW ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  215 | 
  216 | function EmployeeExitView() {
  217 |   const [myStatus, setMyStatus] = useState(null);
  218 |   const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  219 |   const [showResign, setShowResign] = useState(false);
  220 |   const [downloading, setDownloading] = useState(false);
  221 |   const [docsApproved, setDocsApproved] = useState(false);
  222 | 
  223 |   const load = () => {
  224 |     setLoading(true);
  225 |     Promise.all([
  226 |       axios.get('/api/exit/my-status'),
  227 |       axios.get('/api/documents/my'),
  228 |     ]).then(([exitRes, docsRes]) => {
  229 |       setMyStatus(exitRes.data);
  230 |       setDocsApproved(docsRes.data?.submission?.status === 'approved');
  231 |     }).catch(() => { }).finally(() => setLoading(false));
  232 |   };
  233 | 
  234 |   useEffect(() => { load(); }, []);
  235 | 
  236 |   const download = async (fmt) => {
  237 |     if (!myStatus?.relieving_letter_id) return;
  238 |     setDownloading(true);
  239 |     try {
  240 |       const r = await axios.get(`/api/exit/relieving/${myStatus.relieving_letter_id}/download?format=${fmt}`, { responseType: 'blob' });
  241 |       const url = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([r.data]));
  242 |       const a = document.createElement('a'); a.href = url;
  243 |       a.download = `relieving_letter.${fmt}`; a.click();
  244 |       URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  245 |     } catch { alert('Download failed. Please try again.'); }
  246 |     finally { setDownloading(false); }
  247 |   };
  248 | 
  249 |   if (loading) return <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', padding: 60, color: 'var(--text-dim)' }}>Loading…</div>;
  250 | 
  251 |   return (
  252 |     <div>
  253 |       <div className="page-header">
  254 |         <div>
  255 |           <h1 className="page-title">Exit & Relieving</h1>
  256 |           <p className="page-subtitle">Submit your resignation request</p>
  257 |         </div>
  258 |       </div>
  259 | 
  260 |       <MyResignationStatus
  261 |         myStatus={myStatus}
  262 |         onResign={() => setShowResign(true)}
  263 |         onDownload={download}
  264 |         downloading={downloading}
  265 |         docsApproved={docsApproved}
  266 |       />
  267 | 
  268 |       {showResign && (
  269 |         <EmployeeResignModal onClose={() => setShowResign(false)} onDone={() => { setShowResign(false); load(); }} />
  270 |       )}
  271 |     </div>
  272 |   );

  479 | function HRExitView() {
  480 |   const [employees, setEmployees] = useState([]);
  481 |   const [relievingTpls, setRelievingTpls] = useState([]);
  482 |   const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  483 |   const [filterStatus, setFilterStatus] = useState('');
  484 |   const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  485 |   const [clearTarget, setClearTarget] = useState(null);
  486 |   const [relTarget, setRelTarget] = useState(null);
  487 |   const [success, setSuccess] = useState('');
  488 | 
  489 |   const load = () => {
  490 |     setLoading(true);
  491 |     Promise.all([
  492 |       axios.get('/api/exit/'),
  493 |       axios.get('/api/templates/?type=relieving'),
  494 |     ]).then(([e, t]) => {
  495 |       setEmployees(e.data);
  496 |       setRelievingTpls(t.data.filter(x => x.is_active));
  497 |     }).finally(() => setLoading(false));
  498 |   };
  499 | 
  500 |   useEffect(() => { load(); }, []);
  501 | 
  502 |   const notify = (msg) => { setSuccess(msg); load(); setTimeout(() => setSuccess(''), 5000); };
  503 | 
  504 |   const counts = useMemo(() =>
  505 |     employees.reduce((acc, e) => {
  506 |       if (acc[e.status] !== undefined) acc[e.status]++;
  507 |       return acc;
  508 |     }, { notice_period: 0, clearance_pending: 0, clearance_complete: 0, exited: 0 }),

  511 |

  513 |     employees

  515 |       .filter(e => !search || e.name?.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()) || e.employee_id?.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase())),
  516 |     [employees, filterStatus, search]
  517 |   );
  518 | 
  519 |   return (
  520 |     <div>
  521 |       <div className="page-header">
  522 |         <div>

  529 | 
  530 |       {/* Pipeline summary */}
  531 |       <div className="card" style={{ padding: '16px 20px', marginBottom: 20 }}>
  532 |         <div style={{ fontSize: 10, fontFamily: 'var(--mono)', color: 'var(--text-dim)', textTransform: 'uppercase', letterSpacing: 1, marginBottom: 12 }}>Exit Pipeline — Compliance Gate Active</div>
  533 |         <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'stretch', gap: 0 }}>
  534 |           {[
  535 |             { label: 'Notice Period', count: counts.notice_period, color: 'var(--amber)' },
  536 |             { label: 'Clearance', count: counts.clearance_pending, color: 'var(--amber)' },
  537 |             { label: 'All Cleared', count: counts.clearance_complete, color: 'var(--accent)' },
  538 |             { label: 'Exited', count: counts.exited, color: 'var(--green)' },
  539 |           ].map((step, i, arr) => (
  540 |             <div key={step.label} style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', flex: 1 }}>
  541 |               <div style={{ flex: 1, padding: '10px 14px', background: 'var(--surface-2)', border: '1px solid var(--border)', borderRadius: 8, textAlign: 'center' }}>
  542 |                 <div style={{ fontSize: 22, fontWeight: 800, color: step.color }}>{step.count}</div>
  543 |                 <div style={{ fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 600, color: step.color }}>{step.label}</div>

  667 | // ─── Clearance Panel (HR only) ────────────────────────────────────────────────
  668 | 
  669 | function ClearancePanel({ emp, onUpdate, onClose }) {
  670 |   const [clearances, setClearances] = useState(emp.clearances || {});
  671 |   const [saving, setSaving] = useState(null);
  672 |   const [error, setError] = useState('');
  673 |   const days = daysUntil(emp.last_working_day);
  674 |   const done = CLEARANCE_ITEMS.filter(i => clearances[i.key]).length;
  675 |   const total = CLEARANCE_ITEMS.length;
  676 |   const pct = Math.round((done / total) * 100);
  677 | 
  678 |   const toggle = async (key, newVal) => {
  679 |     setSaving(key); setError('');
  680 |     try {
  681 |       const res = await axios.post(`/api/exit/${emp._id}/clearance`, { [key]: newVal });
  682 |       setClearances(prev => ({ ...prev, [key]: newVal }));
  683 |       if (res.data.all_cleared) onUpdate('all_cleared');
  684 |       else onUpdate('updated');
  685 |     } catch (err) {
  686 |       setError(err.response?.data?.error || 'Update failed');
  687 |     } finally { setSaving(null); }
  688 |   };
  689 | 
  690 |   return (
  691 |     <div className="modal-overlay" onClick={e => e.target === e.currentTarget && onClose()}>
  692 |       <div className="modal" style={{ maxWidth: 520 }} onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()}>
  693 |         <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'flex-start', marginBottom: 20 }}>
  694 |           <div>
  695 |             <h2 className="modal-title" style={{ margin: 0 }}>Clearance Checklist</h2>
  696 |             <p style={{ fontSize: 12, color: 'var(--text-dim)', marginTop: 4 }}>{emp.name} · {emp.employee_id}</p>
  697 |           </div>
  698 |           <div style={{ textAlign: 'right' }}>
  699 |             <div style={{ fontSize: 24, fontWeight: 800, color: pct === 100 ? 'var(--green)' : pct > 50 ? 'var(--amber)' : 'var(--red)' }}>{pct}%</div>
  700 |             <div style={{ fontSize: 10, color: 'var(--text-dim)', fontFamily: 'var(--mono)' }}>{done}/{total}</div>
  701 |           </div>
  702 |         </div>
  703 | 
  704 |         {emp.last_working_day && (
  705 |           <div style={{ background: days !== null && days <= 3 ? 'var(--red-dim)' : 'var(--surface-2)', border: `1px solid ${days !== null && days <= 3 ? 'rgba(240,82,82,.3)' : 'var(--border)'}`, borderRadius: 8, padding: '10px 14px', display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', marginBottom: 16 }}>
  706 |             <div>
  707 |               <div style={{ fontSize: 10, fontFamily: 'var(--mono)', color: 'var(--text-dim)', textTransform: 'uppercase', marginBottom: 2 }}>Last Working Day</div>
  708 |               <div style={{ fontWeight: 600 }}>{emp.last_working_day}</div>
  709 |             </div>
  710 |             {days !== null && <div style={{ fontSize: 12, fontFamily: 'var(--mono)', color: days <= 3 ? 'var(--red)' : days <= 7 ? 'var(--amber)' : 'var(--text-dim)' }}>{days > 0 ? `${days} days left` : days === 0 ? 'Today' : `${Math.abs(days)}d overdue`}</div>}
  711 |           </div>
  712 |         )}
  713 | 
  714 |         <div style={{ height: 8, background: 'var(--border)', borderRadius: 99, overflow: 'hidden', marginBottom: 20 }}>
  715 |           <div style={{ height: '100%', borderRadius: 99, width: `${pct}%`, background: pct === 100 ? 'var(--green)' : pct > 50 ? 'var(--amber)' : 'var(--red)', transition: 'width .4s' }} />
  716 |         </div>
  717 | 
  718 |         {error && <div className="alert alert-error">{error}</div>}
  719 | 
  720 |         <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 8, marginBottom: 20 }}>
  721 |           {CLEARANCE_ITEMS.map(item => {
  722 |             const ok = clearances[item.key] === true;
  723 |             const busy = saving === item.key;
  724 |             return (
  725 |               <div key={item.key} onClick={() => !busy && toggle(item.key, !ok)}
  726 |                 style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 14, padding: '12px 16px', borderRadius: 8, background: ok ? 'var(--green-dim)' : 'var(--surface-2)', border: `1px solid ${ok ? 'rgba(63,207,142,.25)' : 'var(--border)'}`, cursor: busy ? 'wait' : 'pointer', opacity: busy ? .6 : 1, transition: 'all .2s' }}>
  727 |                 <div style={{ width: 22, height: 22, borderRadius: 6, flexShrink: 0, background: ok ? 'var(--green)' : 'var(--surface)', border: `1.5px solid ${ok ? 'var(--green)' : 'var(--border-bright)'}`, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', fontSize: 12, color: 'white' }}>
  728 |                   {busy ? '…' : ok ? '✓' : ''}
  729 |                 </div>
  730 |                 <span style={{ fontSize: 16, opacity: .7 }}>{item.icon}</span>
  731 |                 <div style={{ flex: 1 }}>
  732 |                   <div style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 600, color: ok ? 'var(--green)' : 'var(--text)' }}>{item.label}</div>
  733 |                   <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: 'var(--text-dim)' }}>{item.desc}</div>
  734 |                 </div>
  735 |                 <span style={{ fontSize: 10, fontFamily: 'var(--mono)', padding: '2px 8px', borderRadius: 99, background: ok ? 'rgba(63,207,142,.15)' : 'var(--border)', color: ok ? 'var(--green)' : 'var(--text-dim)' }}>
  736 |                   {ok ? 'CLEARED' : 'PENDING'}
  737 |                 </span>
  738 |               </div>
  739 |             );
  740 |           })}
  741 |         </div>
  742 | 
  743 |         {pct === 100 ? (
  744 |           <div style={{ background: 'var(--green-dim)', border: '1px solid rgba(63,207,142,.3)', borderRadius: 8, padding: '10px 14px', fontSize: 12, color: 'var(--green)', marginBottom: 16 }}>
  745 |             ✓ All clearances complete. Relieving letter generation is now unlocked.
  746 |           </div>
  747 |         ) : (
  748 |           <div style={{ background: 'var(--red-dim)', border: '1px solid rgba(240,82,82,.2)', borderRadius: 8, padding: '10px 14px', fontSize: 12, color: 'var(--red)', marginBottom: 16 }}>
  749 |             ✕ {total - done} clearance{total - done !== 1 ? 's' : ''} remaining before relieving letter can be generated.
  750 |           </div>
  751 |         )}
  752 | 
  753 |         <div className="modal-footer"><button className="btn btn-secondary" onClick={onClose}>Close</button></div>
  754 |       </div>
  755 |     </div>
  756 |   );

  761 | const PLACEHOLDER_LABELS = {
  762 |   employee_name: 'Employee Name',
  763 |   employee_id: 'Employee ID',
  764 |   designation: 'Designation',
  765 |   department: 'Department',
  766 |   joining_date: 'Date of Joining',
  767 |   last_working_day: 'Last Working Day',
  768 |   resignation_date: 'Resignation Date',
  769 |   exit_reason: 'Exit Reason',

  773 | // ─── Relieving Letter Modal (HR only) ────────────────────────────────────────
  774 | //
  775 | // Flow:
  776 | //   1. HR selects template  → auto-calls /preview with employee data
  777 | //   2a. All fields filled   → PDF preview rendered immediately
  778 | //   2b. Fields missing      → inline form shown for just the missing fields
  779 | //   3. HR fills missing     → clicks "Preview Again" → re-calls /preview with extra_fields
  780 | //   4. Preview looks good   → HR fills email → clicks "Generate"
  781 | 
  782 | function RelievingModal({ emp, templates, onClose, onDone }) {
  783 |   const [templateId, setTemplateId] = useState('');
  784 |   const [candidateEmail, setCandidateEmail] = useState(emp.email || emp.login_email || '');
  785 |   const [extraFields, setExtraFields] = useState({});// HR-filled missing values
  786 |   const [missingFields, setMissingFields] = useState([]);   // keys backend said were empty
  787 |   const [previewing, setPreviewing] = useState(false);
  788 |   const [previewUrl, setPreviewUrl] = useState(null);
  789 |   const [previewError, setPreviewError] = useState('');
  790 |   const [generating, setGenerating] = useState(false);
  791 |   const [genError, setGenError] = useState('');
  792 | 
  793 |   // Auto-fetch login email if not already on emp object
  794 |   useEffect(() => {
  795 |     if (!candidateEmail && emp._id) {
  796 |       axios.get(`/api/exit/${emp._id}/login-email`)
  797 |         .then(r => { if (r.data.email) setCandidateEmail(r.data.email); })
  798 |         .catch(() => { });
  799 |     }
  800 |   }, [emp._id]);
  801 | 
  802 |   // ── Call /preview — handles both step 1 (initial) and step 2 (after fill) ─
  803 |   const triggerPreview = async (tid, extra = {}) => {
  804 | 
  805 |     if (!tid) return;
  806 |     setPreviewing(true);
  807 |     setPreviewUrl(null);
  808 |     setPreviewError('');
  809 |     setMissingFields([]);
  810 | 
  811 |     try {
  812 |       const token = localStorage.getItem('token');
  813 |       const res = await fetch('/api/exit/relieving/preview', {
  814 |         method: 'POST',
  815 |         headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` },
  816 |         body: JSON.stringify({ employee_id: emp._id, template_id: tid, extra_fields: extra }),
  817 |       });
  818 | 
  819 |       if (res.status === 422) {
  820 |         // Backend found unfilled placeholders — show fill-in form
  821 |         const d = await res.json();
  822 |         setMissingFields(d.missing_fields || []);
  823 |         // Pre-fill extraFields with whatever the backend already resolved
  824 |         setExtraFields(prev => {
  825 |           const merged = { ...(d.current_ctx || {}), ...prev };
  826 |           // Keep only the missing keys so the form is minimal
  827 |           const filtered = {};
  828 |           (d.missing_fields || []).forEach(k => { filtered[k] = merged[k] || ''; });
  829 |           return { ...prev, ...filtered };
  830 |         });
  831 |         return;
  832 |       }
  833 | 
  834 |       if (!res.ok) {
  835 |         const d = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
  836 |         setPreviewError(d.error || 'Preview failed. Check employee record.');
  837 |         return;
  838 |       }
  839 | 
  840 |       const blob = await res.blob();
  841 |       setPreviewUrl(URL.createObjectURL(blob));
  842 |     } catch (e) {
  843 |       setPreviewError('Preview generation failed.');
  844 |     } finally {
  845 |       setPreviewing(false);
  846 |     }
  847 |   };
  848 | 
  849 |   // ── Template selector ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  850 |   const handleTemplateChange = (tid) => {
  851 |     setTemplateId(tid);
  852 |     setExtraFields({});
  853 |     setMissingFields([]);
  854 |     triggerPreview(tid, {});
  855 |   };
  856 | 
  857 |   // Auto-select template if only one exists
  858 |   useEffect(() => {
  859 |     if (templates.length === 1 && !templateId) {
  860 |       handleTemplateChange(templates[0]._id);
  861 |     }
  862 |   }, [templates]);
  863 | 
  864 |   // ── HR filled missing fields → re-preview ───────────────────────────────
  865 |   const handleRePreview = () => {
  866 |     // Validate all missing fields are filled
  867 |     const empty = missingFields.filter(k => !String(extraFields[k] || '').trim());
  868 |     if (empty.length) {
  869 |       setPreviewError(`Please fill in: ${empty.map(k => PLACEHOLDER_LABELS[k] || k).join(', ')}`);
  870 |       return;
  871 |     }
  872 |     setPreviewError('');
  873 |     triggerPreview(templateId, extraFields);
  874 |   };
  875 | 
  876 |   // ── Final generate ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  877 |   const handleGenerate = async (e) => {
  878 |     e.preventDefault();
  879 |     if (!previewUrl) { setGenError('Please preview the letter first.'); return; }
  880 |     setGenError(''); setGenerating(true);
  881 |     try {
  882 |       await axios.post('/api/exit/relieving/generate', {
  883 |         employee_id: emp._id,
  884 |         template_id: templateId,
  885 |         candidate_email: candidateEmail,
  886 |         extra_fields: extraFields,
  887 |       });
  888 |       onDone(`Relieving letter generated for ${emp.name}. Employee status updated to Exited.`);
  889 |     } catch (err) {
  890 |       const d = err.response?.data;
  891 |       setGenError(d?.missing_clearances
  892 |         ? `Missing clearances: ${d.missing_clearances.join(', ')}`
  893 |         : d?.error || 'Generation failed');
  894 |     } finally { setGenerating(false); }
  895 |   };
  896 | 
  897 |   const hasPreview = !!previewUrl;
  898 |   const hasMissing = missingFields.length > 0;
  899 | 
  900 |   return (
  901 |     <div className="modal-overlay" onClick={e => e.target === e.currentTarget && onClose()}>
  902 |       <div
  903 |         className="modal"
  904 |         style={{ maxWidth: hasPreview ? 900 : 520, maxHeight: '95vh', overflowY: 'auto', transition: 'max-width .25s' }}
  905 |         onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()}
  906 |       >
  907 |         {/* Header */}
  908 |         <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: 16 }}>
  909 |           <h2 className="modal-title" style={{ margin: 0 }}>Generate Relieving Letter</h2>
  910 |           <button className="btn btn-ghost btn-sm" onClick={onClose}>✕</button>
  911 |         </div>
  912 | 
  913 |         {/* Employee info card */}
  914 |         <div style={{ background: 'var(--surface-2)', borderRadius: 8, padding: 14, marginBottom: 16 }}>
  915 |           <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1fr', gap: 10 }}>
  916 |             {[['Employee', emp.name], ['ID', emp.employee_id], ['Designation', emp.designation], ['LWD', emp.last_working_day]]
  917 |               .filter(([, v]) => v).map(([k, v]) => (
  918 |                 <div key={k}>
  919 |                   <div style={{ fontSize: 10, fontFamily: 'var(--mono)', color: 'var(--text-dim)', textTransform: 'uppercase', marginBottom: 2 }}>{k}</div>
  920 |                   <div style={{ fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 500 }}>{v}</div>
  921 |                 </div>
  922 |               ))}
  923 |           </div>
  924 |         </div>
  925 | 
  926 |         {/* Clearance banner */}
  927 |         <div style={{ background: 'var(--green-dim)', border: '1px solid rgba(63,207,142,.25)', borderRadius: 8, padding: '10px 14px', marginBottom: 16, fontSize: 12, color: 'var(--green)', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8 }}>
  928 |           <span>✓</span> All 5 clearances confirmed. Letter generation unlocked.
  929 |         </div>
  930 | 
  931 |         <form onSubmit={handleGenerate}>
  932 |           <div style={{ display: hasPreview ? 'grid' : 'block', gridTemplateColumns: '300px 1fr', gap: 24 }}>
  933 | 
  934 |             {/* ── Left column: controls ── */}
  935 |             <div>
  936 | 
  937 |               {/* Template selector */}
  938 |               <div className="form-group">
  939 |                 <label className="form-label">Relieving Letter Template <span style={{ color: 'var(--red)' }}>*</span></label>
  940 |                 <select required value={templateId} onChange={e => handleTemplateChange(e.target.value)}>
  941 |                   <option value="">Select template…</option>
  942 |                   {templates.map(t => <option key={t._id} value={t._id}>{t.name} (v{t.version})</option>)}
  943 |                 </select>
  944 |                 {templates.length === 0 && (
  945 |                   <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: 'var(--amber)', marginTop: 6 }}>No relieving templates found. Upload one in Templates.</div>
  946 |                 )}
  947 |               </div>
  948 | 
  949 |               {/* Spinner while previewing */}
  950 |               {previewing && (
  951 |                 <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8, fontSize: 12, color: 'var(--text-dim)', padding: '8px 0' }}>
  952 |                   <div className="spinner" style={{ width: 14, height: 14 }} /> Reading template & generating preview…
  953 |                 </div>
  954 |               )}
  955 | 
  956 |               {/* ── Missing fields form ── */}
  957 |               {hasMissing && !previewing && (
  958 |                 <div style={{ background: 'rgba(245,166,35,.07)', border: '1px solid rgba(245,166,35,.25)', borderRadius: 8, padding: '12px 14px', marginBottom: 12 }}>
  959 |                   <div style={{ fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 700, color: 'var(--amber)', marginBottom: 4 }}>
  960 |                     ⚠ {missingFields.length} field{missingFields.length !== 1 ? 's' : ''} not found in employee record
  961 |                   </div>
  962 |                   <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: 'var(--text-dim)', marginBottom: 12, lineHeight: 1.5 }}>
  963 |                     The following could not be filled from the employee record. Please enter them manually, then click Preview Again.
  964 |                   </div>
  965 | 
  966 |                   {missingFields.map(key => (
  967 |                     <div className="form-group" key={key} style={{ marginBottom: 10 }}>
  968 |                       <label className="form-label" style={{ fontSize: 11 }}>
  969 |                         {PLACEHOLDER_LABELS[key] || key} <span style={{ color: 'var(--red)' }}>*</span>
  970 |                       </label>
  971 |                       <input
  972 |                         value={extraFields[key] || ''}
  973 |                         onChange={e => setExtraFields(p => ({ ...p, [key]: e.target.value }))}
  974 |                         placeholder={`Enter ${PLACEHOLDER_LABELS[key] || key}…`}
  975 |                         style={{ fontSize: 13 }}
  976 |                       />
  977 |                     </div>
  978 |                   ))}
  979 | 
  980 |                   <button
  981 |                     type="button"
  982 |                     className="btn btn-primary btn-sm"
  983 |                     style={{ width: '100%', marginTop: 4 }}
  984 |                     onClick={handleRePreview}
  985 |                   >
  986 |                     ↻ Preview Again
  987 |                   </button>
  988 |                 </div>
  989 |               )}
  990 | 
  991 |               {/* Preview error */}
  992 |               {previewError && !previewing && (
  993 |                 <div style={{ fontSize: 12, color: 'var(--red)', padding: '6px 0', marginBottom: 8 }}>⚠ {previewError}</div>
  994 |               )}
  995 | 
  996 |               {/* Preview success indicator */}
  997 |               {hasPreview && !hasMissing && (
  998 |                 <div style={{ fontSize: 12, color: 'var(--green)', padding: '6px 0', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 6 }}>
  999 |                   ✓ Preview ready
 1000 |                 </div>
 1001 |               )}
 1002 | 
 1003 |               {/* Candidate email */}
 1004 |               <div className="form-group">
 1005 |                 <label className="form-label">Candidate Email <span style={{ color: 'var(--red)' }}>*</span></label>
 1006 |                 <input
 1007 |                   type="email"
 1008 |                   value={candidateEmail}
 1009 |                   onChange={e => setCandidateEmail(e.target.value)}
 1010 |                   placeholder="e.g. employee@gmail.com"
 1011 |                   required
 1012 |                 />
 1013 |               </div>
 1014 | 
 1015 |               {genError && <div className="alert alert-error" style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>{genError}</div>}
 1016 |             </div>
 1017 | 
 1018 |             {/* ── Right column: PDF preview iframe ── */}
 1019 |             {hasPreview && (
 1020 |               <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column' }}>
 1021 |                 <div style={{ fontSize: 10, fontFamily: 'var(--mono)', color: 'var(--text-dim)', textTransform: 'uppercase', letterSpacing: '0.08em', marginBottom: 8 }}>
 1022 |                   Document Preview
 1023 |                 </div>
 1024 |                 <iframe
 1025 |                   src={previewUrl}
 1026 |                   style={{ flex: 1, minHeight: 520, border: '1px solid var(--border)', borderRadius: 8, background: '#fff' }}
 1027 |                   title="Relieving Letter Preview"
 1028 |                 />
 1029 |               </div>

 1031 |           </div>
 1032 | 
 1033 |           <div className="modal-footer" style={{ marginTop: 16 }}>
 1034 |             <button type="button" className="btn btn-secondary" onClick={onClose}>Cancel</button>
 1035 |             <button
 1036 |               type="submit"
 1037 |               className="btn btn-primary"
 1038 |               disabled={generating || !templateId || !hasPreview || hasMissing}
 1039 |               title={!hasPreview ? 'Preview the letter first' : hasMissing ? 'Fill in all missing fields first' : ''}
 1040 |             >
 1041 |               {generating ? 'Generating…' : '◈ Generate Relieving Letter'}
 1042 |             </button>
 1043 |           </div>
 1044 |         </form>
 1045 |       </div>
 1046 |     </div>

  233 | // ─── Main page ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  234 | export default function LeaveManagementPage() {
  235 |   const { user } = useAuth();
  236 |   const canDecide = ['hr_head', 'admin'].includes(user?.role);
  237 | 
  238 |   const [tab, setTab] = useState('requests');
  239 |   const [requests, setRequests] = useState([]);
  240 |   const [balances, setBalances] = useState([]);
  241 |   const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  242 |   const [toast, setToast] = useState('');
  243 |   const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState('');
  244 | 
  245 |   const load = useCallback(() => {
  246 |     setLoading(true);
  247 |     const q = statusFilter ? `?status=${statusFilter}` : '';
  248 |     Promise.all([
  249 |       axios.get(`/api/leaves/all${q}`).catch(() => ({ data: [] })),
  250 |       axios.get('/api/leaves/balances').catch(() => ({ data: [] })),
  251 |     ]).then(([r, b]) => { setRequests(r.data); setBalances(b.data); }).finally(() => setLoading(false));
  252 |   }, [statusFilter]);
  253 | 
  254 |   useEffect(() => { load(); }, [load]);
  255 | 
  256 |   const handleDecide = async (id, action, remarks = '') => {
  257 |     try {
  258 |       await axios.post(`/api/leaves/${id}/hr-head-action`, { action, remarks });
  259 |       setToast(`Request ${action}d`); setTimeout(() => setToast(''), 2500); load();
  260 |     } catch (e) {
  261 |       setToast(e.response?.data?.error || 'Action failed'); setTimeout(() => setToast(''), 3000);
  262 |     }
  263 |   };
  264 | 
  265 |   if (loading) return <div className="loading-screen"><div className="spinner" /></div>;
  266 | 
  267 |   return (
  268 |     <div>
  269 |       <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'flex-start', marginBottom: 4 }}>
  270 |         <div>
  271 |           <h2 style={{ fontFamily: 'var(--display)', fontSize: 20, fontWeight: 700, margin: 0 }}>Leave Management</h2>
  272 |           <p style={{ color: 'var(--text-dim)', fontSize: 13, margin: '4px 0 0' }}>
  273 |             Track every employee's leave requests and monthly balances.
  274 |             {!canDecide && ' You can view and adjust balances; approvals are handled by managers and HR Head.'}
  275 |           </p>
  276 |         </div>
  277 |         <NotificationBell />
  278 |       </div>
  279 | 
  280 |       {toast && <div className="alert alert-success" style={{ margin: '16px 0' }}>{toast}</div>}
  281 | 
  282 |       <div className="tab-bar" style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 4, background: '#f1f5f9', borderRadius: 10, padding: 4, width: 'fit-content', margin: '20px 0' }}>
  283 |         {[{ key: 'requests', label: 'All Requests' }, { key: 'balances', label: 'Balances' }].map(t => (
  284 |           <button key={t.key} onClick={() => setTab(t.key)} style={{
  285 |             padding: '7px 16px', borderRadius: 7, border: 'none', cursor: 'pointer', fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 600,
  286 |             background: tab === t.key ? '#fff' : 'transparent', color: tab === t.key ? '#2563eb' : '#64748b',
  287 |             boxShadow: tab === t.key ? '0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.06)' : 'none',
  288 |           }}>{t.label}</button>
  289 |         ))}
  290 |       </div>
  291 | 
  292 |       {tab === 'requests' && (
  293 |         <>
  294 |           <div style={{ marginBottom: 14 }}>
  295 |             <select value={statusFilter} onChange={e => setStatusFilter(e.target.value)} style={{ width: 220 }}>
  296 |               <option value="">All statuses</option>
  297 |               <option value="pending_manager">Pending — Manager</option>
  298 |               <option value="pending_hr_head">Pending — HR Head</option>
  299 |               <option value="approved">Approved</option>
  300 |               <option value="rejected">Rejected</option>
  301 |               <option value="cancelled">Cancelled</option>
  302 |             </select>
  303 |           </div>
  304 |           <AllRequestsTab requests={requests} canDecide={canDecide} onDecide={handleDecide} />
  305 |         </>
  306 |       )}
  307 |       {tab === 'balances' && <BalancesTab balances={balances} onAdjust={load} />}
  308 |     </div>
  309 |   );
  310 | }

    1 | /**

   43 | // ─── Apply Leave Modal (with live preview) ──────────────────────────────────
   44 | function ApplyLeaveModal({ isFemale, onClose, onSubmitted }) {
   45 |   const [leaveType, setLeaveType] = useState('');
   46 |   const [fromDate, setFromDate]   = useState('');
   47 |   const [toDate, setToDate]       = useState('');
   48 |   const [teamEmail, setTeamEmail] = useState('');
   49 |   const [reason, setReason]       = useState('');
   50 |   const [error, setError]         = useState('');
   51 |   const [saving, setSaving]       = useState(false);
   52 |   const [preview, setPreview]     = useState(null);
   53 |   const [previewing, setPreviewing] = useState(false);
   54 |   const debounceRef = useRef(null);
   55 | 
   56 |   const availableTypes = isFemale ? ['CL', 'SL', 'ML', 'LP'] : ['CL', 'SL', 'LP'];
   57 | 
   58 |   // Live preview whenever type/dates change
   59 |   useEffect(() => {
   60 |     setPreview(null);
   61 |     if (!leaveType || !fromDate || !toDate || toDate < fromDate) return;
   62 |     clearTimeout(debounceRef.current);
   63 |     debounceRef.current = setTimeout(async () => {
   64 |       setPreviewing(true);
   65 |       try {
   66 |         const { data } = await axios.post('/api/leaves/preview', {
   67 |           leave_type: leaveType, from_date: fromDate, to_date: toDate,
   68 |         });
   69 |         setPreview(data);
   70 |       } catch (e) {
   71 |         setPreview({ error: e.response?.data?.error || 'Could not check balance' });
   72 |       } finally { setPreviewing(false); }
   73 |     }, 350);
   74 |     return () => clearTimeout(debounceRef.current);
   75 |   }, [leaveType, fromDate, toDate]);
   76 | 
   77 |   const submit = async (acknowledgeLp = false) => {
   78 |     setError('');
   79 |     if (!leaveType) return setError('Please select a leave type.');
   80 |     if (!fromDate || !toDate) return setError('Please select a date range.');
   81 |     if (toDate < fromDate) return setError('End date cannot be before start date.');
   82 |     setSaving(true);
   83 |     try {
   84 |       await axios.post('/api/leaves/apply', {
   85 |         leave_type: leaveType, from_date: fromDate, to_date: toDate,
   86 |         team_email: teamEmail, reason, acknowledge_lp_split: acknowledgeLp,
   87 |       });
   88 |       onSubmitted();
   89 |     } catch (e) {
   90 |       if (e.response?.status === 409 && e.response?.data?.error === 'lp_confirmation_required') {
   91 |         // Shouldn't normally hit this since the preview already warned, but handle it safely.
   92 |         setError(e.response.data.message);
   93 |       } else {
   94 |         setError(e.response?.data?.error || 'Could not submit leave request');
   95 |       }
   96 |     } finally { setSaving(false); }
   97 |   };
   98 | 
   99 |   const hasLpSplit = leaveType !== 'LP' && preview && !preview.error && preview.lp_days > 0;
  100 | 
  101 |   return (
  102 |     <div className="modal-overlay" onClick={e => { if (e.target === e.currentTarget) onClose(); }}>
  103 |       <div className="modal" style={{ maxWidth: 520, padding: 0 }}>
  104 |         <div style={{
  105 |           padding: '18px 24px', borderBottom: '1px solid #e2e8f0',
  106 |           display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between',
  107 |         }}>
  108 |           <h3 style={{ margin: 0, fontFamily: 'var(--display)', fontSize: 17, fontWeight: 700 }}>Apply Leave</h3>
  109 |           <button onClick={onClose} style={{
  110 |             width: 28, height: 28, borderRadius: 7, border: '1px solid #e2e8f0',
  111 |             background: 'transparent', cursor: 'pointer', fontSize: 13,
  112 |           }}>✕</button>
  113 |         </div>
  114 | 
  115 |         <div style={{ padding: '20px 24px' }}>
  116 |           {error && <div className="alert alert-error" style={{ marginBottom: 14 }}>{error}</div>}
  117 | 
  118 |           <div className="form-group">
  119 |             <label className="form-label">Leave type *</label>
  120 |             <select value={leaveType} onChange={e => setLeaveType(e.target.value)}>
  121 |               <option value="">Select…</option>
  122 |               {availableTypes.map(k => (
  123 |                 <option key={k} value={k}>{LEAVE_META[k].label} ({k})</option>
  124 |               ))}
  125 |             </select>
  126 |           </div>
  127 | 
  128 |           <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1fr', gap: 12, margin: '14px 0' }}>
  129 |             <div className="form-group" style={{ margin: 0 }}>
  130 |               <label className="form-label">From *</label>
  131 |               <input type="date" value={fromDate} onChange={e => setFromDate(e.target.value)} />
  132 |             </div>
  133 |             <div className="form-group" style={{ margin: 0 }}>
  134 |               <label className="form-label">To *</label>
  135 |               <input type="date" value={toDate} onChange={e => setToDate(e.target.value)} />
  136 |             </div>
  137 |           </div>
  138 | 
  139 |           {previewing && <div style={{ fontSize: 12, color: '#94a3b8', marginBottom: 10 }}>Checking your balance…</div>}
  140 |           {preview && !preview.error && leaveType !== 'LP' && (
  141 |             <div style={{
  142 |               marginBottom: 14, padding: '10px 14px', borderRadius: 8, fontSize: 12.5,
  143 |               background: hasLpSplit ? 'rgba(217,119,6,.08)' : 'rgba(5,150,105,.08)',
  144 |               border: `1px solid ${hasLpSplit ? '#d9770640' : '#05966940'}`,
  145 |               color: hasLpSplit ? '#92400e' : '#065f46',
  146 |             }}>
  147 |               {hasLpSplit ? (
  148 |                 <>⚠️ {preview.warning}</>

  150 |                 <>✓ All {preview.days} day(s) fit within your free {leaveType} quota this month.</>
  151 |               )}
  152 |             </div>
  153 |           )}
  154 |           {preview?.error && <div className="alert alert-error" style={{ marginBottom: 14, fontSize: 12.5 }}>{preview.error}</div>}
  155 | 
  156 |           <div className="form-group">
  157 |             <label className="form-label">Team email ID (optional — who to notify)</label>
  158 |             <input type="email" value={teamEmail} onChange={e => setTeamEmail(e.target.value)}
  159 |                    placeholder="team@company.com" />
  160 |           </div>
  161 | 
  162 |           <div className="form-group" style={{ marginBottom: 0 }}>
  163 |             <label className="form-label">Reason for leave</label>
  164 |             <textarea rows={3} value={reason} onChange={e => setReason(e.target.value)} />
  165 |           </div>
  166 |         </div>
  167 | 
  168 |         <div style={{
  169 |           padding: '14px 24px', borderTop: '1px solid #e2e8f0',
  170 |           display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'flex-end', gap: 8, background: '#f8fafc',
  171 |         }}>
  172 |           <button className="btn btn-secondary" onClick={onClose}>Cancel</button>
  173 |           <button className="btn btn-primary" onClick={() => submit(hasLpSplit)} disabled={saving || previewing}>
  174 |             {saving ? 'Submitting…' : hasLpSplit ? `Submit (${preview.paid_days}d paid + ${preview.lp_days}d LP)` : 'Submit'}
  175 |           </button>
  176 |         </div>
  177 |       </div>

  181 | 
  182 | // ─── Calendar View ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  183 | function CalendarView({ requests }) {
  184 |   const [cursor, setCursor] = useState(new Date());
  185 |   const year = cursor.getFullYear();
  186 |   const month = cursor.getMonth();
  187 | 
  188 |   const firstDay = new Date(year, month, 1);
  189 |   const startWeekday = firstDay.getDay();
  190 |   const daysInMonth = new Date(year, month + 1, 0).getDate();
  191 | 
  192 |   const leaveDays = {};
  193 |   requests.filter(r => r.status === 'approved' || r.status.startsWith('pending')).forEach(r => {
  194 |     const from = new Date(r.from_date);
  195 |     const to = new Date(r.to_date);
  196 |     for (let d = new Date(from); d <= to; d.setDate(d.getDate() + 1)) {
  197 |       if (d.getFullYear() === year && d.getMonth() === month) leaveDays[d.getDate()] = r;
  198 |     }
  199 |   });
  200 | 
  201 |   const cells = [];
  202 |   for (let i = 0; i < startWeekday; i++) cells.push(null);
  203 |   for (let d = 1; d <= daysInMonth; d++) cells.push(d);
  204 | 
  205 |   const monthLabel = cursor.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { month: 'long', year: 'numeric' });
  206 |   const today = new Date();
  207 |   const isToday = (d) => d === today.getDate() && month === today.getMonth() && year === today.getFullYear();
  208 | 
  209 |   return (
  210 |     <div>
  211 |       <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 12, marginBottom: 16 }}>
  212 |         <button onClick={() => setCursor(new Date(year, month - 1, 1))} className="btn btn-secondary" style={{ padding: '6px 12px' }}>‹</button>
  213 |         <div style={{ fontFamily: 'var(--display)', fontWeight: 700, fontSize: 15 }}>{monthLabel}</div>
  214 |         <button onClick={() => setCursor(new Date(year, month + 1, 1))} className="btn btn-secondary" style={{ padding: '6px 12px' }}>›</button>
  215 |       </div>
  216 |       <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(7, 1fr)', gap: 6 }}>
  217 |         {['Sun', 'Mon', 'Tue', 'Wed', 'Thu', 'Fri', 'Sat'].map(d => (
  218 |           <div key={d} style={{ fontSize: 11.5, fontWeight: 700, color: '#94a3b8', textAlign: 'center', padding: '4px 0' }}>{d}</div>
  219 |         ))}
  220 |         {cells.map((d, i) => {
  221 |           const leave = d ? leaveDays[d] : null;
  222 |           const meta = leave ? LEAVE_META[leave.leave_type] : null;
  223 |           return (
  224 |             <div key={i} style={{
  225 |               minHeight: 68, borderRadius: 8, padding: '6px 8px',
  226 |               background: d ? (leave ? meta.bg : '#fff') : 'transparent',
  227 |               border: d ? `1px solid ${leave ? meta.color + '40' : '#e2e8f0'}` : 'none',
  228 |             }}>
  229 |               {d && (
  230 |                 <>
  231 |                   <div style={{ fontSize: 12.5, fontWeight: isToday(d) ? 800 : 600, color: isToday(d) ? '#2563eb' : '#0f172a' }}>{d}</div>
  232 |                   {leave && <div style={{ fontSize: 10, fontWeight: 700, color: meta.color, marginTop: 3 }}>{leave.leave_type}</div>}
  233 |                 </>
  234 |               )}
  235 |             </div>
  236 |           );
  237 |         })}
  238 |       </div>
  239 |     </div>
  240 |   );
  241 | }
  242 | 
  243 | // ─── Leave Summary tab ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  244 | function SummaryCard({ leaveKey, availableMonth, usedMonth, availableYear, usedYear, cap }) {
  245 |   const meta = LEAVE_META[leaveKey];
  246 |   return (
  247 |     <div style={{ background: '#fff', border: '1px solid #e2e8f0', borderRadius: 12, padding: '18px 20px' }}>
  248 |       <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10, marginBottom: 14 }}>
  249 |         <div style={{
  250 |           width: 34, height: 34, borderRadius: 9, background: meta.bg,
  251 |           display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', fontSize: 16, color: meta.color,
  252 |         }}>{meta.icon}</div>
  253 |         <div style={{ fontWeight: 700, fontSize: 13.5 }}>{meta.label}</div>
  254 |       </div>
  255 |       <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', marginBottom: 4 }}>
  256 |         <span style={{ fontSize: 12, color: '#64748b' }}>Free this month</span>
  257 |         <span style={{ fontWeight: 700 }}>{availableMonth} / {cap}</span>
  258 |       </div>
  259 |       <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', marginBottom: 10 }}>
  260 |         <span style={{ fontSize: 12, color: '#64748b' }}>Used this month</span>
  261 |         <span style={{ fontWeight: 700 }}>{usedMonth}</span>
  262 |       </div>

  271 | function SummaryTab({ summary, requests, onApply }) {

  389 |         <button className="btn btn-primary" onClick={onApply}>Add Request</button>
  390 |       </div>

  393 |   return (
  394 |     <div style={{ background: '#fff', border: '1px solid #e2e8f0', borderRadius: 12, overflow: 'hidden' }}>

  397 |           <div>
  398 |             <div style={{ fontWeight: 700, marginBottom: 3 }}>

  401 |             </div>

  409 |           </div>

  411 |             <StatusPill status={r.status} />
  412 |             {(r.status === 'pending_manager' || r.status === 'pending_hr_head') && (
  413 |               <button className="btn btn-secondary" style={{ padding: '5px 10px', fontSize: 12 }} onClick={() => onCancel(r._id)}>Cancel</button>
  414 |             )}
  415 |           </div>
  416 |         </div>
  417 |       ))}
  418 |     </div>

  422 | // ─── Team Requests tab (manager only) ───────────────────────────────────────
  423 | function TeamTab({ pending, onAction }) {
  424 |   const [remarksFor, setRemarksFor] = useState(null);
  425 |   const [remarks, setRemarks] = useState('');
  426 | 
  427 |   if (!pending.length) return <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', padding: '64px 0', color: '#94a3b8' }}>No pending requests from your team</div>;
  428 | 
  429 |   return (
  430 |     <div style={{ background: '#fff', border: '1px solid #e2e8f0', borderRadius: 12, overflow: 'hidden' }}>
  431 |       {pending.map(r => (
  432 |         <div key={r._id} style={{ padding: '14px 18px', borderBottom: '1px solid #f1f5f9' }}>
  433 |           <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'flex-start' }}>
  434 |             <div>
  435 |               <div style={{ fontWeight: 700 }}>{r.employee_name} <span style={{ color: '#94a3b8', fontWeight: 400 }}>({r.employee_code})</span></div>
  436 |               <div style={{ fontSize: 13, marginTop: 3 }}>
  437 |                 <span style={{ color: LEAVE_META[r.leave_type]?.color, fontWeight: 700, marginRight: 8 }}>{r.leave_type}</span>
  438 |                 {r.from_date} → {r.to_date} ({r.days}d)
  439 |                 {r.lp_days > 0 && r.leave_type !== 'LP' && (
  440 |                   <span style={{ color: '#d97706', fontWeight: 600 }}> · {r.paid_days}d paid + {r.lp_days}d LP</span>
  441 |                 )}
  442 |               </div>
  443 |               {r.reason && <div style={{ fontSize: 12.5, color: '#64748b', marginTop: 3 }}>{r.reason}</div>}
  444 |             </div>
  445 |             <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8 }}>
  446 |               <button className="btn btn-primary" style={{ padding: '6px 12px', fontSize: 12.5 }} onClick={() => onAction(r._id, 'approve')}>Approve</button>
  447 |               <button className="btn btn-secondary" style={{ padding: '6px 12px', fontSize: 12.5, color: '#dc2626' }} onClick={() => setRemarksFor(r._id)}>Reject</button>
  448 |             </div>
  449 |           </div>
  450 |           {remarksFor === r._id && (
  451 |             <div style={{ marginTop: 10, display: 'flex', gap: 8 }}>
  452 |               <input placeholder="Rejection reason (required)" value={remarks} onChange={e => setRemarks(e.target.value)} style={{ flex: 1 }} />
  453 |               <button className="btn btn-secondary" style={{ color: '#dc2626' }}
  454 |                       onClick={() => { onAction(r._id, 'reject', remarks); setRemarksFor(null); setRemarks(''); }}>Confirm Reject</button>
  455 |               <button className="btn btn-secondary" onClick={() => { setRemarksFor(null); setRemarks(''); }}>Cancel</button>
  456 |             </div>
  457 |           )}
  458 |         </div>
  459 |       ))}
  460 |     </div>
  461 |   );
  462 | }

  464 | // ─── Main page ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  465 | export default function LeaveTrackerPage() {
  466 |   const { user } = useAuth();
  467 |   const isManager = user?.role === 'manager';
  468 | 
  469 |   const [tab, setTab] = useState('summary');
  470 |   const [summary, setSummary] = useState(null);
  471 |   const [requests, setRequests] = useState([]);
  472 |   const [teamPending, setTeamPending] = useState([]);
  473 |   const [showApply, setShowApply] = useState(false);
  474 |   const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  475 |   const [toast, setToast] = useState('');
  476 | 
  477 |   const load = useCallback(() => {
  478 |     setLoading(true);
  479 |     Promise.all([
  480 |       axios.get('/api/leaves/my-summary').catch(() => ({ data: null })),
  481 |       axios.get('/api/leaves/my-requests').catch(() => ({ data: [] })),
  482 |       isManager ? axios.get('/api/leaves/team-pending').catch(() => ({ data: [] })) : Promise.resolve({ data: [] }),
  483 |     ]).then(([s, r, t]) => { setSummary(s.data); setRequests(r.data); setTeamPending(t.data); })
  484 |       .finally(() => setLoading(false));
  485 |   }, [isManager]);
  486 | 
  487 |   useEffect(() => { load(); }, [load]);
  488 | 
  489 |   const handleCancel = async (id) => { await axios.post(`/api/leaves/${id}/cancel`).catch(() => {}); load(); };
  490 | 
  491 |   const handleTeamAction = async (id, action, remarks = '') => {
  492 |     try {
  493 |       await axios.post(`/api/leaves/${id}/manager-action`, { action, remarks });
  494 |       setToast(`Request ${action}d`); setTimeout(() => setToast(''), 2500); load();
  495 |     } catch (e) {
  496 |       setToast(e.response?.data?.error || 'Action failed'); setTimeout(() => setToast(''), 3000);
  497 |     }
  498 |   };
  499 | 
  500 |   const TABS = [
  501 |     { key: 'summary', label: 'Leave Summary' },
  502 |     { key: 'requests', label: 'Leave Requests' },
  503 |     ...(isManager ? [{ key: 'team', label: `Team Requests${teamPending.length ? ` (${teamPending.length})` : ''}` }] : []),
  504 |   ];
  505 | 
  506 |   if (loading) return <div className="loading-screen"><div className="spinner" /></div>;
  507 | 
  508 |   return (
  509 |     <div>
  510 |       <h2 style={{ fontFamily: 'var(--display)', fontSize: 20, fontWeight: 700, marginBottom: 4 }}>Leave Tracker</h2>
  511 |       <p style={{ color: 'var(--text-dim)', fontSize: 13, marginBottom: 20 }}>Apply for leave, track your balance, and view request history.</p>
  512 | 
  513 |       {toast && <div className="alert alert-success" style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>{toast}</div>}
  514 | 
  515 |       <div className="tab-bar" style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 4, background: '#f1f5f9', borderRadius: 10, padding: 4, width: 'fit-content', marginBottom: 20 }}>
  516 |         {TABS.map(t => (
  517 |           <button key={t.key} onClick={() => setTab(t.key)} style={{
  518 |             padding: '7px 16px', borderRadius: 7, border: 'none', cursor: 'pointer', fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 600,
  519 |             background: tab === t.key ? '#fff' : 'transparent', color: tab === t.key ? '#2563eb' : '#64748b',
  520 |             boxShadow: tab === t.key ? '0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.06)' : 'none',
  521 |           }}>{t.label}</button>
  522 |         ))}
  523 |       </div>
  524 | 
  525 |       {tab === 'summary' && <SummaryTab summary={summary} requests={requests} onApply={() => setShowApply(true)} />}
  526 |       {tab === 'requests' && <RequestsTab requests={requests} onApply={() => setShowApply(true)} onCancel={handleCancel} />}
  527 |       {tab === 'team' && isManager && <TeamTab pending={teamPending} onAction={handleTeamAction} />}
  528 | 
  529 |       {showApply && (
  530 |         <ApplyLeaveModal
  531 |           isFemale={!!summary?.is_female}
  532 |           onClose={() => setShowApply(false)}
  533 |           onSubmitted={() => { setShowApply(false); setToast('Leave request submitted'); setTimeout(() => setToast(''), 2500); load(); }}
  534 |         />
  535 |       )}
  536 |     </div>
  537 |   );
  538 | }

   76 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   77 | // SignaturePad — draw or upload a digital signature, returns base64 PNG
   78 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   79 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   80 | // Signature Pad — draw or upload, outputs base64 PNG
   81 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   82 | 
   83 | const SIGNATURE_KEYS = new Set(['hr_signature', 'chairman_signature']);
   84 | 
   85 | function SignaturePad({ label, value, onChange }) {
   86 |   const canvasRef = useRef(null);
   87 |   const [mode, setMode] = useState('draw'); // 'draw' | 'upload'
   88 |   const [drawing, setDrawing] = useState(false);
   89 |   const [hasDrawing, setHasDrawing] = useState(false);
   90 |   const fileRef = useRef(null);
   91 | 
   92 |   // Initialize canvas
   93 |   useEffect(() => {
   94 |     if (mode !== 'draw') return;
   95 |     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
   96 |     if (!canvas) return;
   97 |     const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
   98 |     ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
   99 |     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
  100 |     ctx.strokeStyle = '#1a1a2e';
  101 |     ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  102 |     ctx.lineCap = 'round';
  103 |     ctx.lineJoin = 'round';
  104 |   }, [mode]);
  105 | 
  106 |   const getPos = (e, canvas) => {
  107 |     const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  108 |     const scaleX = canvas.width / rect.width;
  109 |     const scaleY = canvas.height / rect.height;
  110 |     if (e.touches) {
  111 |       return {
  112 |         x: (e.touches[0].clientX - rect.left) * scaleX,
  113 |         y: (e.touches[0].clientY - rect.top) * scaleY,
  114 |       };
  115 |     }
  116 |     return {
  117 |       x: (e.clientX - rect.left) * scaleX,
  118 |       y: (e.clientY - rect.top) * scaleY,
  119 |     };
  120 |   };
  121 | 
  122 |   const startDraw = (e) => {
  123 |     e.preventDefault();
  124 |     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
  125 |     const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  126 |     const pos = getPos(e, canvas);
  127 |     ctx.beginPath();
  128 |     ctx.moveTo(pos.x, pos.y);
  129 |     setDrawing(true);
  130 |   };
  131 | 
  132 |   const draw = (e) => {
  133 |     if (!drawing) return;
  134 |     e.preventDefault();
  135 |     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
  136 |     const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  137 |     const pos = getPos(e, canvas);
  138 |     ctx.lineTo(pos.x, pos.y);
  139 |     ctx.stroke();
  140 |     setHasDrawing(true);
  141 |   };
  142 | 
  143 |   const endDraw = () => {
  144 |     if (!drawing) return;
  145 |     setDrawing(false);
  146 |     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
  147 |     onChange(canvas.toDataURL('image/png'));
  148 |   };
  149 | 
  150 |   const clearPad = () => {
  151 |     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
  152 |     const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  153 |     ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  154 |     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
  155 |     setHasDrawing(false);
  156 |     onChange('');
  157 |   };
  158 | 
  159 |   const handleUpload = (e) => {
  160 |     const file = e.target.files[0];
  161 |     if (!file) return;
  162 |     const reader = new FileReader();
  163 |     reader.onload = (ev) => onChange(ev.target.result);
  164 |     reader.readAsDataURL(file);
  165 |   };
  166 | 
  167 |   return (
  168 |     <div style={{ border: '1px solid var(--border)', borderRadius: 8, overflow: 'hidden' }}>
  169 |       {/* Header */}
  170 |       <div style={{
  171 |         display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between',
  172 |         padding: '8px 12px', background: 'var(--surface-2)',
  173 |         borderBottom: '1px solid var(--border)',
  174 |       }}>
  175 |         <span style={{ fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 600, color: 'var(--text)' }}>{label}</span>
  176 |         <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 4 }}>
  177 |           {['draw', 'upload'].map(m => (
  178 |             <button key={m} type="button"
  179 |               className={`btn btn-sm ${mode === m ? 'btn-primary' : 'btn-secondary'}`}
  180 |               style={{ fontSize: 11, padding: '3px 10px' }}
  181 |               onClick={() => { setMode(m); onChange(''); setHasDrawing(false); }}>
  182 |               {m === 'draw' ? '✏ Draw' : '⬆ Upload'}
  183 |             </button>
  184 |           ))}
  185 |           {value && (
  186 |             <button type="button" className="btn btn-sm btn-secondary"
  187 |               style={{ fontSize: 11, padding: '3px 10px', color: 'var(--red)', borderColor: 'rgba(240,82,82,.3)' }}
  188 |               onClick={() => { clearPad(); onChange(''); }}>
  189 |               ✕ Clear
  190 |             </button>
  191 |           )}
  192 |         </div>
  193 |       </div>
  194 | 
  195 |       {/* Draw mode */}
  196 |       {mode === 'draw' && (
  197 |         <div style={{ position: 'relative', background: '#fff' }}>
  198 |           <canvas
  199 |             ref={canvasRef}
  200 |             width={100} height={120}
  201 |             style={{ width: '80%', height: 120, cursor: 'crosshair', display: 'block', touchAction: 'none' }}
  202 |             onMouseDown={startDraw}
  203 |             onMouseMove={draw}
  204 |             onMouseUp={endDraw}
  205 |             onMouseLeave={endDraw}
  206 |             onTouchStart={startDraw}
  207 |             onTouchMove={draw}
  208 |             onTouchEnd={endDraw}
  209 |           />
  210 |           {!hasDrawing && !value && (
  211 |             <div style={{
  212 |               position: 'absolute', inset: 0, display: 'flex',
  213 |               alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center',
  214 |               pointerEvents: 'none', color: '#bbb', fontSize: 13,
  215 |             }}>
  216 |               Draw signature here…
  217 |             </div>
  218 |           )}
  219 |         </div>
  220 |       )}
  221 | 
  222 |       {/* Upload mode */}
  223 |       {mode === 'upload' && (
  224 |         <div style={{ padding: 16, background: '#fff' }}>
  225 |           {value ? (
  226 |             <div style={{ textAlign: 'center' }}>
  227 |               <img src={value} alt="signature" style={{ maxHeight: 80, maxWidth: '100%', objectFit: 'contain' }} />
  228 |             </div>
  229 |           ) : (
  230 |             <div
  231 |               style={{ border: '2px dashed var(--border)', borderRadius: 6, padding: '20px 0', textAlign: 'center', cursor: 'pointer', color: 'var(--text-dim)', fontSize: 13 }}
  232 |               onClick={() => fileRef.current?.click()}
  233 |             >
  234 |               Click to upload signature image (PNG/JPG)
  235 |             </div>
  236 |           )}
  237 |           <input ref={fileRef} type="file" accept="image/*" style={{ display: 'none' }} onChange={handleUpload} />
  238 |         </div>
  239 |       )}
  240 | 
  241 |       {/* Status */}
  242 |       {value && (
  243 |         <div style={{ padding: '4px 12px', background: 'rgba(63,207,142,.06)', borderTop: '1px solid rgba(63,207,142,.2)', fontSize: 11, color: 'var(--green)' }}>
  244 |           ✓ Signature captured
  245 |         </div>
  246 |       )}
  247 |     </div>
  248 |   );
  249 | }
