  275 |     ['DA (Dearness Allowance)', bd.da_monthly, bd.da, '20% of Basic'],
  276 |     ['Other Allowances', bd.other_allowances_monthly, bd.other_allowances, 'CTC minus all other components'],

  278 |     ['Group Health Insurance', bd.ghi_monthly, bd.ghi, 'Annual premium entered'],

  381 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  382 | // CTC Section (input + auto-breakdown)
  383 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  384 | 
  385 | function CTCSection({ state, onChange }) {
  386 |   const timerRef = useRef(null);
  387 |   const { ctc, pf, ghi, metro, bd, bdLoading } = state;
  388 | 
  389 |   const recalc = (overrides = {}) => {
  390 |     const merged = { ctc, pf, ghi, metro, ...overrides };
  391 |     if (!merged.ctc || isNaN(merged.ctc)) return;
  392 |     onChange({ bdLoading: true });
  393 |     axios.post('/api/letters/ctc-breakdown', {
  394 |       annual_ctc: parseFloat(merged.ctc),
  395 |       avail_pf: merged.pf,
  396 |       ghi_annual: parseFloat(merged.ghi || 0),
  397 |       metro: merged.metro,
  398 |     }).then(r => onChange({ bd: r.data, bdLoading: false }))
  399 |       .catch(() => onChange({ bdLoading: false }));
  400 |   };
  401 | 
  402 |   const handleCTC = (val) => {
  403 |     onChange({ ctc: val, bd: null });
  404 |     clearTimeout(timerRef.current);
  405 |     if (!val || isNaN(val)) return;
  406 |     timerRef.current = setTimeout(() => recalc({ ctc: val }), 600);
  407 |   };
  408 | 
  409 |   return (
  410 |     <div style={{ background: 'var(--surface)', border: '1px solid var(--border)', borderRadius: 'var(--radius)', padding: 16, marginBottom: 16 }}>
  411 |       <div style={{ fontSize: 11, fontFamily: 'var(--mono)', color: 'var(--text-dim)', textTransform: 'uppercase', letterSpacing: '0.08em', marginBottom: 12 }}>CTC & Salary Breakdown</div>
  412 | 
  413 |       <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1fr', gap: 12, marginBottom: 12 }}>
  414 |         <div className="form-group" style={{ margin: 0 }}>
  415 |           <Lbl req>Annual CTC (₹)</Lbl>
  416 |           <input type="number" value={ctc} min="0" step="1000"
  417 |             onChange={e => handleCTC(e.target.value)}
  418 |             placeholder="e.g. 600000" />
  419 |         </div>
  420 |         <div className="form-group" style={{ margin: 0 }}>
  421 |           <Lbl>GHI Annual Premium (₹)</Lbl>
  422 |           <input type="number" value={ghi} min="0" step="500"
  423 |             onChange={e => { onChange({ ghi: e.target.value }); recalc({ ghi: e.target.value }); }}
  424 |             placeholder="0 if not applicable" />
  425 |         </div>
  426 |       </div>
  427 | 
  428 |       <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 24, fontSize: 13, marginBottom: 10 }}>
  429 |         <label style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 7, cursor: 'pointer' }}>
  430 |           <input type="checkbox" checked={pf} onChange={e => { onChange({ pf: e.target.checked }); recalc({ pf: e.target.checked }); }} style={{ width: 'auto' }} />
  431 |           <span>Avail Employer PF</span>
  432 |           <span style={{ fontSize: 10, color: 'var(--text-dim)' }}>(fixed ₹1,800/mo)</span>
  433 |         </label>
  434 |         <label style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 7, cursor: 'pointer' }}>
  435 |           <input type="checkbox" checked={metro} onChange={e => { onChange({ metro: e.target.checked }); recalc({ metro: e.target.checked }); }} style={{ width: 'auto' }} />
  436 |           <span>Metro city</span>
  437 |           <span style={{ fontSize: 10, color: 'var(--text-dim)' }}>(HRA 50% vs 40%)</span>
  438 |         </label>
  439 |       </div>
  440 | 
  441 |       {bdLoading && (
  442 |         <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', padding: '10px', color: 'var(--text-dim)', fontSize: 12 }}>
  443 |           <div className="spinner" style={{ width: 18, height: 18, display: 'inline-block', marginRight: 8, verticalAlign: 'middle' }} />
  444 |           Calculating breakdown…
  445 |         </div>
  446 |       )}
  447 | 
  448 |       {bd && (
  449 |         <div style={{ background: 'var(--surface-2)', borderRadius: 'var(--radius)', padding: 12 }}>
  450 |           <div style={{ fontSize: 10, fontFamily: 'var(--mono)', color: 'var(--accent)', textTransform: 'uppercase', marginBottom: 6 }}>
  451 |             Salary Structure Preview
  452 |           </div>
  453 |           <BreakdownTable bd={bd} />
  454 |         </div>
  455 |       )}
  456 |     </div>
  457 |   );
  458 | }

  460 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  461 | // Template Placeholder Fields
  462 | // (only renders fields not in CTC_AUTO, EMP_AUTO, or SIG_AUTO)
  463 | // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  464 | 
  465 | function PlaceholderFields({ template, vals, onChange }) {
  466 |   if (!template) return null;
  467 | 
  468 |   const all = template.placeholders || [];
  469 |   const autoFill = all.filter(p => EMP_AUTO.has(p) || CTC_AUTO.has(p) || SIG_AUTO.has(p));
  470 |   const manual = all.filter(p => !EMP_AUTO.has(p) && !CTC_AUTO.has(p) && !SIG_AUTO.has(p));
  471 | 
  472 |   return (
  473 |     <div style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}>
  474 |       {/* Auto-filled badge list */}
  475 |       {autoFill.length > 0 && (
  476 |         <div style={{ background: 'var(--green-dim)', border: '1px solid rgba(63,207,142,0.2)', borderRadius: 'var(--radius)', padding: '8px 12px', marginBottom: 12, fontSize: 12 }}>
  477 |           <div style={{ fontSize: 10, fontFamily: 'var(--mono)', color: 'var(--green)', textTransform: 'uppercase', marginBottom: 6 }}>
  478 |             ✓ Auto-filled — no input needed
  479 |           </div>
  480 |           <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 5 }}>
  481 |             {autoFill.map(p => (
  482 |               <span key={p} style={{ background: 'var(--surface)', border: '1px solid rgba(63,207,142,0.3)', borderRadius: 4, padding: '2px 8px', fontFamily: 'var(--mono)', fontSize: 11, color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>
  483 |                 {'{{'}{p}{'}}'}
  484 |               </span>
  485 |             ))}
  486 |           </div>
  487 |         </div>
  488 |       )}
  489 | 
  490 |       {/* Manual placeholder inputs */}
  491 |       {manual.length === 0 ? (
  492 |         <div style={{ padding: '12px 14px', background: 'var(--surface-2)', borderRadius: 'var(--radius)', fontSize: 12, color: 'var(--text-dim)', textAlign: 'center' }}>
  493 |           No additional fields to fill — all placeholders are auto-populated.
  494 |         </div>
  495 |       ) : (
  496 |         <>
  497 |           <div style={{ fontSize: 11, fontFamily: 'var(--mono)', color: 'var(--text-dim)', textTransform: 'uppercase', letterSpacing: '0.08em', marginBottom: 10 }}>
  498 |             Fill In — template-specific placeholders
  499 |           </div>
  500 |           <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1fr', gap: 12 }}>
  501 |             {manual.filter(p => !SIGNATURE_KEYS.has(p)).map(p => (
  502 |               <div key={p} className="form-group" style={{ margin: 0 }}>
  503 |                 <Lbl>{p.replace(/_/g, ' ')}</Lbl>
  504 |                 <input value={vals[p] || ''}
  505 |                   onChange={e => onChange({ ...vals, [p]: e.target.value })}
  506 |                   placeholder={`{{${p}}}`} />
  507 |               </div>
  508 |             ))}
  509 |           </div>
  510 | 
  511 |           {/* Signature fields — full width with draw/upload pad */}
  512 |           {manual.filter(p => SIGNATURE_KEYS.has(p)).map(p => (
  513 |             <div key={p} style={{ marginTop: 12 }}>
  514 |               <div style={{ fontSize: 11, color: 'var(--text-dim)', marginBottom: 6, fontWeight: 600 }}>
  515 |                 {p.replace(/_/g, ' ').replace(/\b\w/g, c => c.toUpperCase())} <span style={{ color: 'var(--red)' }}>*</span>
  516 |               </div>
  517 |               <SignaturePad
  518 |                 label={p === 'hr_signature' ? 'HR Signature' : 'Chairman Signature'}
  519 |                 value={vals[p] || ''}
  520 |                 onChange={v => onChange({ ...vals, [p]: v })}
  521 |               />
  522 |             </div>
  523 |           ))}
  524 |         </>
  525 |       )}
  526 |     </div>
  527 |   );
  528 | }

  661 | function LetterPreviewModal({ letter, onClose, onEditDone }) {
  662 |   const [mode, setMode] = useState('preview');
  663 |   const [pdfUrl, setPdfUrl] = useState(null);
  664 |   const [isGoogleViewer, setIsGoogleViewer] = useState(false);
  665 |   const [pdfKey, setPdfKey] = useState(0);
  666 |   const [fields, setFields] = useState({});
  667 |   const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  668 |   const [error, setError] = useState('');
  669 |   const [success, setSuccess] = useState('');
  670 | 
  671 |   const SKIP = new Set([
  672 |     'basic', 'hra', 'da', 'employer_pf', 'ghi', 'other_allowances',
  673 |     'gross_monthly', 'net_annual', 'ctc_fmt', 'basic_fmt', 'hra_fmt', 'da_fmt',
  674 |     'employer_pf_fmt', 'ghi_fmt', 'other_allowances_fmt', 'gross_monthly_fmt',
  675 |     'net_annual_fmt', 'basic_monthly', 'hra_monthly', 'da_monthly',
  676 |     'employer_pf_monthly', 'other_allowances_monthly',
  677 |     'basic_m', 'basic_y', 'hra_m', 'hra_y', 'da_m', 'da_y',
  678 |     'other_m', 'other_y', 'gross_m', 'gross_y',
  679 |     'pf_employer_m', 'pf_employer_y', 'additions_m', 'additions_y',
  680 |     'total_ctc_m', 'total_ctc_y', 'pf_employee_m', 'pf_employee_y',
  681 |     'prof_tax_m', 'prof_tax_y', 'deductions_m', 'deductions_y',
  682 |     'net_pay_m', 'net_pay_y', 'employee_id', 'date',
  683 |   ]);
  684 | 
  685 |   const loadPdf = () => {
  686 |     axios.get(`/api/letters/${letter._id}/preview-pdf`, {
  687 |       responseType: 'blob',
  688 |       headers: { ...axios.defaults.headers.common }
  689 |     }).then(r => {
  690 |       const ct = r.headers['content-type'] || '';
  691 |       if (ct.includes('application/json')) {
  692 |         r.data.text().then(text => {
  693 |           const json = JSON.parse(text);
  694 |           if (json.docx_url) {
  695 |             const viewer = `https://docs.google.com/gview?url=${encodeURIComponent(window.location.origin + json.docx_url)}&embedded=true`;
  696 |             setPdfUrl(viewer); setPdfKey(k => k + 1); setIsGoogleViewer(true);
  697 |           }
  698 |         });
  699 |       } else {
  700 |         setPdfUrl(prev => { if (prev) URL.revokeObjectURL(prev); return URL.createObjectURL(r.data); });
  701 |         setPdfKey(k => k + 1); setIsGoogleViewer(false);
  702 |       }
  703 |     }).catch(() => { });
  704 |   };
  705 | 
  706 |   useEffect(() => {
  707 |     loadPdf();
  708 |     axios.get(`/api/letters/${letter._id}/preview-context`)
  709 |       .then(r => {
  710 |         const ctx = r.data.context || {};
  711 |         const filtered = {};
  712 |         Object.entries(ctx).forEach(([k, v]) => { if (!SKIP.has(k)) filtered[k] = v; });
  713 |         setFields(filtered);
  714 |       }).catch(() => { });
  715 |     return () => { if (pdfUrl) URL.revokeObjectURL(pdfUrl); };
  716 |   }, [letter._id]);
  717 | 
  718 |   const save = async () => {
  719 |     setSaving(true); setError(''); setSuccess('');
  720 |     try {
  721 |       await axios.post(`/api/letters/${letter._id}/update-draft`, { fields });
  722 |       setSuccess('Saved! Refreshing preview…');
  723 |       setMode('preview');
  724 |       setTimeout(() => { loadPdf(); setSuccess(''); if (onEditDone) onEditDone(); }, 800);
  725 |     } catch (e) {
  726 |       setError(e.response?.data?.error || 'Save failed');
  727 |     } finally { setSaving(false); }
  728 |   };
  729 | 
  730 |   const isEditable = ['draft', 'rejected'].includes(letter.status);
  731 | 
  732 |   return (
  733 |     <div className="modal-overlay" onClick={e => e.target === e.currentTarget && onClose()}>
  734 |       <div className="modal" style={{ maxWidth: 860, maxHeight: '95vh', overflowY: 'auto', padding: 0 }}>
  735 | 
  736 |         {/* Toolbar */}
  737 |         <div style={{
  738 |           display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center',
  739 |           padding: '14px 20px', borderBottom: '1px solid var(--border)',
  740 |           background: 'var(--surface)', position: 'sticky', top: 0, zIndex: 10,
  741 |         }}>
  742 |           <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10 }}>
  743 |             <span style={{ fontFamily: 'var(--display)', fontWeight: 700, fontSize: 15 }}>
  744 |               {mode === 'edit' ? '✎ Edit Placeholder Values' : '◈ Offer Letter Preview'}
  745 |             </span>
  746 |             <span className={`badge ${letter.status === 'rejected' ? 'badge-red' :
  747 |               letter.status === 'draft' ? 'badge-gray' :
  748 |                 letter.status === 'pending_hr_head' ? 'badge-amber' : 'badge-green'
  749 |               }`}>{letter.status?.replace(/_/g, ' ')}</span>
  750 |           </div>
  751 |           <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 8 }}>
  752 |             {isEditable && mode === 'preview' && (
  753 |               <button className="btn btn-secondary btn-sm" onClick={() => setMode('edit')}>
  754 |                 ✎ Edit Fields
  755 |               </button>
  756 |             )}
  757 |             {mode === 'edit' && (
  758 |               <>
  759 |                 <button className="btn btn-secondary btn-sm" onClick={() => { setMode('preview'); setError(''); }}>
  760 |                   Cancel
  761 |                 </button>
  762 |                 <button className="btn btn-primary btn-sm" onClick={save} disabled={saving}>
  763 |                   {saving ? 'Saving…' : '✓ Save & Preview'}
  764 |                 </button>
  765 |               </>
  766 |             )}
  767 |             <button className="btn btn-ghost btn-sm" onClick={onClose}>✕</button>
  768 |           </div>
  769 |         </div>
  770 | 
  771 |         {error && <div className="alert alert-error" style={{ margin: '10px 20px 0' }}>{error}</div>}
  772 |         {success && <div className="alert alert-success" style={{ margin: '10px 20px 0' }}>{success}</div>}
  773 | 
  774 |         {/* EDIT MODE — placeholder fields */}
  775 |         {mode === 'edit' && (
  776 |           <div style={{ padding: 24 }}>
  777 |             <div style={{
  778 |               background: 'var(--accent-dim)', border: '1px solid rgba(79,142,247,0.2)',
  779 |               borderRadius: 'var(--radius)', padding: '10px 14px', marginBottom: 18, fontSize: 12, color: 'var(--accent)'
  780 |             }}>
  781 |               ✎ Edit any field below. The document will be <strong>regenerated from the original template</strong> — all formatting, alignment, logo, tables and layout are preserved automatically.
  782 |             </div>
  783 | 
  784 |             <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1fr', gap: 12 }}>
  785 |               {Object.entries(fields).map(([k, v]) => (
  786 |                 <div key={k} className="form-group" style={{
  787 |                   margin: 0,
  788 |                   gridColumn: (k.includes('address') || k.includes('line') || String(v).length > 60) ? '1 / -1' : 'auto'
  789 |                 }}>
  790 |                   <label className="form-label" style={{ textTransform: 'capitalize' }}>
  791 |                     {k.replace(/_/g, ' ')}
  792 |                   </label>
  793 |                   {String(v).length > 60 ? (
  794 |                     <textarea rows={3} value={v || ''}
  795 |                       onChange={e => setFields(f => ({ ...f, [k]: e.target.value }))}
  796 |                       style={{ width: '100%', resize: 'vertical' }} />
  797 |                   ) : (
  798 |                     <input
  799 |                       type={k.includes('date') ? 'date' : k === 'ctc' ? 'number' : 'text'}
  800 |                       value={v || ''}
  801 |                       onChange={e => setFields(f => ({ ...f, [k]: e.target.value }))}
  802 |                     />
  803 |                   )}
  804 |                 </div>
  805 |               ))}
  806 |             </div>
  807 | 
  808 |             {/* CTC note */}
  809 |             {fields.ctc !== undefined && (
  810 |               <div style={{ marginTop: 14, padding: '10px 14px', background: 'var(--surface-2)', borderRadius: 'var(--radius)', fontSize: 12, color: 'var(--text-dim)' }}>
  811 |                 💡 If you change the CTC value, the entire salary breakdown table (Basic, HRA, DA, PF, Net Pay etc.) will be recalculated automatically.
  812 |               </div>
  813 |             )}
  814 |           </div>
  815 |         )}
  816 | 
  817 |         {/* PREVIEW MODE — PDF */}
  818 |         {mode === 'preview' && (
  819 |           <div style={{ width: '100%', height: '75vh', background: '#525659', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center' }}>
  820 |             {pdfUrl ? (
  821 |               <iframe key={pdfKey} src={pdfUrl}
  822 |                 style={{ width: '100%', height: '100%', border: 'none' }}
  823 |                 title="Offer Letter Preview" />
  824 |             ) : (
  825 |               <div style={{ color: '#ccc', fontSize: 13 }}>Loading document…</div>
  826 |             )}
  827 |           </div>
  828 |         )}
  829 |       </div>
  830 |     </div>
  831 |   );

  833 | 
  834 | function DirectEditModal({ letter, onClose, onEditDone }) {
  835 |   const [blocks, setBlocks] = useState([]);
  836 |   const [orig, setOrig] = useState({});   // original texts by id
  837 |   const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  838 |   const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  839 |   const [error, setError] = useState('');
  840 |   const [success, setSuccess] = useState('');
  841 |   const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  842 | 
  843 |   useEffect(() => {
  844 |     setError('');
  845 |     axios.get(`/api/letters/${letter._id}/docx-to-html`)
  846 |       .then(r => {
  847 |         const blks = r.data.blocks || [];
  848 |         setBlocks(blks);
  849 |         // Store originals for diff on save
  850 |         const o = {};
  851 |         blks.forEach(b => { o[b.id] = b.text; });
  852 |         setOrig(o);
  853 |       })
  854 |       .catch(() => setError('Failed to load document'))
  855 |       .finally(() => setLoading(false));
  856 |   }, [letter._id]);
  857 | 
  858 |   const update = (id, val) =>
  859 |     setBlocks(prev => prev.map(b => b.id === id ? { ...b, text: val } : b));
  860 | 
  861 |   const save = async () => {
  862 |     setSaving(true); setError(''); setSuccess('');
  863 |     // Only send blocks that actually changed
  864 |     const changed = blocks.filter(b => b.text !== orig[b.id]);
  865 |     if (changed.length === 0) {
  866 |       setSaving(false);
  867 |       onClose();
  868 |       return;
  869 |     }
  870 |     try {
  871 |       await axios.post(`/api/letters/${letter._id}/save-html`, {
  872 |         blocks: changed.map(b => ({ id: b.id, text: b.text }))
  873 |       });
  874 |       setSuccess(`Saved ${changed.length} change${changed.length > 1 ? 's' : ''}!`);
  875 |       setTimeout(() => { if (onEditDone) onEditDone(); onClose(); }, 1000);
  876 |     } catch (e) {
  877 |       setError(e.response?.data?.error || 'Save failed');
  878 |     } finally { setSaving(false); }
  879 |   };
  880 | 
  881 |   const paraBlocks = blocks.filter(b =>
  882 |     b.type === 'para' && (b.text.trim() || orig[b.id]?.trim()) &&
  883 |     (!search || b.text.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()) ||
  884 |       orig[b.id]?.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()))
  885 |   );
  886 |   const cellBlocks = blocks.filter(b =>
  887 |     b.type === 'cell' &&
  888 |     (!search || b.text.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()))
  889 |   );
  890 | 
  891 |   const changedCount = blocks.filter(b => b.text !== orig[b.id]).length;
  892 | 
  893 |   return (
  894 |     <div className="modal-overlay" onClick={e => e.target === e.currentTarget && onClose()}>
  895 |       <div className="modal" style={{ maxWidth: 900, maxHeight: '95vh', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', padding: 0 }}>
  896 | 
  897 |         {/* Header */}
  898 |         <div style={{
  899 |           display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center',
  900 |           padding: '14px 20px', borderBottom: '1px solid var(--border)',
  901 |           background: 'var(--surface)', flexShrink: 0,
  902 |         }}>

 1555 |   const [previewPdfUrl, setPreviewPdfUrl] = useState(null);
 1556 |   const [empRole, setEmpRole] = useState('employee');
 1557 |   const [hrSignature, setHrSignature] = useState(null); // base64 PNG — HR
 1558 |   const [chairmanSignature, setChairmanSignature] = useState(null); // base64 PNG — Chairman

 1566 |       responseType: 'blob',
 1567 |       headers: { ...axios.defaults.headers.common }
 1568 |     }).then(r => {
 1569 |       const ct = r.headers['content-type'] || '';
 1570 |       if (ct.includes('application/json')) {
 1571 |         r.data.text().then(text => {
 1572 |           try {
 1573 |             const json = JSON.parse(text);
 1574 |             if (json.docx_url) {
 1575 |               setPreviewPdfUrl(`https://docs.google.com/gview?url=${encodeURIComponent(window.location.origin + json.docx_url)}&embedded=true`);
 1576 |             }
 1577 |           } catch { }
 1578 |         });
 1579 |       } else {
 1580 |         setPreviewPdfUrl(URL.createObjectURL(r.data));
 1581 |       }
 1582 |     }).catch(() => { });
 1583 |   }, [letter._id]);
 1584 |

 1587 |     if (!hrSignature || !chairmanSignature) return;
 1588 |     axios.post(`/api/letters/${letter._id}/preview-with-signatures`, {
 1589 |       hr_signature: hrSignature,
 1590 |       chairman_signature: chairmanSignature,

 1592 |       .then(r => {
 1593 |         const ct = r.headers['content-type'] || '';
 1594 |         if (ct.includes('application/pdf')) {
 1595 |           setPreviewPdfUrl(prev => { if (prev) URL.revokeObjectURL(prev); return URL.createObjectURL(r.data); });
 1596 |         }
 1597 |       })
 1598 |       .catch(() => { });
 1599 |   }, [hrSignature, chairmanSignature]);
 1600 | 
 1601 |   useEffect(() => {
 1602 |     axios.get('/api/auth/users?role=manager')
 1603 |       .then(r => setManagers(r.data || []))
 1604 |       .catch(() => { });

 1608 |   const phase = isRevised

 1641 |         to_email: email,

 2077 | function DeleteModal({ letter, onClose, onDone }) {
 2078 |   const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
 2079 |   const [error, setError] = useState('');
 2080 |   const cfg = STATUS_CFG[letter.status] || {};
 2081 | 
 2082 |   const confirm = async () => {
 2083 |     setLoading(true); setError('');
 2084 |     try {
 2085 |       await axios.delete(`/api/letters/${letter._id}`);
 2086 |       onDone(`Deleted offer letter v${letter.version} for ${letter.employee_name}.`);
 2087 |     } catch (e) {
 2088 |       setError(e.response?.data?.error || 'Delete failed');
 2089 |       setLoading(false);
 2090 |     }
 2091 |   };
 2092 | 
 2093 |   return (
 2094 |     <div className="modal-overlay" onClick={e => e.target === e.currentTarget && onClose()}>
 2095 |       <div className="modal" style={{ maxWidth: 420 }}>
 2096 |         <h2 className="modal-title" style={{ color: 'var(--red)' }}>⚠ Delete Offer Letter</h2>
 2097 |         <div style={{ background: 'var(--surface-2)', borderRadius: 'var(--radius)', padding: 14, marginBottom: 12, fontSize: 13 }}>
 2098 |           <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1fr', gap: 8 }}>
 2099 |             {[['Employee', letter.employee_name], ['Code', letter.employee_code],
 2100 |             ['Version', `v${letter.version}`]].map(([k, v]) => (
 2101 |               <div key={k}><span style={{ color: 'var(--text-dim)' }}>{k}: </span><strong>{v}</strong></div>
 2102 |             ))}
 2103 |             <div><span style={{ color: 'var(--text-dim)' }}>Status: </span><span className={`badge ${cfg.cls}`}>{cfg.label}</span></div>
 2104 |           </div>
 2105 |         </div>
 2106 |         <div style={{ background: 'var(--red-dim)', border: '1px solid rgba(240,82,82,0.25)', borderRadius: 'var(--radius)', padding: '10px 14px', marginBottom: 14, fontSize: 12, color: 'var(--red)' }}>
 2107 |           <strong>Permanent.</strong> Record and files removed. Approved / Issued / Joined / Withdrawn letters are audit records and cannot be deleted.
 2108 |         </div>
 2109 |         {error && <div className="alert alert-error">{error}</div>}
 2110 |         <div className="modal-footer">
 2111 |           <button className="btn btn-secondary" onClick={onClose} disabled={loading}>Cancel</button>
 2112 |           <button onClick={confirm} disabled={loading}
 2113 |             style={{ padding: '9px 18px', background: 'var(--red)', color: 'white', border: 'none', borderRadius: 'var(--radius)', cursor: loading ? 'not-allowed' : 'pointer', fontSize: 13, fontWeight: 500 }}>
 2114 |             {loading ? 'Deleting…' : '✕ Delete Permanently'}
 2115 |           </button>
 2116 |         </div>
 2117 |       </div>
 2118 |     </div>
 2119 |   );
 2120 | }

   16 | // ── Delete Confirm Modal ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   17 | 
   18 | function DeleteTemplateModal({ template, onClose, onDone }) {
   19 |   const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
   20 |   const [error, setError] = useState('');
   21 | 
   22 |   const confirm = async () => {
   23 |     setLoading(true); setError('');
   24 |     try {
   25 |       await axios.delete(`/api/templates/${template._id}`);
   26 |       onDone(`Template "${template.name}" deleted.`);
   27 |     } catch (e) {
   28 |       setError(e.response?.data?.error || 'Delete failed');
   29 |       setLoading(false);
   30 |     }
   31 |   };
   32 | 
   33 |   return (
   34 |     <div className="modal-overlay" onClick={e => e.target === e.currentTarget && onClose()}>
   35 |       <div className="modal" style={{ maxWidth: 440 }}>
   36 |         <h2 className="modal-title" style={{ color: 'var(--red)' }}>⚠ Delete Template</h2>
   37 | 
   38 |         <div style={{ background: 'var(--surface-2)', borderRadius: 'var(--radius)', padding: 14, marginBottom: 16 }}>
   39 |           <div style={{ display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: '1fr 1fr', gap: 10, fontSize: 13 }}>
   40 |             {[['Name', template.name], ['Type', template.type], ['Version', `v${template.version}`], ['Status', template.is_active ? 'Active' : 'Inactive']].map(([k, v]) => (
   41 |               <div key={k}>
   42 |                 <div style={{ fontSize: 10, fontFamily: 'var(--mono)', color: 'var(--text-dim)', textTransform: 'uppercase', marginBottom: 2 }}>{k}</div>
   43 |                 <div style={{ fontWeight: 500 }}>{v}</div>
   44 |               </div>
   45 |             ))}
   46 |           </div>
   47 |         </div>
   48 | 
   49 |         <div style={{ background: 'var(--red-dim)', border: '1px solid rgba(240,82,82,0.25)', borderRadius: 'var(--radius)', padding: '10px 14px', marginBottom: 16, fontSize: 12, color: 'var(--red)', lineHeight: 1.6 }}>
   50 |           <strong>This action is permanent.</strong> The template record and its DOCX file will
   51 |           be deleted from disk. This will fail if any offer letters reference this template —
   52 |           in that case, <strong>Deactivate</strong> it instead to block new use while
   53 |           preserving the audit trail.
   54 |         </div>
   55 | 
   56 |         {error && <div className="alert alert-error">{error}</div>}
   57 | 
   58 |         <div className="modal-footer">
   59 |           <button className="btn btn-secondary" onClick={onClose} disabled={loading}>Cancel</button>
   60 |           <button className="btn btn-danger" onClick={confirm} disabled={loading}
   61 |             style={{ background: 'var(--red)', borderColor: 'var(--red)', color: 'white' }}>
   62 |             {loading ? 'Deleting...' : '✕ Delete Permanently'}
   63 |           </button>
   64 |         </div>
   65 |       </div>
   66 |     </div>
   67 |   );
   68 | }

   70 | // ── Main TemplatesPage ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

   72 | export default function TemplatesPage() {
   73 |   const { user } = useAuth();
   74 |   const [templates, setTemplates] = useState([]);
   75 |   const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
   76 |   const [showModal, setShowModal] = useState(false);
   77 |   const [deleteTarget, setDeleteTarget] = useState(null);
   78 |   const [uploading, setUploading] = useState(false);
   79 |   const [error, setError] = useState('');
   80 |   const [success, setSuccess] = useState('');
   81 |   const [form, setForm] = useState({ name: '', templateType: 'offer' });
   82 |   const [activeType, setActiveType] = useState('offer');
   83 |   const fileRef = useRef();
   84 | 
   85 |   const isAdmin = user?.role === 'admin';
   86 |   const canDelete = user?.role === 'admin' || user?.role === 'hr_head';
   87 | 
   88 |   const load = (type = activeType) => {
   89 |     setLoading(true);
   90 |     axios.get(`/api/templates/?type=${type}`)
   91 |       .then(r => setTemplates(r.data))
   92 |       .finally(() => setLoading(false));
   93 |   };
   94 |   useEffect(() => { load(activeType); }, [activeType]);
   95 | 
   96 |   const handleUpload = async (e) => {
   97 |     e.preventDefault(); setError(''); setUploading(true);
   98 |     const file = fileRef.current.files[0];
   99 |     if (!file) { setError('Please select a .docx file'); setUploading(false); return; }
  100 |     const fd = new FormData();
  101 |     fd.append('file', file);
  102 |     fd.append('name', form.name || file.name);
  103 |     fd.append('type', form.templateType);
  104 |     try {
  105 |       const res = await axios.post('/api/templates/upload', fd, { headers: { 'Content-Type': 'multipart/form-data' } });
  106 |       setSuccess(`Uploaded v${res.data.version}. Found ${res.data.placeholders.length} placeholder(s).`);
  107 |       setShowModal(false);
  108 |       setActiveType(form.templateType);
  109 |       setTimeout(() => setSuccess(''), 6000);
  110 |     } catch (err) {
  111 |       setError(err.response?.data?.error || 'Upload failed');
  112 |     } finally { setUploading(false); }
  113 |   };
  114 | 
  115 |   const toggle = async (id) => {
  116 |     try {
  117 |       await axios.post(`/api/templates/${id}/toggle`);
  118 |       load();
  119 |     } catch (err) {
  120 |       setError(err.response?.data?.error || 'Toggle failed');
  121 |     }
  122 |   };
  123 | 
  124 |   const dlTemplate = (t) =>
  125 |     axios.get(`/api/templates/${t._id}/download`, { responseType: 'blob' })
  126 |       .then(r => {
  127 |         const url = URL.createObjectURL(r.data);
  128 |         const a = document.createElement('a');
  129 |         a.href = url; a.download = t.filename; a.click();
  130 |         setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 1000);
  131 |       });
  132 | 
  133 |   const onDeleteDone = (msg) => {
  134 |     setDeleteTarget(null);
  135 |     load();
  136 |     setSuccess(msg);
  137 |     setTimeout(() => setSuccess(''), 5000);
  138 |   };
  139 | 
  140 |   return (
  141 |     <div>
  142 |       <div className="page-header">
  143 |         <div>
  144 |           <h1 className="page-title">Templates</h1>
  145 | 
  146 |         </div>
  147 |         {isAdmin && (
  148 |           <button className="btn btn-primary"
  149 |             onClick={() => { setShowModal(true); setError(''); setForm({ name: '', templateType: activeType }); }}>
  150 |             ↑ Upload Template
  151 |           </button>
  152 |         )}
  153 |       </div>
  154 | 
  155 |       {success && <div className="alert alert-success">{success}</div>}
  156 |       {error && <div className="alert alert-error">{error}</div>}
  157 | 
  158 |       {/* Permission notice */}
  159 |       {canDelete && (
  160 |         <div style={{ background: 'var(--amber-dim)', border: '1px solid rgba(245,166,35,0.25)', borderRadius: 'var(--radius)', padding: '8px 14px', marginBottom: 16, fontSize: 12, color: 'var(--amber)', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8 }}>
  161 |           <span>⚠</span>
  162 |           <span>You have <strong>{user.role === 'admin' ? 'Admin' : 'HR Head'}</strong> privileges. Templates with no linked letters can be permanently deleted. Use <strong>Deactivate</strong> to soft-disable templates that have existing letters.</span>
  163 |         </div>
  164 |       )}
  165 | 
  166 |       {/* Type tabs */}
  167 |       <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 4, marginBottom: 16, background: 'var(--surface)', border: '1px solid var(--border)', borderRadius: 'var(--radius)', padding: 4, width: 'fit-content' }}>
  168 |         {[['offer', 'Offer Letter Templates'], ['relieving', 'Relieving Letter Templates'], ['appointment_order', 'Appointment Order Templates']].map(([type, label]) => (
  169 |           <button key={type}
  170 |             className={`btn btn-sm ${activeType === type ? 'btn-primary' : 'btn-ghost'}`}
  171 |             onClick={() => setActiveType(type)} style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>
  172 |             {label}
  173 |           </button>
  174 |         ))}
  175 |       </div>
  176 | 
  177 | 
  178 | 
  179 |       <div className="card">
  180 |         {loading ? <div className="page-loading"><div className="spinner" /></div> : (
  181 |           <div className="table-wrap">
  182 |             <table>
  183 |               <thead>
  184 |                 <tr><th>Name</th><th>Version</th><th>Status</th><th>Actions</th></tr>

  194 |                     <td>

  197 |                     </td>

  236 |               Create a <strong style={{ color: 'var(--text)' }}>.docx</strong> Word document and use{' '}

📄 FILE #67: README.md
----------------------------------------------------------------------
    1 | # HR Offer Letter Automation System
    2 | 
    3 | Internal tool for generating, approving, and managing **offer letters** — built with Flask + React + MongoDB.
    4 | 
    5 | ---
    6 | 
    7 | ## Architecture
    8 | 
    9 | ```
   10 | React (port 3000)  ←→  Flask API (port 5000)  ←→  MongoDB (port 27017)
   11 |                               ↓
   12 |                      DOCX/PDF Generation (python-docx + LibreOffice)
   13 | ```
   14 | 
   15 | ---
   16 | 
   17 | ## Quick Start (Local Dev)
   18 | 
   19 | ### Prerequisites
   20 | - Python 3.10+, Node.js 18+, MongoDB running locally
   21 | - LibreOffice (optional — for PDF output)
   22 | 
   23 | ### 1. Backend
   24 | ```bash
   25 | cd backend
   26 | cp .env.example .env          # edit JWT_SECRET_KEY
   27 | pip install -r requirements.txt
   28 | python app.py                 # → http://localhost:5000
   29 | ```
   30 | 
   31 | ### 2. Frontend
   32 | ```bash
   33 | cd frontend
   34 | npm install
   35 | npm start                     # → http://localhost:3000
   36 | ```
   37 | 
   38 | ### 3. Seed demo users
   39 | In the browser: click **Seed DB** on the login page, or:
   40 | ```bash
   41 | curl -X POST http://localhost:5000/api/auth/seed
   42 | ```
   43 | 
   44 | ---
   45 | 
   46 | ## Docker (Recommended)
   47 | 
   48 | ```bash
   49 | docker-compose up --build
   50 | # App: http://localhost:3000
   51 | ```
   52 | 
   53 | ---
   54 | 
   55 | ## Demo Accounts
   56 | 
   57 | | Role     | Email                   | Password      | Can Do                            |
   58 | |----------|-------------------------|---------------|-----------------------------------|
   59 | | Admin    | admin@company.com       | admin123      | Everything + template management  |
   60 | | HR       | hr@company.com          | hr123         | Add employees, generate letters   |
   61 | | Manager  | manager@company.com     | manager123    | First-stage approval              |
   62 | | HR Head  | hrhead@company.com      | hrhead123     | Final approval                    |
   63 | 
   64 | ---
   65 | 
   66 | ## Offer Letter Workflow
   67 | 
   68 | ```
   69 | HR logs in
   70 |   → Adds employee (name, designation, CTC, joining date, etc.)
   71 |   → Uploads DOCX template (Admin only)
   72 |   → Generates offer letter  [status: draft]
   73 |   → Submits for approval    [status: pending_manager]
   74 | 
   75 | Manager logs in
   76 |   → Reviews → Approves      [status: pending_hr_head]
   77 |      OR Rejects             [status: rejected]
   78 | 
   79 | HR Head logs in
   80 |   → Final review → Approves [status: approved]  ← letter is now official
   81 |      OR Rejects             [status: rejected]
   82 | 
   83 | HR downloads final DOCX / PDF
   84 | ```
   85 | 
   86 | ---
   87 | 
   88 | ## Template Placeholders
   89 | 
   90 | Create a `.docx` file using these `{{placeholder}}` tokens:
   91 | 
   92 | | Placeholder              | Value Source                     |
   93 | |--------------------------|----------------------------------|
   94 | | `{{employee_name}}`      | Employee record                  |
   95 | | `{{employee_id}}`        | Employee record                  |
   96 | | `{{designation}}`        | Employee record                  |
   97 | | `{{department}}`         | Employee record                  |
   98 | | `{{ctc}}`                | Employee record                  |
   99 | | `{{basic}}`              | Employee record                  |
  100 | | `{{hra}}`                | Employee record                  |
  101 | | `{{allowances}}`         | Employee record                  |
  102 | | `{{joining_date}}`       | Employee record                  |
  103 | | `{{address}}`            | Employee record                  |
  104 | | `{{probation_period}}`   | Employee record (default: 6)     |
  105 | | `{{notice_period}}`      | Employee record (default: 30)    |
  106 | | `{{company_name}}`       | Set at generation time           |
  107 | | `{{hr_signatory_name}}`  | Set at generation time           |
  108 | | `{{hr_signatory_designation}}` | Set at generation time     |
  109 | | `{{date}}`               | Auto-set to today's date         |
  110 | 
  111 | A ready-to-use sample template is at: `backend/templates_docx/offer_letter_template.docx`
  112 | 
  113 | ---
  114 | 
  115 | ## API Reference
  116 | 
  117 | ```
  118 | POST /api/auth/login          Login
  119 | GET  /api/auth/me             Current user
  120 | POST /api/auth/seed           Seed demo users
  121 | 
  122 | GET  /api/employees/          List employees
  123 | POST /api/employees/          Create employee
  124 | PUT  /api/employees/:id       Update employee
  125 | POST /api/employees/bulk-upload  CSV import
  126 | 
  127 | GET  /api/templates/          List offer templates
  128 | POST /api/templates/upload    Upload DOCX template (Admin)
  129 | POST /api/templates/:id/toggle  Activate/deactivate
  130 | 
  131 | GET  /api/letters/            List offer letters
  132 | POST /api/letters/generate    Generate letter from template
  133 | POST /api/letters/:id/submit  Submit draft for approval
  134 | GET  /api/letters/:id/download?format=docx|pdf
  135 | 
  136 | GET  /api/approvals/pending   Letters pending your action
  137 | GET  /api/approvals/history   Approved/rejected letters
  138 | POST /api/approvals/:id/action  { action: approve|reject, remarks }
  139 | GET  /api/approvals/stats     Status counts
  140 | ```
  141 | 
  142 | ---
  143 | 
  144 | ## File Storage Layout
  145 | 
  146 | ```
  147 | backend/storage/
  148 |   templates/
  149 |     offer_v1_my_template.docx
  150 |     offer_v2_updated.docx
  151 |   letters/
  152 |     2026/
  153 |       EMP001_offer_v1.docx
  154 |       EMP001_offer_v1.pdf
  155 | ```
